jobs.title: Sr Manager, Data Scientist
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**Job Summary:**
The Sr. Manager, Data Science - Operations serves as the strategic and technical leader responsible for driving data science, AI, optimization, and advanced analytics initiatives across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Demand Planning, and Product Formulation functions. This role partners closely with business and technology leaders to identify opportunities, develop scalable analytical solutions, and translate complex business challenges into measurable operational and financial outcomes. Success in this role is demonstrated through delivering enterprise-wide value, accelerating data-driven decision making, and advancing Kraft Heinz's digital transformation agenda.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the identification, prioritization, and execution of advanced analytics, machine learning, optimization, and AI initiatives across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Demand Planning, and Formulation functions.
* Partner with business stakeholders and operational leaders to understand strategic objectives, define analytical roadmaps, and translate business requirements into scalable data science solutions.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Analytics professionals, and cross-functional project teams without direct people management responsibilities.
* Communicate analytical insights, recommendations, business cases, and project outcomes to senior leadership and executive stakeholders using clear, concise, and business-friendly language.
* Design and oversee development of predictive, prescriptive, and optimization models that improve operational efficiency, forecasting accuracy, inventory management, production planning, and product development processes.
* Champion best practices in data science, AI, model governance, experimentation, and responsible AI across the organization.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, industry trends, and innovative analytical approaches to continuously improve business capabilities and competitive advantage.

**Requirements**

* Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or Statistics
* Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in Data Science, Analytics, Operations Research, Machine Learning, or Advanced Analytics
* Demonstrated experience supporting Manufacturing, Digital Twin, Supply Chain, Demand Planning, Production Planning, Inventory Optimization, Procurement, or Product Formulation functions
* Proven track record delivering business value through predictive analytics, optimization, simulation, statistical modeling, and AI solutions.
* Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives involving business stakeholders, technology teams, and executive leadership.
* Experience translating ambiguous business challenges into analytical frameworks and actionable recommendations.
* Preferred experience in Consumer-Packaged Goods (CPG), Food & Beverage, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, or Operations environments.
* Experience with cloud-based analytical platforms and modern data ecosystems.

Location(s)
  
  
Bengaluru - Brookfield GCC
  
  
**Kraft Heinz is an Equal Opportunity Employer – Underrepresented Ethnic Minority Groups/Women/Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity and other protected classes.**

jobs.title: R&D Chef – Patisserie & Sweets
jobs.description:
**Location: Bengaluru**
**Who We Are…**
At GO DESi, our mission is to make DESi 'POP’ular. We are a packaged food brand making regional Desi products relevant and accessible to customers while ensuring quality and authenticity. Today, the majority of our products fall under the Impulse category. Our bestseller is DESi POPz; we sell more than 90 lakh POPz per month. Our other categories include DESi Meetha, DESi Mints, and DESi Bytes. We have an integrated backend, i.e., we own the entire supply chain from sourcing to manufacturing.
  
  
GO DESi aims to be a sustainable brand with the larger purpose of becoming a beacon for non-zero-sum capitalism, where all stakeholders win.
  
  
**Check Out More About Us. Follow The Link Below**
https://bit.ly/4dWXm7r
  
  
**Brief**
As a R&D Chef – Patisserie & Sweets, you oversee all aspects of pastry and sweet production, menu creation, and team management within a professional kitchen. This role demands creativity, leadership, and deep expertise in pastry techniques and food safety standards.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
**Premium Sweet Production & Efficiency:**

* Manage the daily preparation of all sweet items for exclusive store orders, strictly adhering to recipes, quality standards, and portion control optimized for online delivery.
* Specialize in premium Indian sweets (e.g., Kaju Katli, Mysore Pak) and Bengali sweets (e.g., Rasgulla, Sandesh), with attention to transportability and presentation upon arrival.
* Execute mise en place and workflow to ensure swift and efficient fulfilment of high-volume online orders.

**Quality, Consistency & Go Desi Vision**

* Maintain a high standard of quality, focusing on developing and executing low-sweetness, high-flavour sweets that align with the brand vision.
* Evaluate all products for taste, texture, and appearance, ensuring they meet premium guidelines even after transit.

**Hygiene & Operations**

* Strictly adhere to FSSAI regulations, maintaining impeccable food safety, hygiene, and packaging hygiene standards for online operations.
* Efficiently manage stock rotation and inventory to minimize wastage and maximize the use of available resources.

**Collaboration & Presentation**

* Work seamlessly with the NPD, Chef de Partie, packaging, and exclusive stores team to ensure a smooth, end-to-end process from cooking to dispatch.
* Focus on the aesthetic presentation of all sweets, ensuring they are visually appealing for online appeal and maintain their form during delivery.

**Requirements**
**Experience**
: 4-8 years as a R&D Chef / Kitchen Manager or Sous Chef, with a strong focus on Indian sweets, fusion sweets, pastry, or confectionery. Experience with cloud kitchen or exclusive outlet operations is an advantage.
  
  
**Culinary Knowledge:**
Solid knowledge of traditional sweet-making methods, especially Bengali sweets. Basic knowledge of fusion concepts and a keen interest in flavour experimentation.
  
  
**Attributes:**
High attention to detail, a creative mindset, strong teamwork skills, and the ability to work calmly and efficiently under pressure driven by order volumes.
  
  
**Vision Alignment:**
Must understand the Go Desi mission, vision, and target consumer palate, and prioritize initiatives that lead to repeat business.
  
  
**Why you should join GO DESi…**
At GO DESi, we are growing exponentially and discovering new problems and creative solutions daily. We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things and experimenting. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values. Here, you own your work, right from day one. You can grow enormously if you are a self-learner and embrace challenges.

jobs.title: Product Development Manager, Rugs and Home Textiles
jobs.description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**
Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.
  
  
What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.
  
  
**OUR CULTURE**
Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.
  
  

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.
  
  
**Product Development Manager, Rugs and Home Textile**
Quince is a US-based, hyper-growth tech retail start-up experiencing 100%+ YoY growth and serving millions of users each month. Backed by over USD 500 million in funding, we continue to scale rapidly. At Quince, we didn’t just build a $2B+ retail brand—we completely rewrote the playbook on cross-border e-commerce.
  
  
We are seeking a
**Product Development Manager, Rugs and Home Textile**
to join our growing team at Quince. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring products are launched in a timely manner while achieving the highest quality standards.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Own and actively manage day-to-day product development timelines across new products, color and size extensions, vendor transitions, and refreshes, tracking milestones and escalating risks early.
* Serve as the central point of coordination across Merchandising, Sourcing, Fit, Technical Development, Materials, QA, Creative, and Vendors to ensure alignment on development status and dependencies.
* Ensure all required product documentation is accurate, complete, and ready prior to vendor handoff, including technical specifications, build documentation, testing requirements, and fit inputs.
* Coordinate and track all sample requests, shipments, reviews, fit requests, and revisions to drive efficiency and maintain momentum toward target timelines.
* Facilitate timely product reviews and approvals by Merchandising, Fit, and Technical teams; track testing requests and results to ensure quality outcomes are clearly communicated.
* Run in-person country development trips with Global Merchants, Global Fit, and Local PD teams to accelerate decision-making and strengthen vendor execution.
* Partner with Sourcing to support timely staging of materials and finished-goods production; coordinate delivery of photo samples to Creative to ensure marketing and launch readiness.
* Maintain clean, accurate, real-time data across all product development systems and tracking tools to ensure transparency and support fast execution.

**Qualifications required:**

* 10+ years in product development or factory-facing roles
* Deep functional category expertise, including product and material standards
* Extensive experience working directly with factories and sample rooms
* Comfortable operating independently and navigating ambiguity Highly organized, detail-oriented and analytical with focus on execution, problem-solving, improving processes and quality enhancement
* Clear communicator across language, cultural, and functional boundaries
* Proven track record of progressing within an organization and demonstrating continuous growth in roles and responsibilities
* Continuous learner and highly curious; always open to considering new perspectives; proactive when changing course and facing added challenges
* Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills
* Motivated by working in a fast-paced collaborative environment, where flexibility to stretch into or out of functional comfort zones is crucial for team success
* Bachelor’s Degree, preferred

**WHY QUINCE?**
Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.
  
  
**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY**
Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
  
  
Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.
  
  
Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
  
  
*Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds*
At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

jobs.description:
**Job Description: Assistant Manager – Research & Development (R&D)**

**Company:**
Deconstruct

**Location:**
Bangalore – HSR Layout

**Role Type:**
Full-time

**About Deconstruct**

We’re a D2C skincare brand built on one belief: safe, sensible, honest skincare. No fairy-tale marketing. No filler ingredients. Just actives that work. We’re looking for an execution-focused, scientifically rigorous
**Assistant Manager – R&D**
who can own our innovation pipeline end to end, from formulation and claims to quality and launch, and help build science-backed skincare that delivers real results.

**What you’ll own**

* Own the end-to-end NPD and renovation pipeline and deliver
  **10–12 new product launches a year**
  on time against the product launch calendar.
* Lead formulation development for new launches and existing SKU renovations, from ingredient evaluation and optimization through compatibility studies to the final formula.
* Ensure seamless pilot batches and commercial scale-ups with third-party manufacturers, with zero RM- or PM-related challenges.
* Ensure every product meets its accelerated stability, freeze-thaw, compatibility and long-term stability requirements, and maintain
  **zero critical consumer complaints**
  across launched products.
* Develop all products within the target cost in the product brief, and drive cost optimization without compromising quality.
* Lead
  **claims substantiation**
  across existing SKUs and at brand level. This includes planning and running efficacy, consumer perception and in-vitro/clinical studies with testing partners, and extending claims in line with brand and NPD goals.
* Explore and develop
  **potential RM blends**
  with ingredient suppliers to build product differentiation.
* Turn technical and claims data into consumer-relevant communication for Brand, Marketing and Customer Service teams.
* Deliver technical content for PDPs, social media campaigns, blogs, label artworks and marketing communications.
* Own
  **GRN approvals**
  for raw materials within TAT, and work with Quality to keep incoming material standards high.
* Run weekly cross-functional reviews with Brand, CS, Supply Chain, Procurement, Packaging, Quality and Regulatory, as well as with RM and FG vendors, to deliver OTIF.
* Maintain and update NPD project trackers, ensure no deviation from standard SOPs, and drive continuous improvement in development processes.
* Manage formulation partners, CDMOs and ingredient suppliers, and evaluate new vendors and technologies.
* Guide and review the work of R&D associates and interns, and support their technical growth.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, formulation records and product specifications, and support regulatory and artwork approvals.

**What we’re looking for**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cosmetic Technology, Pharmacy, Cosmetic Science, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related discipline.
* 4–7 years of hands-on experience in skincare, cosmetics, personal care or pharmaceutical formulation development.
* A proven track record of taking multiple products from brief to commercial launch with third-party manufacturers.
* Strong expertise in emulsion systems, active ingredients, stability testing, scale-up and commercialization.
* Hands-on exposure to claims substantiation, including efficacy studies, testing labs and claim support documentation.
* Ability to manage a high-volume NPD pipeline in parallel without compromising timelines, quality or cost.
* Strong vendor management, project management and cross-functional stakeholder skills.
* Ability to explain complex science in clear, consumer-friendly language.
* Experience mentoring or guiding junior team members is an advantage.
* Based in Bangalore or willing to relocate.

**What We Offer**

* **Compensation:**
  Competitive compensation aligned with industry standards and experience.
* **Growth:**
  Ownership of the brand’s innovation pipeline, working directly with leadership and cross-functional teams on products from concept to launch.
* **Culture:**
  A fast-paced, collaborative, science-driven and ownership-focused environment with plenty of room to learn, innovate and grow.

**ADDITIONAL CONSIDERATION**

* Experience in D2C skincare, beauty, cosmetics or FMCG brands is preferred.
* Experience running claims substantiation or clinical/efficacy studies is highly desirable.
* Exposure to BIS/CDSCO cosmetic regulations and claim compliance will be an added advantage.
* Candidates with a strong passion for skincare innovation, emerging ingredients and consumer-centric product development will be given preference.

jobs.description:
**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
  
  
**Environmental Conditions**
Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.)
  
  
**About The Company**
Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. (NYSE: TMO) is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue of approximately $44 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving analytical challenges, growing efficiency in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics, or developing and manufacturing life-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our distributed team delivers an outstanding combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience, and pharmaceutical services through our industry-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon, and PPD. Our Innovative Laboratory technologies & Services makes it easier for customers.
  
  
About Team: Antibody team
  
  
The antibody team is involved in engineering and development of antibodies, with a deep focus on reagent quality and specificity. The core activities of the team include design, development, purification, conjugation and testing of antibodies in a variety of immunoassay applications using pioneering tools and technologies. The goal of the program is advanced product development and creation of product specific information to promote research use.
  
  
**Role:**
**To be an integral part of an antibody development team with a focus on performance and specificity using innovative molecular, protein, and cell biology methods. The successful candidate will be joining the Bangalore R&D leadership team for developing antibodies for the Thermo Fisher Scientific Antibody portfolio. This position involves people management, internal, external and cross function collaboration to drive technical strategies for execution in R&D projects involving state-of-art methods.**
Responsibilities:
  
  

* Perform in a fast- paced environment towards antigen and antibody development
* Lead team of scientists in matrix style operation, provide technical and operational supervision.
* Drive conceptualization within teams to enable development of successful protocols for antigen design and development
* Mentoring and training junior scientists in research, designing and experimental execution, interpreting data and data presentation to the stakeholders
* Partner with supporting functions such as product management, program management, operations, and business development to meet program goals.
* Good scientific writing skills, establishing technical protocols for effective transfer to operations teams.
* Good documentation practice is a must to maintain data integrity and accuracy.
* Delivering high quality results according to project schedule in support of product commercialization from concept to launch including early feasibility, development and validation phases.
* Support the manufacturing team for technical support and quality by providing technical guidance.

**Education & Experience needed:**
Applicants should have a Master’s degree with 15+ years R&D experience or PhD with 7+ years experience in a life sciences field with a strong focus on protein biology. Minimum 3-4 years of Industrial experience is required. Prior people management experience is essential.
  
  
Nature of experience:
  
  

* Strong domain expertise
* in the antibody development and engineering field including hybridoma, single B cell, and other recombinant antibody platforms
* Expert in the field of peptide and protein design, expression, purification, and protein-protein interaction (Structure -function -relationship)
* Thorough understanding of antigen/immunogen properties, design and development towards eliciting desired antibody response
* Extensive experience in expression and purification of recombinant proteins from bacterial, yeast, insect and mammalian systems
* Extensive experience in structural biology, antibody and protein engineering, computational modeling and rational design.
* Expertise in development of conjugation chemistries or performing antibody conjugations is desired
* Broad knowledge and experience in molecular biology, cell biology, immunoassays, protein design, engineering, purification, and conjugation fields to enable successful delivery on program goals
* Thorough in biochemical and immunoassay workflows such as ELISA, SDS-PAGE, Western blotting, IF, IHC
* Ability to provide technical trouble shooting to resolve scientific problems.
* Experience in authoring and optimizing standard operating procedures with a focus on reproducibility
* Skills for identifying deviations from expected outcomes, problem solving and suggesting alternatives
* Excellent written and verbal presentation skills
* Experience in leading product launches through knowledge and application of product commercialization processes including feasibility, development, and validation stages
* Proven leadership skills and ability to work alongside colleagues from different backgrounds
* Experience with leading and mentoring people with or without direct reporting structure
* Strong, independent understanding of standard and emerging research protocols and techniques are preferred

The successful candidate will be self-motivated and a self-starter who is excellent at learning and applying new concepts for process or product improvements, possess excellent people and project leadership skills including decision making and conflict resolution, oral and written communication skills to connect to peers and leadership, and demonstrate role model leadership for integrity, intensity, innovation, and involvement.

jobs.title: Risk Modelling Validation & Insights Specialist
jobs.company: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group (ANZ)
jobs.description:
### Job Summary

As a Manager, Modelling Insights is responsible for leading model monitoring and portfolio performance assessment across ANZs credit risk model inventory. The role combines deep analytical expertise, portfolio risk knowledge, and strong stakeholder engagement to deliver actionable insights on model performance, emerging risks, and portfolio behaviour.

The successful candidate will leverage advanced analytics, data visualisation, and statistical techniques to assess model effectiveness, identify performance deterioration, evaluate key risk drivers, and support compliance with internal model risk management standards and regulatory expectations.

Banking is changing and we re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

**Role Type: Permanent  
Role Location: Bengaluru  
Work Hours: Morning Shift**

### What will your day look like

As a Risk Modelling Validation & Insights Specialist, you are expected to undertake the following activities that are deemed core to the role:

* Lead model monitoring and performance analysis across credit risk models, including Decision, Basel Capital, IF/Provisioning, and other risk models
* Drive deep-dive investigations into model outcomes, portfolio performance, segmentation strategies, business growth initiatives, and risk appetite changes
* Develop and enhance interactive dashboards, monitoring frameworks, and management reporting to provide timely risk and performance insights
* Identify opportunities to improve monitoring methodologies, data quality, automation, and analytics capabilities through innovative use of data science and AI/ML techniques
* Provide leadership, coaching, and technical guidance to team members, fostering a high-performing and continuously improving analytical team
* Partner with model developers, validators, portfolio managers, risk teams, and senior stakeholders to ensure effective governance and risk insight generation

### What will you bring

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

* Strong experience in model monitoring, model validation, credit risk analytics, or model risk management within financial services
* Demonstrated knowledge of Decision Models, Basel Capital Models, IF/Provisioning Models, and associated regulatory expectations
* Proficiency in Python, SAS, R, SQL, and large-scale data analysis
* Solid understanding of Machine Learning (ML) techniques and emerging Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications in risk management, with practical experience preferred
* Strong understanding of credit risk portfolios and banking products, including mortgages, personal lending, credit cards, unsecured lending, SME, commercial, and institutional products
* Experience assessing model performance metrics, stability measures, calibration, discrimination, segmentation, and monitoring frameworks
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex analytical findings into business insights and recommendations
* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop teams within a collaborative and diverse environment

You re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we d love to hear from you.

**1. Role Overview**

The Primary Resource Person will be responsible for developing, reviewing, and implementing a structured, child-centric, and competency-based curriculum for Grades 15 across the school network.

The role involves academic content development, lesson planning, teacher training, assessment design, and monitoring classroom implementation to ensure consistent academic standards across branches.

The candidate should possess strong subject knowledge, pedagogical expertise, and the ability to translate curriculum objectives into effective teaching-learning practices aligned with CBSE guidelines, NEP 2020, and the National Curriculum Framework (NCF).

* Design structured lesson plans, teaching-learning materials, worksheets, activity modules, and classroom resources.
* Ensure curriculum alignment with CBSE guidelines, NEP 2020, NCF, and competency-based learning objectives.

jobs.title: Payer
jobs.description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for professionals with experience in **healthcare payer operations, transformation, technology, and analytics** to support payer modernization initiatives. The role will focus on improving operational effectiveness, redesigning workflows and operating models, leveraging data and analytics, and supporting technology-enabled transformation across payer functions.

Candidates may specialize in one or more of the following capability areas:

* Healthcare Back Office Transformation
* Healthcare Middle Office Transformation
* Payer Analytics & Data Strategy

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support strategic, operational, and technology-led transformation initiatives across healthcare payer organizations.
* Assess existing processes and develop **process maps, workflow assessments, operating models, and improvement recommendations**.
* Conduct benchmarking, workforce assessments, research, and cost-benefit analyses to identify improvement opportunities.
* Support transformation across payer functions such as **claims, enrollment, eligibility, billing, provider data, care management, utilization management, pharmacy/PBM, network management, payment integrity, and risk adjustment**.
* Analyze large and complex healthcare datasets to identify trends, operational issues, and actionable business insights.
* Support technology-enabled operating model transformation, including workflow redesign, system implementation, platform optimization, and process automation.
* Contribute to analytics initiatives addressing **risk adjustment, quality, utilization, care management, pharmacy performance, and payment integrity**.
* Support data governance and effective communication of analytical insights to business and operational stakeholders.
* Use **GenAI** to support research, insight development, and storyboarding where appropriate.
* Evaluate opportunities to leverage automation, AI/ML, NLP, interoperability, and data exchange to improve payer processes.

  

**Essential Knowledge & Experience**

* Understanding of healthcare payer operations and core functions.
* Experience supporting operational, strategic, technology, analytics, or transformation initiatives.
* Understanding of payer workflows such as **claims, enrollment, eligibility, billing, provider data, benefits, care management, and utilization management**.
* Familiarity with process mapping, workflow assessment, operating models, project management, or benchmarking.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to conduct independent research and translate findings into actionable insights.
* Experience working with complex datasets.
* Understanding of payer technology platforms and system-enabled process improvement.
* Ability to communicate analytical and technical insights clearly to business stakeholders.

  

**Preferred Knowledge & Experience**

* Understanding of **Medicare Advantage, Medicare Part D, Medicaid, and commercial payer models**.
* Familiarity with **risk adjustment, HCCs, Stars, HEDIS, CAHPS**, and compliance-driven payer activities.
* Understanding of **Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM)** concepts such as formulary design, utilization management, rebates, pharmacy networks, and drug-spend analytics.
* Awareness of CMS oversight, payer regulatory requirements, audits, and compliance processes.
* Understanding of value-based care and payment models.
* Experience with payer analytics use cases involving risk adjustment, quality, care management, utilization, pharmacy, or payment integrity.
* Exposure to predictive modeling, forecasting, risk scoring, or anomaly detection.
* Familiarity with healthcare interoperability, data exchange, provider data platforms, and automation concepts.
* Exposure to digital transformation and analytics programs.

  

**Technical Skills**

**Essential**

* Experience analyzing large and complex datasets.
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills.
* Ability to perform benchmarking and basic cost-benefit analysis.
* Basic proficiency in GenAI-enabled research and insight development.

  

**Preferred**

* SQL
* Python or R
* Automation tools
* AI/ML and NLP concepts
* Predictive modeling and forecasting
* Healthcare analytics and data visualization
* GenAI-based research and storyboarding

**Core Competencies**

* Strategic and structured thinking
* Strong analytical mindset
* Problem solving
* Stakeholder communication
* Independent research
* Business and technology alignment
* Data-driven decision making
* Innovation and continuous improvement
* Ability to operate effectively in transformation environments

  

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate combines **healthcare payer domain knowledge with strong analytical and transformation capabilities**. They should be comfortable understanding payer workflows, analyzing complex information and datasets, identifying improvement opportunities, and supporting technology- and data-enabled modernization initiatives.

Candidates with deeper specialization in **payer operations, Medicare/Medicaid, PBM, risk adjustment, care/utilization management, healthcare analytics, data strategy, or payer technology transformation** would be particularly relevant depending on the specific capability area.

**What You Must Have**

- Master's degree full- time  
- At least 2-4 years of experience  
- Oral and written proficiency in English required

jobs.title: Electrical Maintenance Executive - Retail Store
jobs.description:
We are Licious and we are a Bengaluru based meat and seafood company founded in 2015by Abhay Hanjura and Vivek Gupta, our founders, foodies and friends. We pride ourselves on being Indias most successful D2Cfood-tech brand operating in 20 cities across the country delighting over 32 lac customers with our de-*licious*fresh meat and seafood!

Think you have what it takes to be the **magic ingredient** in the recipe that is Licious? Read on

  

**What makes the role meaty?**

To ensure smooth and uninterrupted maintenance operations across Licious offline retail stores by managing preventive and breakdown maintenance, vendor coordination, infrastructure upkeep, equipment reliability and statutory safety compliance.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Store Maintenance & Operations**

* Manage day-to-day maintenance activities across 8–10 offline retail stores.
* Ensure the availability and proper functioning of refrigeration equipment, display chillers, deep freezers, HVAC, exhaust systems, electrical panels, UPS, RO systems and other store utilities.
* Handle breakdowns and ensure timely resolution to minimise business disruption.
* Conduct regular store visits and maintenance audits to identify and resolve infrastructure issues.

**B. Preventive & Breakdown Maintenance**

* Develop and execute preventive maintenance schedules for all store equipment.
* Monitor equipment performance and maintain service history.
* Ensure timely closure of maintenance complaints within defined TAT and SLA.
* Identify recurring equipment failures and implement permanent corrective actions.

**C. Vendor & AMC Management**

* Coordinate with service providers and contractors for maintenance activities.
* Manage AMC, repair quotations, vendor performance and service quality.
* Ensure cost-effective maintenance without compromising equipment reliability.
* Verify vendor bills and validate completed maintenance work before processing payments.

**D. Safety & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with electrical safety, fire safety and other statutory requirements.
* Conduct regular safety inspections and maintain audit documentation.
* Ensure proper upkeep of electrical installations, fire extinguishers, emergency lighting and safety equipment.

**E. Cost & Performance Management**

* Monitor store-wise maintenance expenditure and control R&M costs.
* Identify opportunities for energy savings and equipment optimisation.
* Maintain maintenance MIS, breakdown reports, PM compliance and expenditure tracking.
* Drive continuous improvement through 5S, Kaizen and root cause analysis.

  
  

**We hope that you have..**

  

* Diploma / Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
* 5–8 years of experience in maintenance and facilities management.
* Experience in retail stores, supermarkets, QSR or food industry preferred.
* Good knowledge of refrigeration, display chillers, deep freezers, HVAC and electrical systems.
* Strong vendor management, troubleshooting and coordination skills.
* Knowledge of CMMS, preventive maintenance and maintenance MIS.
* Good communication and reporting skills.
* Must be willing to travel extensively within the city to manage multiple outlets.
* Preventive maintenance compliance: 95% or above.
* Maintenance complaint closure within defined TAT: 90% or above.
* Equipment uptime and business continuity.
* Reduction in recurring breakdowns.
* Maintenance expenditure within approved budget.
* Vendor SLA and AMC compliance.
* Timely completion of store maintenance audits.
* Improvement in energy efficiency and maintenance cost savings.

jobs.title: Manager - Product Management

jobs.description:
Job Purpose

To drive sustainable and profitable growth of the assigned product portfolio through market-led portfolio strategy, customer

insight, product development, lifecycle management, pricing, go-to-market execution, and cross-functional collaboration.

The role is responsible for identifying market opportunities and portfolio gaps, developing differentiated customer value

propositions, building product roadmaps, managing new product development and launches, improving portfolio

profitability, and ensuring products remain competitive and relevant throughout their lifecycle.

Collaborate with Sales, R&D, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Marketing, Procurement, Legal, Service, and

other relevant stakeholders to translate customer and business requirements into commercially successful products and

solutions.

  

3. Key Business Dimensions

- Revenue, volume, growth, market share, and profitability of the assigned portfolio.

- Number of categories, subcategories, products, variants, and SKUs managed.

- New Product Development pipeline, annual launch plan, cycle time, and launch performance.

- Revenue and margin contribution from new, strategic, differentiated, or premium products.

- Pricing, realisation, product mix, cost optimisation, and value-engineering impact.

- Geographic, channel, customer, distributor, dealer, retailer, and influencer coverage, as applicable.

- Product availability, inventory health, service levels, quality, complaints, and customer adoption.

- Product development, research, communication, training, and market-development budgets.

- Portfolio rationalisation, SKU productivity, and product master-data accuracy.

  

4. Key Result Areas and Accountabilities

A. Product and Portfolio Strategy

- Develop and execute the strategic plan for the assigned portfolio in alignment with business objectives.

- Define the role of each category, product family, product, and SKU within the portfolio.

- Identify growth opportunities across segments, applications, channels, price points, and geographies.

- Develop short- and long-term product roadmaps based on market potential, customer needs, technology trends, and business

priorities.

- Conduct portfolio gap analysis and recommend new products, variants, specifications, pack sizes, solutions, or services.

- Prioritise initiatives based on market attractiveness, competitive strength, profitability, strategic fit, and organisational

capability.

- Drive portfolio mix improvement and support annual operating, category, and long-range plans.

  

B. Market, Industry and Competitive Intelligence

- Monitor macroeconomic, regulatory, technology, customer, channel, and industry trends affecting the portfolio.

- Track market size, growth, segmentation, applications, price bands, channel dynamics, and competitive intensity.

- Build structured market-intelligence mechanisms through field inputs, research, channel partners, customers, exhibitions, and

secondary sources.

- Benchmark competitor range, specifications, features, quality, pricing, positioning, distribution, communication, service, and

launches.

- Convert market and competitive intelligence into implications for portfolio, pricing, development, and go-to-market decisions.

- Maintain competitive comparison tools and identify emerging categories, substitutes, adjacent opportunities, and disruptive

technologies.

  

C. Customer and Consumer Insights

- Develop a deep understanding of customer, consumer, channel, influencer, installer, applicator, and end-user needs, as

applicable.

- Create customer personas and segment customers by needs, applications, behaviour, value expectations, and purchase

drivers.

- Map customer journeys, pain points, barriers, expectations, interaction points, and moments of truth.

- Gather Voice of Customer through visits, interviews, focus groups, surveys, complaint analysis, feedback, and usage

observation.

- Plan qualitative and quantitative research and translate insights into requirements, propositions, experience improvements,

and communication priorities.

- Validate concepts, prototypes, features, packaging, pricing, and communication before commercial launch.

  

D. Product Roadmap and New Product Development

- Develop and maintain a prioritised product roadmap aligned with customer needs, market opportunities, strategy, and

technical feasibility.

- Define product concepts, applications, target segments, technical requirements, expected benefits, target price, volume

potential, and commercial expectations.

- Create product briefs and Product Requirement Documents with relevant stakeholders.

- Lead cross-functional development projects from concept through commercialisation using a defined stage-gate process.

- Track milestones, risks, dependencies, costs, trials, validations, certifications, and launch readiness.

- Facilitate prototype evaluation, technical validation, customer trials, pilots, and market testing.

- Conduct post-launch reviews and maintain a balanced innovation pipeline.

  

E. Product Lifecycle and SKU Management

- Manage products across introduction, growth, maturity, and decline stages.

- Define lifecycle-specific pricing, positioning, distribution, communication, promotion, and investment strategies.

- Review product and SKU performance using revenue, volume, growth, margin, availability, inventory, and strategic relevance.

- Identify slow-moving, obsolete, duplicate, low-margin, or low-potential SKUs and lead rationalisation, replacement, migration,

or phase-out plans.

- Ensure smooth transition from legacy products and maintain accurate portfolio, lifecycle, and product-master information.

- Recommend upgrades, extensions, repositioning, cost optimisation, or withdrawal based on performance.

  

F. Business Case and Commercial Viability

- Prepare business cases for new products, upgrades, localisation, capacity, portfolio extensions, and strategic investments.

- Estimate addressable opportunity, volume, revenue, price, margin, investment, payback, and key assumptions.

- Evaluate scenario sensitivity to price, volume, cost, investment, and market adoption.

- Assess technical feasibility, operational readiness, supply-chain implications, and commercial risks.

- Conduct post-launch reviews against approved assumptions and recommend acceleration, correction, continuation, or

closure.

  

G. Pricing and Profitability Management

- Develop pricing recommendations based on customer value, competitive benchmarks, cost, positioning, willingness to pay,

and business objectives.

- Track market prices, competitor movements, discounts, schemes, channel margins, and price architecture.

- Evaluate premium, penetration, competitive, cost-plus, value-based, bundle, and promotional pricing approaches.

- Assess price-change impact on volume, revenue, margin, mix, and competitiveness and conduct price-volume-mix analysis.

- Identify opportunities for price correction, premiumisation, cost reduction, and margin improvement.

- Coordinate approved price changes and maintain product pricing and profitability dashboards.

  

H. Value Engineering and Cost Optimisation

- Build a pipeline of value-engineering and cost-optimisation opportunities without compromising customer value, quality,

safety, or performance.

- Evaluate alternative materials, specifications, processes, designs, vendors, and packaging with cross-functional teams.

- Prioritise opportunities based on savings, complexity, customer impact, and technical risk.

- Ensure robust testing, validation, approvals, and change management and track realised savings.

  

I. Customer Value Proposition and Positioning

- Develop differentiated value propositions defining the target customer, problem, benefits, reasons to believe, and

differentiation from alternatives.

- Quantify customer value through performance, productivity, convenience, durability, safety, savings,

At MPS, we cultivate creativity, are passionate about sustainability, and are committed to providing leading-edge products and innovation to our customers. This is a customer application engineer position, based in Bangalore and reporting to the Automotive Product Line. The candidate will be working on automotive applications at Tier1 and OEM customers in India, across ADAS, infotainment/IVI, power distribution and lighting.

  

The candidate will be supporting the local FAE and sales teams, understanding the customers needs and requirements, planning action items, communicating with MPS internal departments, and driving actions to meet customer requirements and deliver the best solution.

jobs.description:
**Location:**
Delhi / Bangalore

**Work Model:**
Hybrid — 3 days in office

**About Elucidata**

Elucidata is a Tech Data-centric AI company on a mission to make life sciences AI-ready. Headquartered in San Francisco with a 120+ member team across the US and India, we’re building the future of data-centric AI for drug discovery.

Our flagship AI-Agentic powered platform, Polly, helps research teams wrangle, harmonize, and analyze massive volumes of biomedical data, accelerating discoveries and making precision medicine a reality.

Recognized by Fast Company as the “Most Innovative Biotech Company of 2024,” Elucidata partners with 25+ leading organizations, including Pfizer, Novo Nordisk, Google DeepMind, Alnylam Therapeutics, and the Bill & Melinda Gates Research Institute. Backed by top VCs like Eight Roads, F-Prime, IvyCap, and Hyperplane.

With over 200 data products and AI solutions co-developed by 100+ domain experts, we’ve helped our partners achieve 4X faster R&D milestones and contribute to 16 therapies advancing toward FDA approval. At Elucidata, you’ll work at the intersection of AI, biology and impact while solving real-world challenges that accelerate the journey from data to discovery.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Senior ML Scientist to drive research and development at the intersection of AI and biology, with a focus on solving complex problems in biomedical research and drug discovery.

In this role, you will own the development, training, and evaluation of advanced ML models, including LLMs, deep learning models, and biological foundation models, working with diverse data sources such as scientific literature, clinical data, and multi-omics datasets.

You will collaborate closely with computational biologists, ML engineers, and product teams to translate scientific challenges into innovative, practical AI solutions, while driving rigorous experimentation, scientific validation, and research outcomes.

**What You’ll Own**

* Lead research and development initiatives at the intersection of AI and biology, translating complex scientific problems into well-defined ML problems and actionable solutions.
* Develop, fine-tune, and evaluate ML models, including LLMs, transformer-based models, and biological foundation models, for applications in drug discovery and biomedical research.
* Build AI-driven solutions for extracting and synthesizing biological knowledge from scientific literature, clinical data, and other biomedical sources.
* Explore and develop novel approaches for analyzing complex biological datasets, including single-cell, spatial transcriptomics, and multi-omics data.
* Design rigorous experiments, establish evaluation benchmarks, and ensure scientific validity, reproducibility, and robustness of model outputs.
* Own research projects end-to-end, from literature reviews and hypothesis formulation to experimentation, validation, and communicating findings through technical reports, publications, or product capabilities.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* PhD from a Tier-1 institution in Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Computer Science, or a related field; alternatively, a Master’s degree with 3–4 years of relevant post-master’s industry experience applying AI/ML to biological problems.
* Strong understanding of molecular biology, genetics, genomics, or related areas, with the ability to interpret biological data and reason about underlying biological mechanisms.
* Hands-on experience developing and training ML/deep learning models, preferably applied to biomedical NLP, genomics, multi-omics, or drug discovery.
* Excellent Python programming skills, with practical experience in PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, and modern data science and ML libraries.
* Strong scientific research skills, including reading and critically evaluating research papers, designing experiments, benchmarking methods, and drawing evidence-based conclusions.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, tackle ambiguous research problems, challenge assumptions, and translate research findings into practical, high-impact solutions.

**Why Join Elucidata?**

* Opportunity to shape the future of biomedical data ecosystems by building partnerships at the frontier of science and healthcare.
* Direct visibility with the CEO and leadership team.
* High-impact role — the partnerships you establish will directly translate into Elucidata’s growth and customer success.
* Work with global leaders and contribute to data-driven drug discovery.

jobs.title: Principal Scientist - Molecular Biology and Protein Biochemistry
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!
  
  
Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.
  
  
**Position Overview**
A dedicated Molecular Biology and Protein Biochemistry scientist is required to establish and grow Bangalore’s in-house capabilities in cell-based assays and protein analysis. The role will support current Biochemistry R&D projects and help develop workflows for future projects and product opportunities.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong experimental execution and troubleshooting skills with an innovative, business-oriented mindset. In addition to building robust laboratory workflows, the scientist will identify opportunities for new biochemistry projects and catalogue additions, explore market needs, investigate underperforming portfolio areas, and engage with customers and potential collaborators.
  
  
**Role purpose**
Establish and support in-house molecular biology, cell-based assay, and protein analysis capabilities within Bangalore Biochemistry R&D. Execute and troubleshoot workflows involving mammalian cell culture, protein extraction, GST-based assay support, SDS-PAGE, Western blotting, protein quantification, chemiluminescent detection, and application or product validation.
  
  
In partnership with cross-functional and global teams, translate scientific and customer needs into new project proposals, product and catalogue opportunities, and practical application data. Contribute to market and portfolio assessments, including investigation of low-selling products and recommendations for improvement, repositioning, or future development.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Establish, execute, and continuously improve molecular biology and protein biochemistry workflows for Biochemistry R&D projects.
* Perform mammalian cell-based experiments, including cell handling, treatment planning, harvesting, and lysate preparation.
* Extract proteins using appropriate lysis buffers, protease and phosphatase inhibitors, and sample-stabilization conditions.
* Perform BCA or equivalent protein quantification assays and normalize samples for downstream analysis.
* Execute SDS-PAGE, protein transfer to PVDF membranes, Ponceau staining, Western blotting, antibody incubation, washing, and chemiluminescent detection.
* Support GST-based experimental workflows, including protein–probe interaction studies, control planning, and data interpretation.
* Optimize and troubleshoot protein-analysis workflows, addressing weak signal, high background, poor transfer, protein degradation, and inconsistent sample loading.
* Maintain accurate experimental records, raw data, image files, calculations, and technical reports.
* Draft and maintain SOPs, work instructions, and technical documentation for cell biology and protein-analysis workflows.
* Propose new biochemistry projects and catalogue additions based on scientific developments, customer needs, application opportunities, and market research.
* Conduct or coordinate market and portfolio assessments; investigate low-selling products to understand potential technical, application, positioning, or customer-related factors and recommend appropriate next steps.
* Engage with customers to understand their workflows and challenges, discuss application needs, and support technical data generation and product validation.
* Identify and develop potential collaborations with internal teams, external researchers, customers, or other relevant partners.
* Support product and application validation, proof-of-concept studies, customer-facing technical data generation, and internal capability development.
* Coordinate with global R&D, application, product management, quality, EHS, and manufacturing teams as needed.
* Manage critical reagents, including antibodies, buffers, gels, membranes, protein ladders, cell-culture consumables, and assay reagents.
* Ensure compliance with laboratory safety, biological sample handling, chemical hygiene, and documentation requirements.
* Travel as required to support customer engagement, collaboration, project work, or business needs.

**Required Qualifications**

* Ph.D. in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Cell Biology, or a related discipline.
* Preferably 6-10 years of relevant experience in industry or application-driven R&D.

**Required Technical Skills And Experience**

* Mammalian cell culture and cell-based assays, including treatment planning, harvesting, and lysate preparation.
* Protein extraction, sample stabilization, and BCA, Bradford, or equivalent protein quantification.
* SDS-PAGE, PVDF or nitrocellulose transfer, Ponceau staining, Western blotting, antibody optimization, and chemiluminescent imaging.
* Experimental design using appropriate positive, negative, no-light, no-treatment, and competitor controls.
* Strong knowledge of protein chemistry, molecular biology, and biochemical assay principles.
* Troubleshooting protein degradation, weak signal, non-specific bands, high background, uneven transfer, and loading variation.
* Preferred: probe-based assays or photo-affinity labelling; GST workflows; recombinant protein expression and purification; LC-MS, HPLC, or other orthogonal characterization; product or application development; GLP-like documentation and R&D quality systems.

**Behavioural and functional competencies**

* Innovative mindset with the ability to spot scientific, application, and business opportunities.
* Strong experimental planning and troubleshooting mindset, with the ability to guide and train scientific and technical staff and contribute to project planning.
* Good documentation discipline and awareness of data integrity.
* Ability to work independently in a newly developing capability area.
* Cross-functional communication with chemistry, biology, application, product, and commercial teams.
* Scientific curiosity and the ability to translate protocols into robust, reproducible workflows.
* Customer-oriented approach and openness to engaging with customers and collaborators.
* Ability to assess market feedback and portfolio performance and turn findings into actionable proposals.
* Safety-conscious laboratory working style.
* Ability to train junior scientists or technical staff as the capability expands.

**What we offer:**
We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!
  
  
Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

**ABOUT US**

As a leading provider of high-quality food and beverage ingredients, we work with farming communities across the globe to grow, source and produce ingredients that are good for consumers, farmers, and the world around us. We supply household food brands and manufacturers worldwide with cocoa, coffee, dairy, nuts and spices ingredients which are often grown on our own farms and estates and sourced from hundreds of thousands of farmers across ~50 countries. Along with our diverse manufacturing and innovation capabilities, this means we can provide ingredients for a range of products, from a plant-based latte mix to an almond-based snack bar or a dairy-free ice cream. Making a positive impact on people and planet is a core component of our Purpose, to be the change for good food and a healthy future. With a deep-rooted presence in the countries where our ingredients are grown, we are closer to farmers, enabling better quality, and more reliable, traceable, and transparent supply. And whoever we’re with, whatever we’re doing, we always make it real.

**JOB IN SUMMARY**

The Regional Food Safety Microbiologist for Asia Pacific will provide advanced scientific leadership and technical expertise in food microbiology, microbiological risk management, environmental monitoring, validation science and food safety systems.

The role will support the implementation of global food safety strategies and initiatives across Asia Pacific while ensuring effective deployment of microbiological control programs, environmental monitoring systems, validation programs and risk management practices. The position will support ofi's Zero Incident Mindset through the application of sound science, robust risk assessments and continuous improvement of food safety controls.

As part of the Global Food Safety COE, the role will work closely with regional Quality & Food Safety teams, site leadership, Operations, Engineering and global food safety experts to drive harmonization, capability building and consistent application of food safety standards across all product platforms.

* Support implementation of global food safety strategies, standards and initiatives across all Asia Pacific sites.
* Drive alignment and harmonization of microbiological risk management programs across regions.
* Support continuous improvement of global food safety standards and governance processes.
* Participate in global communities of practice and technical working groups.

* Ensure effective documentation and governance of validation programs.

**Incident Management & Root Cause Analysis**

* Support root cause investigations and development of corrective and preventive actions.
* Review regional microbiological trends and identify recurring issues requiring systematic improvement.
* Provide guidance during product disposition decisions and crisis management activities.

**Capability Building & Training**

* Develop and deliver advanced food microbiology and food safety training programs.
* Build microbiological capability across regional and site Quality & Food Safety teams.
* Coach and mentor food safety professionals across the region.
* Support development of technical competency frameworks for food safety and microbiology disciplines.
* Drive knowledge sharing through communities of practice and technical forums.

India's leading Fresh produce (Fruits and Vegetables) agritech platform, Ninjacart (founded 2015) is revolutionising the $400B+ agri supply chain with tech-driven commerce, finance, and Supply chain solutions. We've served 200,000+ farmers and 60,000+ retailers & and 5000+ Traders. Over the last 10 years, our made-for-India technology and India-centric solutions have revolutionised the way fruits and vegetables reach consumers’ plates from farms daily. * LLB / LLM from a recognized university.

jobs.title: Statutory Accountant [T500-31075]
jobs.description:
**About ADM:**

We are one of the world’s largest nutrition companies and a global leader in human and animal nutrition. We unlock the power of nature to provide nourishing quality of life by transforming crops into ingredients and solutions for foods, beverages, supplements, livestock, aquaculture, and pets.

**About ADM India Hub:**

At ADM, we have long recognized the strength and potential of India’s talent pool, which is why we have maintained a presence in the country for more than 25 years. Building on this foundation, we have now established ADM India Hub, our first GCC in India.

At ADM India Hub, we are hiring for IT and finance roles across diverse technology and business functions. We stand at the intersection of global expertise and local excellence, enabling us to drive innovation and support our larger purpose of unlocking the power of nature to enrich quality of life.

**Job Title:**
Statutory Accountant

**Type/ Location:**
Full time,
Bangalore, India

**About ADM**
:

At ADM, we unlock the power of nature to provide access to nutrition worldwide. With industry-advancing innovations, a complete portfolio of ingredients and solutions to meet any taste, and a commitment to sustainability, we give customers an edge in solving the nutritional challenges of today and tomorrow. We’re a global leader in human and animal nutrition and the world’s premier agricultural origination and processing company. Our breadth, depth, insights, facilities and logistical expertise give us unparalleled capabilities to meet needs for food, beverages, health and wellness, and more. From the seed of the idea to the outcome of the solution, we enrich the quality of life the world over.

**The Role:**

The Statutory Reporting team is responsible for the preparation and audit of financial statements of over 150 of ADM subsidiaries, worldwide.

Statutory Reporting is part of the Corporate Finance department of ADM and is responsible for the completeness and correctness of ADM’s accounting and external financial reporting under Local GAAP and/or International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS).

In this position, you will not only prepare financial statements, but also leverage your expertise in IFRS, local GAAPs, and technical accounting to manage financial reporting for multiple entities. You will also engage in cross-functional projects, contribute to automation initiatives, and gain exposure to high-impact areas.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Prepare Financial Statements:**
  Support the preparation of financial statements under IFRS and other GAAPs of ADM subsidiaries, ensuring accurate identification and adjustment of differences between USGAAP and IFRS/local GAAPs.
* **Local Regulatory Compliance:**
  To Support tax, company secretary and other regulatory compliance activities.
* **Collaboration:**
  Work closely with external and internal stakeholders including Tax, Treasury, and Controlling, providing exposure to diverse areas of financial management.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Support the automation and standardization of financial statement preparation, in accordance with ADM's strategy to streamline processes, improve efficiency and ensure accuracy and compliance.
* **Tackle Complexity:**
  Dive into complex topics like hyperinflation accounting, business combinations under common control and consolidation, providing expertise and solutions.
* **Technical Analysis:**
  Assisting with research and prepare technical memorandums to address scenarios to support the rationale and accounting treatment for relevant topics.

**Role Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in related field such as Finance, Accounting or Auditing is preferred
* Qualified/Semi-qualified accountant (CA, CPA, ACCA) with at least 3 to 5 years of experience in preparing and/ or auditing financial statements.
* Big 4 company experience is a plus
* Deep professional experience including application of IFRS accounting - any other GAAP is a plus.
* Able to articulate financial positions with excellent communication skills.
* Assertive and able to work both independently and within a global team.
* Fluent in spoken and written English is a must (other languages being a plus).
* Excellent in MS Excel, knowledge of accounting-related functionalities in an ERP System preferred.

jobs.title: Supplier Quality Auditor
jobs.description:
Join us and celebrate the beauty of human experience. Create for happier, healthier lives, with love for nature. Together, with kindness, humility, and a spirit of adventure, we deliver food innovations, craft inspired fragrances and develop beauty and wellbeing solutions. There’s much to learn from our 79 production sites worldwide, known for their best-in-class processes and procedures. There’s many to learn from, with high-performing leaders and caring colleagues to explore ideas and ambitions with. Every day, your energy, your personality, and your determination will shape our future, making a positive difference on billions of people. Every essence of you enriches our world. We are Givaudan. Human by nature.
  
  
**Supplier Quality Auditor - Your future position?**
As the
**Supplier Quality Auditor**
with Givaudan, you will in relation to the overall objective of the function to assure raw material quality is guaranteed at source so that products comply with all applicable quality, product safety and customer requirements you will work with limited supervision supporting the execution of the Global Supplier Quality Management Strategy.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**

* Ensure Quality Management System documentation is generated, maintained, stored and archived in compliance with company internal Procedures.
* Responsible for the on-going collection of Supplier Qualification metrics and reporting monthly and quarterly progress reports e.g. Vendor audits and CAPA status, High Risk Vendors, New Ingredient Introduction (NII), Alternate Vendor Approval Process progress (AVAP), Quality Info Records (QIR), versus agreed targets.
* Responsible for the monthly reporting of Z1 non-conformance data (material complaints), showing the trends and high-risk materials/vendors versus targets.
* Responsible for quarterly reporting of incomplete Z1 non-conformance data (material complaints) to identify compliance.
* Responsible for quarterly reporting of the stock re-inspection process to show compliance
* Make visible KPI's, risks and compliance violations with dynamic risk matrix (Power BI)
* Personally complete approximately 20 on-site/virtual audits plus complete all F&B paper audits
* Liaise with Lead auditors to facilitate the follow-up of Vendor audit tasks, closure of audit actions to agreed timescales and audit document filing as needed
* Complete and Monitor Supplier Quality Specialist steps for qualification activities e.g. AVAP and NII, within the agreed lead-time
* Complete Vendor Quality Approval for Legacy QIR Creation Compliance and prepare the QIR Creation Report quarterly to manage compliance
* Monitor and Maintain material risk assessments and gaps
* Lead the reduction in the number of materials missing an ingredient risk class
* Deliver classroom training to auditors in vendor audit principles and processes to plan, perform, lead and follow up vendor audits
* Lead vendor improvement projects
* Lead the cleansing of procurement data to close gaps
* Support the Supplier Quality Specialist in follow up and completion of Z1 non-conformance notifications

**You?**
**Are you someone who wants to grow and shape your own world? Who needs a new challenge and bring excellent contribution to the company? Then come and join us - and impact your world.**
**Your Professional Profile Includes**
**Academic Background**

* Vocational Diploma in an appropriate technical field.
* University degree preferred
* Local language with English as an additional language preferred

**Professional Experience**

* Overall work experience of 3+ years.
* 1 to 2 years of auditing experience preferred.
* CI Green Belt level and problem solving

**Technical Skills**

* Can demonstrate an ability to influence change, form effective relationships and drive continuous improvement.
* Good understanding of the principles and application of Quality Management Systems e.g. ISO 9001, Good Manufacturing Practices e.g. EFfCI and continuous improvement.
* Good knowledge of business processes in Operations, and requirements for manufacturing, quality control testing and distribution facilities.
* Experience with using computer-based Management Systems and applications such as Microsoft Office.

**Personal Competencies**

* Demonstrates self-awareness
* Drives results
* Decision quality
* Nimble learning
* Customer focus
* Courage

At Givaudan, you contribute to delightful taste and scent experiences that touch people’s lives.
  
  
We value the different perspectives that come from diverse cultures, backgrounds, and experiences.
  
  
Everyone — regardless of race, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, culture, religion, or any personal circumstances — is warmly welcomed at Givaudan, a place where we all love to be and grow.
  
  
Every essence of you enriches our world. Join us in making a difference together.

As part of the Group Privacy Team and as a Data Privacy Assurance Executive, I support the business to assess its data privacycompliance position by testing, validating and reporting on a range of data privacy controls
  
**You will be responsible for**
Following our Business Code of Conduct and always acting with integrity and due diligence and have these specific risk responsibilities:Test (across the group) a range of data privacy controls. These controls have been established to ensure our business is operating incompliance with privacy laws (mainly GDPR). It is vital therefore Tesco's senior management understands whether the controls are inplace and effective, or not.- Regularly test and report on our 3 pillars of controls: Blueprint Controls, Operational Controls and Data Standards.-As part of my role, I am accountable for validating and challenging testing evidence submitted by stakeholders. Escalating whereneeded.- Overseeing stakeholders and building their engagement with the privacy assurance process.- Working with stakeholders to develop and implement remediation plans where testing reveals ineffective controls.- Delivering privacy assurance "deep dives" - targeting specific business units or functional areas for more thorough review of theirprivacy practices.- Over time the assurance will expand from purely data privacy testing to other compliance areas.- Understands business needs and in depth understanding of Tesco processes- Builds on Tesco processes and knowledge by applying CI tools and techniques.- Responsible for completing tasks and transactions within agreed KPI's- Solves problems by analyzing solution alternatives
