jobs.title: Associate Director, Financial Services Compliance
jobs.description:
PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:
  
  
At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
  
  
**Job Description**
About PhonePe Ethics & Compliance Team
  
  
The PhonePe Ethics and Compliance team plays a critical role in the successful execution of the firm's ethical and compliance mission. The Payments Compliance function at PhonePe ensures the development and maintenance of a strong compliance culture within the company by developing and maintaining program infrastructure that identifies, measures, and monitors compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and rules governing our business. Compliance teams work closely with Business, Product, Legal, Tech, Risk, and Audit functions to provide expertise on regulatory compliance matters, assess and measure compliance risks, and monitor and test the adequacy of the firm's compliance environment.
  
  
Lines of Business Relevant to This Role
  
  
Merchant Solutions
  
  
PhonePe offers a comprehensive suite of solutions for its 37 million merchant partners to enable end-to-end control over their entire payment process, including transaction confirmation and reconciliation:
  
  

* SmartSpeakers: Provides instant voice payment alerts in noisy environments alongside host operational features.
* PhonePe Payment Gateway (PG): Delivers best-in-class online payment experiences to consumers and digital merchants.
* Point-of-Sale (POS) Devices: Empowers offline merchants to effortlessly accept payments via Debit Cards, Credit Cards, and UPI with seamless settlement processes.

Payments
  
  
PhonePe enables users to send and receive money, recharge mobile, FASTag, & DTH, make bill payments (electricity, credit card bills, rent payments, LPG), make donations, and pay for purchases at stores. Users can also pay for financial services such as loan repayments and tax payments.
  
  

* Core Payment Products: Prepaid Payment Instruments (Wallet & EGVs), Unified Payments Interface (UPI), and Bharat Bill Pay Operating Unit (BBPOU).

Culture & Challenges at PhonePe
  
  
At PhonePe, we empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. Building for scale, rapid iterative development, and customer-centric product thinking define every single day. While we engineer for a 500M+ user base with speed, we care utmost for security, stability, regulatory compliance, and automation. If you enjoy building technology that impacts millions and working alongside best-in-class minds with purpose, PhonePe is the right place for you.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic compliance leader for the position of Associate Director – Payments Compliance. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in regulatory frameworks applicable to Payment System Operators, Payment Aggregators (PA), Prepaid Payment Instruments (PPI), Unified Payments Interface (UPI), Bharat Bill Payment System (BBPS), and broader fintech and banking regulations.
  
  
This leadership role requires a proven track record in leading RBI regulatory inspections, managing end-to-end audit preparedness, establishing robust regulatory change management frameworks, and overseeing compliance sign-offs across complex payment products. The candidate will serve as a trusted regulatory advisor to senior leadership, driving a proactive compliance posture across the PhonePe ecosystem.
  
  
Key Roles & Responsibilities
  
  

* Regulatory Inspection & Audit Leadership:

+ Lead and manage all regulatory inspections and audits conducted by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), and other regulatory bodies.
+ Direct data validation, response preparation, and submission of clarifications to regulatory queries, ensuring audit preparedness across all operational and technology processes.
+ Track, remediate, and close out inspection observations and audit findings in coordination with executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

* Domain Regulatory Expertise (PA, PPI, BBPS,UPI):

+ Subject Matter Expertise in RBI Master Directions and guidelines governing Payment Aggregators (MD-PA), Prepaid Payment Instruments (MD-PPI), Master Direction on KYC (MD-CB KYC), MD-BBPS, as well as NPCI and NBBL guidelines for UPI and BBPS.
+ Provide strategic regulatory interpretation and guidance on evolving rules for merchant onboarding, escrow account operations, payment settlement, recurring mandates, and cross-border payment flows.

* Regulatory Change Management (RCM) & Governance:

+ Drive the enterprise-wide Regulatory Change Management framework to track, evaluate, disseminate, and implement circulars, notifications, and directives issued by RBI, NPCI, MeitY, and other statutory authorities.
+ Establish robust control mapping, maintain compliance risk registers, and ensure satisfactory evidence of compliance is documented and archived for regulatory review.

+ Direct the compliance evaluation and risk assessment (NPRA) for all new payment products, features, and strategic business initiatives on the PhonePe platform.
+ Enforce a strict "zero go-live without compliance sign-off" policy by embedding compliance requirements early into the product development lifecycle.

* Policy Formulation & Governance Standards:

+ Lead the creation, review, and periodic updating of non-IT compliance policies, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and operational frameworks across payment business units.
+ Secure necessary approvals from the Risk & Compliance Leadership, Executive Committees, and Board of Directors in a timely manner.

+ Oversee the timely and accurate validation and filing of mandatory periodic returns, compliance reports, and data submissions to RBI, NPCI, and other authorities.
+ Maintain oversight of key compliance metrics; present comprehensive monthly Compliance Dashboards and risk trackers to senior management and governance forums.

* Stakeholder Engagement & Regulatory Relations:

+ Serve as a primary point of contact and liaison with regulatory authorities, industry bodies (e.g., NPCI, RBI), and partner banks.
+ Collaborate closely with internal Legal, Business, Product, Tech Risk, and Internal Audit teams to align strategic objectives with regulatory expectations.

jobs.title: Manager, Global Regulatory Affairs CMC & Devices
Compliance Manager
jobs.description:
**About Olyv**
Olyv (formerly SmartCoin) is an AI-powered fintech platform focused on making financial services more accessible and inclusive. Through digital lending, digital gold savings, credit health and financial wellness solutions, Olyv empowers individuals, micro-entrepreneurs and small businesses with convenient financial solutions.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a Compliance Manager to strengthen our regulatory compliance framework and support business operations across digital lending, payment services and other financial products.
  
  
The role involves interpreting regulatory requirements, advising business and support teams, managing regulatory changes and ensuring effective implementation of compliance practices across products, partnerships and operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Regulatory Change Management
* Monitor applicable RBI directions, NPCI guidelines, FIU-IND requirements and other relevant regulatory developments.
* Assess the impact of regulatory changes and coordinate with business and support functions to define implementation plans.
* Track compliance actions, responsibilities and timelines to ensure timely implementation.
* Product and Partner Advisory
* Review new products, lender partnerships, customer journeys across Olyv applications and partner platforms, including co-lending arrangements.
* Evaluate customer disclosures, marketing communications and significant process changes from a regulatory compliance perspective.
* Document compliance requirements and escalate unresolved regulatory risks before product or process launches.
* Policies and Procedures
* Draft, review and update compliance policies, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and operational checklists.
* Ensure alignment with applicable requirements relating to digital lending, BBPS, UPI, the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act), outsourcing, collections and grievance redressal.
* Regulatory Reporting and Inspections
* Maintain and monitor the regulatory obligations and compliance calendar.
* Coordinate documentation, supporting evidence and draft responses for regulatory filings, supervisory queries and inspections.
* Ensure regulatory submissions are appropriately reviewed and routed through the Chief Compliance Officer (CCO).
* Compliance Oversight and Training
* Prepare compliance updates and reports for the Board and senior management.
* Develop and conduct compliance awareness and training programmes for sales and support teams.
* Coordinate with Product, Risk, IT, Finance and Operations teams to monitor and close corrective action plans.
* Agreements and Business Arrangements
* Review business arrangements, partnership agreements and contractual documentation for regulatory compliance.
* Identify compliance gaps and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure necessary modifications and ongoing adherence to regulatory requirements.

**Candidate Profile**
**Educational Qualification**

* Qualified Company Secretary (CS).
* LL.B. qualification preferred.

**Experience**

* 3–5 years of relevant experience in an NBFC, fintech or financial services organisation.

**Technical Skills And Expertise**

* Working knowledge of RBI, FIU-IND, SEBI and NPCI regulations and guidelines applicable to NBFCs, BBPS and UPI.
* Familiarity with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act).
* Strong understanding of regulatory interpretation, compliance documentation and policy drafting.
* Ability to assess regulatory risks and translate requirements into actionable compliance measures.

**Preferred Experience**

* Exposure to consumer lending and digital lending journeys.
* Experience handling Lending Service Provider (LSP) arrangements and lender partnerships.
* Familiarity with supervisory reviews, regulatory inspections and lender-partner compliance assessments.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Strong analytical and regulatory interpretation skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Strong documentation and drafting capabilities.
* Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and drive compliance initiatives independently.
* A proactive approach towards identifying regulatory risks and ensuring timely resolution.

jobs.title: LIMS Product Specialist/Consultant
jobs.description:
About Smart Food Safe

Smart Food Safe builds software that helps food businesses and laboratories manage quality, compliance, and safety with confidence. Our LIMS platform supports labs in testing, tracking, and reporting, and we are now investing in making it faster, smarter, and more configurable. We're looking for an experienced LIMS expert to help shape that roadmap.

The Role

We're seeking a LIMS Solutions Consultant with hands-on experience implementing and configuring a variety of LIMS platforms. You will draw on your real-world knowledge of what works (and what frustrates lab users) to help us enhance, modernize, and expand our own LIMS product. You'll work closely with our product, engineering, and customer success teams, acting as the voice of the laboratory.

Key Responsibilities

* Review our current LIMS product and identify gaps, usability issues, and opportunities for improvement against leading market solutions
* Recommend and help define new features and workflow enhancements (sample login, test assignment, results entry, QA/QC, reporting, audit trails, etc.)
* Translate laboratory and regulatory requirements into clear functional specifications and user stories for the development team
* Benchmark our platform against competing LIMS software and advise on best practices
* Support the design of configurable workflows, templates, and integrations (instruments, ERP, QMS, and other third-party systems)
* Guide data migration, validation, and implementation approaches for customer deployments
* Support testing activities, including UAT planning, validation scripts, and release readiness
* Advise on compliance requirements such as ISO/IEC 17025, GLP, HACCP, FSSC 22000, 21 CFR Part 11, and data integrity (ALCOA+)
* Create documentation, training material, and implementation playbooks
* Work with customers and internal teams to gather feedback and prioritize the product roadmap

Required Qualifications

* 5+ years of experience in laboratory informatics, including hands-on LIMS implementation or consulting
* Proven experience with
  **multiple LIMS platforms**
  (e.g., LabWare, STARLIMS, LabVantage, Thermo Fisher SampleManager, Benchling, or similar)
* Experience leading or contributing to end-to-end LIMS implementations (requirements, configuration, validation, go-live, support)
* Strong understanding of laboratory workflows, preferably in food, beverage, agriculture, pharma, or environmental testing
* Working knowledge of quality and regulatory standards relevant to testing laboratories
* Ability to write clear business requirements, functional specs, and test plans
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work with both lab scientists and software engineers

jobs.title: Junior Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
**About us**

As a leading provider of high-quality food and beverage ingredients, we work with farming communities across the globe to grow, source and produce ingredients that are good for consumers, farmers, and the world around us. We supply household food brands and manufacturers worldwide with cocoa, coffee, dairy, nuts and spices ingredients which are often grown on our own farms and estates and sourced from hundreds of thousands of farmers across ~50 countries. Along with our diverse manufacturing and innovation capabilities, this means we can provide ingredients for a range of products, from a plant-based latte mix to an almond based snack bar or a dairy-free ice cream. Making a positive impact on people and planet is a core component of our Purpose, to be the change for good food and a healthy future. With a deep-rooted presence in the countries where our ingredients are grown, we are closer to farmers, enabling better quality, and more reliable, traceable, and transparent supply. And whoever we’re with, whatever we’re doing, we always make it real.

**Overview of the position**

**Description**
Do you enjoy designing and implementing solutions to ambiguous and complex problems? Are you looking to expand your scope of impact and influence strategic decision making? Are you in the market for a new, exciting challenge where you are empowered to use your ingenuity to innovate? If so, we are looking for talented people like you to join our Regulatory, Intelligence, Safety and Compliance (RISC) solution delivery team.
  
  
The RISC team's charter is to protect Amazon customers from products that are illegal, illegally marketed, unsafe, or otherwise prohibited by Amazon policies. In this role, you will work closely with legal, business teams, selling partner experience and support teams, operational excellence, product, BI and data science/engineering teams to deliver high-impact end-to-end safety and compliance solutions. Think of this role as a non-technical "solution architect" where you will be given autonomy to develop a strategy and build effective policy enforcements to ensure product safety and compliance worldwide.
  
  
The Senior Risk Manager drives the development and implementation of new tools and programs that advance the store's global safety and compliance efforts. This role requires influencing cross-functional stakeholders, planning strategic projects with legal and business partners, securing team commitments, and developing daily, weekly, and monthly metrics while ensuring compliance with Amazon quality standards and regulatory program expectations.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Drive Cross-Functional Programs: Own and deliver complex, cross-cutting initiatives by partnering with legal, business, tech, and operational excellence teams—bringing structure and momentum to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder efforts.
* Influence Without Authority: Build trusted relationships across multiple organizations; align diverse stakeholders around shared goals, secure commitments, and drive decisions forward—even when you don't own the teams doing the work.
* Build the Mechanisms That Keep Us Sharp: Design and run the operating cadences (business reviews, launch readiness checkpoints, intake processes) that ensure our safety and compliance controls launch with quality and consistency every time.
* Own the Metrics That Matter: Define, develop, and maintain the daily, weekly, and monthly performance metrics that give the team and leadership clear visibility into what's working, what's not, and where to focus next.
* Find the Friction and Fix It: Identify bottlenecks, eliminate redundant work, and drive automation opportunities that free up risk managers to focus on the high-judgment, high-impact work they do best.
* Raise the Quality Bar: Establish and maintain standards for control launches and program deliverables, ensuring every enforcement we ship meets Amazon's quality expectations and regulatory requirements.
* Turn Strategy into Action: Partner with leadership to translate business priorities and legal requirements into clear project plans with milestones, owners, dependencies, and timelines that teams can actually execute against.
* Build Tools and Frameworks That Scale: Champion the development of new tools, templates, and repeatable playbooks that accelerate the team's ability to launch safety and compliance programs worldwide.
* Write with Clarity and Purpose: Author crisp, well-structured documents—SOPs, program updates, leadership narratives—that make complex information accessible and drive informed decision-making.
* Be the Operational Backbone: Keep the trains running. Maintain visibility across workstreams, remove blockers, track commitments, and create the organizational structure that makes everyone on the team more effective at their jobs.

* 6+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience

The Global Solutions Risk and Compliance (GSRC) team ensures that Amazon transactions satisfy legal and safety requirements in accordance to the guidelines across global marketplaces. We proactively identify risks involved for Amazon while doing business in various countries and enable smooth flow of products across international borders. A Sr. Compliance Associate(DE) is responsible for protecting Amazon customers from products that are illegal, hazardous, unsafe, or otherwise prohibited /regulated by Law and Amazon policies.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As a Sr. Compliance Associate(DE), your responsibility is reviewing the latest product information as per Standard Operations Procedures (SOP) and cross-checking it against the relevant regulatory documentation. Using various Amazon-specific tools and systems you classify the products to ensure they meet the necessary compliance requirements for availability on Amazon. Throughout the day, you work closely with your manager and the Process Experts and address any deviations from standard SOPs, seeking their guidance when necessary. You maintain detailed records of your assigned tasks and utilize standardized reports to prioritize your work, ensuring you meet Quality, Productivity and Service Level Agreement targets. You may identify opportunities for improvement and collaborate with partner teams to explore ways to reduce manual effort, such as automating reports using Excel queries. As a mentor, you may support peers by answering their queries and providing process-level training.

jobs.title: Industry Technology Specialist (ITS) Technical Service: Distilling & Biofuel
jobs.description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
At Novonesis, we work in close partnership with our customers to create a better world every day. We use science and biosolutions to help industries improve performance and make better use of our planet’s resources.
  
  
Join our Grain Processing team within Planetary Health Biosolutions in Bangalore, India, where you will work alongside industry technology specialists and laboratory colleagues to support customers in the Distilling and Biofuel industry.
  
  
**The role & your impact**
As Industry Technology Specialist (ITS) – Distilling & Biofuel, you will provide technical service and expertise to customers in the grain processing, distilling, and biofuel industries.
  
  
You will lead plant trials and technical experiments, troubleshoot complex production challenges, analyze process data, and translate technical findings into practical recommendations. Through close collaboration with customers and cross-functional teams, you will help advance technical solutions and contribute to meaningful business outcomes.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities In This Role**

* Provide technical service and process expertise to grain-based ethanol and biofuel customers.
* Develop and lead experimental plans and plant trials and communicate findings and conclusions to support business development.
* Troubleshoot fermentation challenges, including stuck or sluggish fermentation, contamination, reduced ethanol yield, and yeast performance issues.
* Support optimization of grain milling, liquefaction, saccharification, fermentation, distillation, and DDGS processes.
* Optimize process parameters including temperature, pH, nutrient levels, and enzyme dosage to improve production efficiency.
* Support yeast strain selection, propagation, viability, vitality, and fermentation performance.
* Conduct root cause analyses using process data, trends, and statistical tools to address production deviations.
* Identify and help mitigate contamination through effective sterilization and CIP practices.
* Collaborate with customers and internal teams and share technical knowledge to help prevent recurring production challenges.

**What You'll Need To Be Successful In This Role**

* A Bachelor’s degree (BE/B.Tech), Master’s degree, or Ph.D. in Biotechnology, Food Technology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Chemical Engineering, Bioprocessing, or a related discipline.
* 5–10 years of professional experience in a grain-based distillery or biofuel production environment.
* Practical expertise in grain-based ethanol production processes.
* Experience with grain milling involving materials such as rice, corn, sorghum, or wheat, as well as liquefaction, saccharification, fermentation, distillation, and DDGS processes.
* Practical knowledge of yeast selection, propagation, viability, vitality, metabolism, and fermentation performance.
* Experience troubleshooting fermentation, yeast performance, contamination, and ethanol-yield challenges.
* Ability to develop and execute experimental plans and plant trials.
* Willingness and ability to travel frequently across India to provide technical services to ethanol-producing plants.

**Additional Skills & Interests We Value**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, including root cause analysis.
* Experience analyzing process and statistical data and managing technical data using Microsoft Excel or other relevant tools.
* Ability to clearly communicate technical findings and conclusions to customers and cross-functional stakeholders.
* A collaborative approach to technical problem-solving and knowledge sharing.
* A proactive approach to your work, with an interest in developing and implementing innovative technical solutions.

**What We Offer You**
You will join a collaborative technical environment where scientific expertise, innovation, and practical problem-solving come together. You will have opportunities to work closely with customers, cross-functional colleagues, and specialists while contributing to the development and application of biosolutions for the Distilling and Biofuel industry.
  
  
**Our purpose guides the way**
In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Opportunities for everyone**
We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.
  
  
We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.
  
  
**Explore Other Openings**
If this position isn’t the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You’re welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis.com/Career

jobs.title: BI Manager, KYBP, Business Partner Integrity, and Strategic Transactions
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**About the Function:**
Legal at Diageo is about more than handling risk, it’s about helping the business move forward in the right way.
  
  
Working across a global portfolio of brands, this team navigates complex legal and regulatory landscapes, from intellectual property and compliance to corporate activity and commercial partnerships. They work closely with teams across the business, offering clear, pragmatic advice that supports confident decision-making.
  
  
It’s a fast-moving, ever-evolving environment where no two challenges are the same. You’ll need sound judgement, curiosity and the ability to see the bigger picture, balancing risk with opportunity in a way that protects our business while enabling it to grow.
  
  
You’ll be part of a global community of lawyers who are not only authorities in their field, but trusted partners to the business, shaping outcomes, influencing decisions and helping bring our brands to life responsibly.
  
  
**About The Role**
Lead the operation and continuous improvement of Business Integrity’s Know Your Business Partner (KYBP) / Business Partner Integrity programme, helping ensure that integrity risks associated with third parties and other business partners are identified, assessed, mitigated and monitored through a clear, risk-based and proportionate approach aligned to the Spirit of Integrity Framework.
  
  
The role will drive transformation and process improvement across the end-to-end KYBP lifecycle, working across Business Integrity and with Procurement, Commercial, D&T and other enterprise partners to simplify and strengthen processes, improve user experience, and make effective use of data, technology and automation. As part of the wider Legal and Compliance Operations team, the role will also help find opportunities to align approaches, capabilities and ways of working across the function where relevant.
  
  
More broadly, the role will provide flexible project, analytical and operational capability across the Compliance Operations portfolio, supporting wider priorities and continuous improvement as the BI programme evolves.
  
  

* Lead the KYBP / Business Partner Integrity programme: Lead the operation and continuous improvement of the KYBP element of the Spirit of Integrity Framework, ensuring a clear, risk-based and proportionate approach to identifying, assessing, mitigating, approving and monitoring integrity risks associated with third parties and other business partners.
* Drive KYBP transformation and end-to-end process excellence: Lead transformation and improvement across the end-to-end KYBP / KYC / TPRM lifecycle, working across Procurement, Commercial, OpCoP, the TPRM Control Tower, Legal, Finance, D&T and markets to simplify processes, strengthen handoffs and accountabilities, improve user experience and embed scalable and sustainable ways of working. Work with Legal Operations and other partners where there are opportunities to demonstrate common approaches to process improvement, service delivery or transformation.
* Maintain KYBP standards, methodology and risk-based decision-making: Develop and maintain the standards, procedures, playbooks and methodology supporting KYBP, including risk segmentation, due diligence requirements, screening, red flags, issue, mitigation and ongoing monitoring. Work with relevant risk-domain SMEs to ensure appropriate coverage of bribery and corruption, sanctions, money laundering, failure to prevent fraud, facilitation of tax evasion and other relevant integrity risks.
* Strengthen data, technology, monitoring and programme effectiveness: Use data, insight and monitoring to understand the effectiveness of the KYBP programme and find opportunities for continuous improvement. Define business requirements and work with D&T, Compliance Operations and other partners to improve systems, workflows, automation and AI-enabled capabilities supporting business partner integrity. Support complex or non-standard business relationships and strategic transactions, including relevant joint venture and M&A due diligence, risk assessment, mitigation and integration requirements.
* Support delivery across the Legal and Compliance Operations portfolio: Provide flexible analytical, project and operational support across the wider Compliance Operations agenda, responding to evolving priorities and opportunities to strengthen the BI programme. This may include projects and initiatives across Speak Up and breach management, BI controls, policy governance, training and engagement, risk assessment and monitoring, data and analytics, regulatory developments, external benchmarking and other elements of the Spirit of Integrity Framework. Provide appropriate resilience and cover for key Compliance Operations activities as required. As part of the wider Legal and Compliance Operations team, give to cross-functional initiatives where relevant to the role's expertise and capabilities.

**Key Competencies**

* Business Partner Risk and Compliance Judgement: Strong understanding of third-party and business partner integrity risk, with the ability to apply risk-based and proportionate judgement across due diligence, screening, mitigation, issue and ongoing monitoring.
* Process Excellence, Technology and Continuous Improvement: Understands how processes, systems, data and controls connect, and identifies practical opportunities to simplify, standardise, automate and continuously improve end-to-end ways of working.
* Problem Solving, Delivery and Partner Management: Brings structure to complex, cross-functional problems, handles projects and priorities effectively, and works collaboratively across stakeholders to translate requirements and ideas into practical, sustainable outcomes

**Experience / Skills Required**

* Relevant experience in ethics and compliance, third-party risk management, KYC/KYBP, consulting, transformation or a related field.
* Experience in third-party or business partner compliance risk, including areas such as due diligence, bribery and corruption, sanctions, AML, fraud or other relevant integrity risks.
* Strong transformation, process improvement and project management capability, with experience delivering change across complex, cross-functional processes.
* Strong analytical and digital capability, with experience using data, technology, automation or workflow tools to improve processes and programme effectiveness; consulting or professional services experience would be helpful.

**Working with us**
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.
  
  
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:
  
  

* Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.
* We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, give and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.

Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to improve, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to give an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.
  
  
*If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you gain this information when you submit your application.*

Regular
  
  
**Primary Location:**
Bangalore Karle Town SEZ

jobs.title: Head of Finance & Accounts
jobs.description:
**Job Description: Head of Finance & Accounts**

**Company:** Hatti Food & Beverages Pvt. Ltd. (Hatti Kaapi)  
**Designation:** Head, Finance & Accounts  
**Department:** Finance & Accounts  
**Job Location:** Bengaluru  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Reporting To:** Managing Director / CEO

  

**Job Summary**

Hatti Food & Beverages Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a highly qualified, experienced, and strategic Finance Head to lead the company's Finance & Accounts function.

  

The ideal candidate should have substantial experience in the FMCG, Food & Beverage, Retail, or Manufacturing industry, with a strong understanding of financial management, business planning, accounting, taxation, statutory compliance, and commercial operations.

  

The candidate will be responsible for developing financial strategies, driving profitability, strengthening financial controls, managing working capital, ensuring regulatory compliance, and providing strategic financial insights to support business growth.

  

The role requires a hands-on finance leader with the ability to manage multi-location operations, improve financial processes, and work closely with senior management on business decisions.

  

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

  

**1. Financial Planning & Strategic Management**

* Develop and implement financial strategies aligned with the company's business objectives and growth plans.
* Lead annual budgeting, financial forecasting, and long-term financial planning.
* Monitor financial performance and provide periodic reports and recommendations to Management.
* Analyse revenue, expenditure, profitability and business performance across outlets and business units.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to support strategic business decisions.
* Evaluate new business opportunities, expansion plans, capital investments and financial feasibility.

  

**2. Financial Reporting & MIS**

* Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and management reports.
* Ensure timely preparation and presentation of Profit & Loss statements, Balance Sheets and Cash Flow statements.
* Develop and implement financial MIS, dashboards and performance tracking systems.
* Monitor outlet-wise, region-wise and business-unit-wise financial performance.
* Analyse budget versus actual performance and highlight deviations with corrective action plans.
* Ensure accuracy, transparency and timely closure of financial records.

  

**3. FMCG / Food & Beverage Commercial Finance**

* Manage financial operations in a multi-location retail, FMCG and food service environment.
* Monitor product costing, food costs, gross margins, contribution margins and operating expenses.
* Implement effective inventory valuation and stock reconciliation processes.
* Monitor raw material procurement costs, wastage, stock movement and inventory holding.
* Work closely with Procurement, Operations and Supply Chain teams to improve cost efficiency.
* Establish effective controls over outlet-level cash collections, expenses, billing and settlements.
* Monitor outlet profitability and identify opportunities for margin improvement.

  

**4. Working Capital & Treasury Management**

* Manage cash flow, fund allocation, liquidity and working capital requirements.
* Monitor accounts receivable, accounts payable, and outstanding balances.
* Ensure timely vendor payments and effective credit management.
* Develop cash flow forecasts and optimise the utilisation of financial resources.
* Maintain banking relationships and coordinate with financial institutions for funding requirements.
* Monitor fund utilisation and ensure adequate liquidity for business operations.

  

**5. Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable GST, Income Tax, TDS, TCS, and other statutory requirements.
* Oversee timely filing of statutory returns, payments and reconciliations.
* Coordinate with external auditors, tax consultants, and statutory authorities.
* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and regulatory requirements.
* Establish strong internal financial controls and ensure proper documentation.
* Monitor changes in taxation laws and regulatory requirements affecting the business.

  

**6. Internal Controls & Risk Management**

* Establish and strengthen internal financial control systems and accounting procedures.
* Develop financial policies, approval matrices, and expense control mechanisms.
* Monitor financial risks, operational leakages and potential irregularities.
* Conduct periodic financial reviews and internal audits across outlets and departments.
* Ensure proper reconciliation of bank accounts, vendor accounts, customer accounts, and inventory.
* Implement corrective measures to minimise financial losses and improve operational efficiency.

  

**7. Accounts & Finance Team Leadership**

* Lead, guide and develop the Finance & Accounts team.
* Define responsibilities, establish performance expectations and monitor team deliverables.
* Ensure timely processing of vendor payments, employee reimbursements, payroll accounting, and financial transactions.
* Build efficient accounting processes and improve departmental productivity.
* Coordinate with HR, Operations, Procurement, Sales and other departments for financial requirements.

  

**8. Audit & Business Coordination**

* Manage statutory, internal, and tax audits.
* Coordinate with auditors, consultants, bankers and other external stakeholders.
* Ensure audit schedules, supporting documents and reconciliations are completed on time.
* Present financial performance, business risks and recommendations to senior management.
* Support management in business expansion, investment evaluation and financial decision-making.

  

**Educational Qualifications**

* Chartered Accountant / CMA / MBA in Finance from a reputed institution with strong relevant experience.
* Strong knowledge of accounting standards, taxation, and financial management.

  

**Experience Requirements**

* 5 - 10 years of overall experience in Finance & Accounts.
* At least 3 years in a senior finance leadership or managerial position.
* Strong and preferably mandatory experience in FMCG, Food & Beverage, Retail, Manufacturing, or a multi-location business.
* Experience in managing large-scale financial operations, budgeting, costing, taxation, audits, and financial reporting.
* Experience in ERP implementation, accounting automation, and process improvement will be an added advantage.

  

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strategic financial planning and business partnering.
* Advanced financial analysis and interpretation.
* Strong knowledge of GST, Income Tax, TDS, and statutory compliance.
* Budgeting, forecasting and financial modelling.
* Working capital and cash flow management.
* Inventory valuation, product costing and margin analysis.
* Internal financial controls and risk management.
* ERP / Accounting software knowledge.
* Advanced MS Excel and financial MIS reporting.
* Strong leadership, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

  

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Improvement in overall business profitability and operating margins.
* Accuracy and timely closure of monthly financial statements.
* Effective working capital and cash flow management.
* Timely statutory compliance and audit completion.
* Reduction in operational costs and financial leakages.
* Improvement in inventory control and reconciliation.
* Timely and accurate financial MIS and management reporting.
* Strengthening of internal financial controls and processes.

  

**Interested candidates with strong FMCG / Food & Beverage finance experience and a proven track record in leading finance functions are encouraged to apply.**

jobs.title: Associate Manager - Food and Beverage
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

  
  

To oversee and manage the hospital's food and beverage operations, ensuring high standards of food quality, hygiene, nutrition, patient and staff satisfaction, cost control, and operational efficiency. The role is responsible for managing patient meals, staff cafeterias, visitor food services, and other catering operations in compliance with hospital policies and applicable food safety regulations.

  
  

Key Responsibilities

  

A. Food & Beverage Operations

- Oversee daily food production, service, distribution, and catering operations across the hospital.

- Ensure timely delivery of meals to patients, staff, visitors, and consultants.

- Coordinate with the Dietary Department, Nursing, Purchase, Housekeeping, and other departments for smooth operations.

- Monitor food quality, portion sizes, presentation, and consistency of service.

- Ensure adequate food availability and effective management of kitchen and cafeteria operations.

  
  

B. Food Safety, Hygiene & Compliance

- Ensure compliance with applicable FSSAI regulations and hospital food safety policies.

- Maintain high standards of kitchen hygiene, sanitation, food storage, and personal hygiene.

- Conduct regular inspections and internal audits of kitchen, cafeteria, and food service areas.

- Monitor food temperature, expiry dates, pest control, and prevention of cross-contamination.

- Maintain records related to food safety, cleaning schedules, and quality checks.

  
  

C. Patient Food Services

- Ensure timely and accurate delivery of patient meals as per prescribed dietary requirements.

- Coordinate with clinical dietitians and nursing teams regarding therapeutic diets, allergies, and special meal requests.

- Establish systems to minimise meal errors, food wastage, and patient complaints.

- Monitor patient feedback and implement corrective actions to improve satisfaction.

  
  

D. Financial & Inventory Management

- Prepare and monitor departmental budgets and operating expenses.

- Control food costs, wastage, and consumption through effective planning and monitoring.

- Manage inventory, stock rotation, procurement, and vendor coordination.

- Ensure appropriate storage and utilisation of raw materials and finished food products.

E. Team Management & Development

- Supervise chefs, kitchen staff, food service associates, cafeteria staff, and supervisors.

- Prepare duty rosters and ensure adequate staffing across shifts.

- Train team members on food safety, hygiene, service standards, and customer handling.

- Conduct performance reviews and support employee development.

- Maintain discipline, teamwork, and adherence to hospital policies.

  
  

F. Customer Service & Stakeholder Management

- Address complaints and feedback from patients, attendants, employees, and visitors.

- Coordinate with hospital leadership to improve food service standards.

- Monitor service quality and ensure professional, courteous interactions.

- Develop and implement initiatives to improve customer experience and service efficiency.

  

G. Reporting & Quality Improvement

- Prepare periodic reports on food costs, consumption, wastage, complaints, and departmental performance.

- Track key performance indicators and implement corrective and preventive actions.

- Participate in quality audits, hospital accreditation activities, and departmental reviews.

- Identify process improvements to enhance operational efficiency and service quality.

  
  

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Patient and customer satisfaction scores.

- Timely delivery of patient meals.

- Food safety and hygiene audit scores.

- Food cost and budget adherence.

- Reduction in food wastage.

- Inventory accuracy and stock control.

- Number of food quality complaints and corrective actions.

- Employee productivity, training, and retention.

4. Educational Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or diploma in Hotel Management, Hospitality Management, Food & Beverage Management, or a related field.

- Additional certification in food safety, catering operations, or hospitality management is preferred.

  
  

5. Experience

- 58 years of relevant experience in food and beverage, catering, or hospitality operations.

- Prior experience in a hospital, healthcare institution, large institutional kitchen, or high-volume catering setup is preferred.

- Experience in managing large teams, budgets, vendors, and food service operations is essential.

The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end event planning, operational execution, food quality, manpower deployment, vendor coordination, cost control and customer satisfaction.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience managing outdoor catering operations, leading large teams, coordinating multiple events, and ensuring smooth execution within agreed budgets and timelines.

Key Responsibilities

  

**1. Outdoor Catering & Event Operations**

* Plan, organise and execute outdoor catering assignments, corporate events, weddings, exhibitions, private functions and other catering requirements.
* Manage end-to-end event operations, from initial client discussions and requirement assessment to final execution and closure.
* Coordinate food production, transportation, setup, service and dismantling at event locations.
* Ensure timely delivery and smooth execution of all catering activities.
* Conduct site visits to assess infrastructure, logistics, manpower and operational requirements.

  

**2. Client Management & Business Coordination**

* Coordinate with corporate clients, event organisers, institutions and individual customers to understand their catering requirements.
* Handle client meetings, menu discussions, quotations and event-related coordination.
* Maintain strong client relationships and ensure high levels of customer satisfaction.
* Identify new business opportunities and support the development of the ODC business.
* Address client feedback, complaints, and operational concerns professionally.

  

**3. Manpower Planning & Team Management**

* Plan and allocate manpower based on event size and operational requirements.
* Manage supervisors, chefs, kitchen staff, service teams, housekeeping, and temporary event staff.
* Coordinate recruitment and deployment of temporary or outsourced manpower whenever required.
* Ensure proper grooming, hygiene, discipline, and service standards among team members.
* Conduct team briefings and ensure all employees understand their roles and responsibilities.

  

**4. Food Quality & Service Standards**

* Ensure food quality, taste, presentation, and consistency across all catering assignments.
* Coordinate with the kitchen and production teams for menu planning and food preparation.
* Ensure proper food handling, storage, transportation, and temperature control.
* Monitor food safety, hygiene, and sanitation standards in compliance with applicable FSSAI requirements.
* Ensure professional service standards and timely food service during events.

  

**5. Budgeting & Cost Control**

* Prepare event-wise budgets and cost estimates based on client requirements.
* Monitor food costs, manpower expenses, transportation, equipment rentals, and other operational expenses.
* Ensure effective utilisation of resources and minimise operational wastage.
* Monitor event profitability and prepare event-wise cost and revenue reports.

jobs.title: IT Assistant / IT Executive
jobs.description:
We are looking for a technically skilled and proactive IT Assistant / IT Executive to manage and maintain the company's IT infrastructure across the Corporate Office, warehouses, and retail outlets.

The candidate will be responsible for providing day-to-day technical support, maintaining computer systems and networks, troubleshooting hardware and software issues, managing IT assets, and ensuring smooth functioning of IT operations across all company locations.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in Windows administration, networking, hardware maintenance, troubleshooting, and IT infrastructure support.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**1. IT Infrastructure & Network Management**

* Install, configure and maintain computer systems, hardware, software and network infrastructure.
* Perform system and network administration, including LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and internet connectivity.
* Manage and troubleshoot network devices, routers, switches, data cards, dongles and ISP connectivity.
* Ensure network security and provide remote technical support whenever required.
* Configure and maintain Windows Server environments, including DHCP, DNS, FTP, Group Policies and IIS.

  

**2. Technical Support & Troubleshooting**

* Provide day-to-day IT support to employees at the Corporate Office, warehouses and retail outlets.
* Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, operating system, printer, LAN and connectivity-related issues.
* Support and maintain EDC/POS machines, CCTV systems, biometric attendance devices and other IT equipment.
* Install, configure and update antivirus software and ensure systems are protected.
* Handle Windows OS installations, upgrades, migrations and troubleshooting.

  

**3. IT Asset & Equipment Management**

* Maintain an updated inventory of all IT assets, including desktops, laptops, printers, networking devices, CCTV and biometric equipment.
* Track equipment servicing, repairs, replacements and maintenance records.
* Coordinate the movement, installation and allocation of IT equipment between the Corporate Office, warehouse and outlets.
* Maintain proper records of company-issued laptops, desktops and other IT assets.

  

**4. Preventive Maintenance & Data Backup**

* Schedule and carry out periodic preventive maintenance of IT equipment across all company locations.
* Perform regular data backups of company-assigned desktops and laptops.
* Ensure systems are updated and maintained for optimal performance.
* Maintain proper records of system maintenance, backups and IT-related activities.

  

**5. Vendor & Service Provider Coordination**

* Coordinate with IT vendors, suppliers and service providers for hardware purchases, repairs, AMC and maintenance.
* Follow up on service requests, equipment replacements and technical support requirements.
* Assist in evaluating IT products and services based on company requirements.

  

**6. MIS & Documentation**

* Maintain IT-related reports, asset registers, maintenance records and service documentation.
* Prepare and update IT inventory and MIS reports using MS Excel.
* Support the implementation, maintenance and continuous improvement of IT infrastructure and processes.

  

**7. General Responsibilities**

* Coordinate with internal departments to ensure uninterrupted IT support and smooth business operations.
* Identify opportunities to improve IT systems, infrastructure and operational efficiency.
* Perform additional IT-related responsibilities as assigned by the reporting manager.

  

**Required Technical Skills**

* Good knowledge of Microsoft Windows Operating Systems and Windows Server environments.
* Hands-on experience in system administration and network troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of DHCP, DNS, FTP, Group Policies and IIS.
* Experience in LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, routers, switches and internet connectivity.
* Knowledge of antivirus installation, configuration and updates.
* Experience in hardware installation, maintenance and troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of CCTV, biometric attendance systems and POS/EDC machines.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel and MIS reporting.
* Knowledge of data backup, system upgrades and operating system migration.

  

**Candidate Profile**

* Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
* Prior experience in IT Support, IT Administration, Desktop Support or Network Administration.
* Practical hands-on troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to independently manage IT support requirements across multiple locations.
* Willingness to travel to company outlets and other locations whenever required.

  

**Key Competencies**

* Technical troubleshooting and problem-solving.
* Time management and task prioritisation.
* Vendor and stakeholder coordination.
* Asset management and documentation.
* Ownership, accountability and teamwork.

Build and manage a resilient, quality-first vendor base across domestic and international sourcing geographies (e.g. mango, jamun, and kokum from Indian growing regions; select fruit and seed sourcing from international markets) and Fairtrade-aligned sourcing programs (e.g. groundnut sourcing for chikki).

jobs.description:
**Job Purpose and Impact**

The Poultry Nutrition Specialist should have technical expertise and science-driven insights to design, evaluate, and optimize poultry feed formulations. In this role, you will support raw material selection, feed program design, and diet modifications to improve bird performance, health, feed efficiency, and cost-effectiveness. You will also provide analytical and advisory services to RD, production, and commercial teams on key poultry nutritional considerations. You should be able to learn and adopt Cargills nutrition system and apply it in your feed formulations for precise nutrition.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Provide technical support and feed formulations to poultry producers and feed mills for precise nutrition, feeding programs (broilers, layers, breeders), and performance optimization.
* Formulate and optimize poultry feed formulation based on raw material quality, nutrient specifications, cost targets, and production goals.
* Monitor and evaluate feed quality, ingredient variability, and nutritional consistency to ensure feed meet required nutrient specifications and bird performance standards.
* Analyse performance data (FCR, body weight gain, egg production, mortality, etc.) and recommend nutritional interventions to address production challenges.
* Maintain and update nutritional databases (ingredients, feed formulations, nutrient matrices) using laboratory data and industry benchmarks.
* Collaborate with Cargills Global Nutrition experts and commercial teams to incorporate market trends, ingredient availability, and cost optimization strategies.
* Conduct trials at Cargills Technology Application Centre and support field trials to validate feed formulations, additives, and nutritional strategies and create scientific trial reports.
* Independently solve moderately complex nutritional and production issues, escalating more complex concerns to global experts when required.
* Deliver technical presentations, training sessions, and documentation to internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* M.V.Sc (Animal Nutrition).
* Minimum of 6 years of experience in poultry nutrition, feed formulation and poultry industry.
* Demonstrated knowledge of poultry nutritional requirements (broilers, layers, breeders) and feed ingredient evaluation.
* Experience with feed formulation software and nutritional modelling.
* Other minimum qualifications may apply.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Ph.D. in Animal Nutrition.
* Experience in commercial poultry operations or feed industry.
* Knowledge of alternative ingredients, feed additives, and enzyme technologies.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong data analysis and interpretation skills.

**Job Title:** Key Account Manager (KAM), International Business  
**Function:** Account Management, Sales & Business Growth - Pet Food  
**Location:** Bengaluru, India (On-Site)  
   
**About Dogsee:**  
At Dogsee, we are passionately crafting a global revolution in the pet industry. Our mission is to elevate canine wellness through a commitment to quality, ethics, and innovation. With a foundation of love for dogs, we create 100% human-grade treats that nourish pets' health and happiness.  
   
Through strategic partnerships, innovative Go-To-Market strategies, and a dedicated team, Dogsee has achieved a robust presence in 30+ countries. We are continuously redefining global pet care standards, earning international recognition for Indian pet brands. Guided by our mission, we aim to foster cultural resonance, prioritize pet health, and inspire positive industry change.  
   
**Role Summary:**  
We are seeking a highly motivated and dynamic **Key Account Manager (KAM)** to lead the charge in driving sales growth, expanding business, and delivering exceptional client experiences across international markets. This individual will take full ownership of assigned international clients, ensuring client retention, exceeding sales targets, and exploring new growth opportunities.  
   
As the primary point of contact for key accounts, the KAM will focus on nurturing long-term client relationships while leveraging insights to maximize account revenue. The role demands tight alignment with sales targets and KPIs, coupled with proactive efforts to expand Dogsee's presence in global markets.  
   
In addition to managing existing accounts, the KAM will identify and onboard new distributors, resellers, and buyers across diverse geographies, helping Dogsee achieve its ambitious international growth objectives. This role also entails active collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless operations, timely delivery, and outstanding client satisfaction.  
   
**Key Responsibilities:**  
   
**Sales Growth & Expansion:**

* Develop and execute sales strategies to meet or exceed quarterly and annual revenue and growth targets.
* Actively identify new business opportunities and onboard distributors, resellers, and retail buyers in international markets.
* Expand Dogsee's client base by identifying untapped markets and regions with high growth potential.

***Role:-*** Factory Manager / Plant Manager

(Food Manufacturing)

***Employment Type:-*** Full time, Permanent

***Location:-*** Jigani, Bangalore

***Experience:-***  8 to 12 years in food/FMCG manufacturing, incl. 5+ years leading a plant.

***Direct reports:-*** Production Officer, QC, Stores & Warehouse In-charge, Dispatch team

  

***About US:-***

  

We are a long-established brand with a proven track record of strong, long-standing customer base. We are looking to expand our product portfolio. While deeply rooted in our legacy, our focus remains on innovation and growth.

  

***The Role:-***

  

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Factory Manager to run day-to-day operations at our food plant in Jigani. You will know the shop floor, understand food safety deeply, and build a strong culture of hygiene, safety and continuous improvement.

  

***Responsibilities:-***

  

* **Production:** Plan and run production to meet volume, quality and delivery targets. Track KPIs (OEE, yield, wastage, downtime, cost per unit, OTIF) and act fast on gaps. Make the best use of materials, utilities and manpower, and support new product trials with R&D.
* **Food safety and quality:** Own the plants food safety system and FSSAI compliance, including batch traceability, mock recalls, root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* **Safety and compliance:** Ensure compliance with the Factories Act, Legal Metrology, Pollution Control Board, fire safety and other laws. Build a zero-harm safety culture, manage effluent and waste, and be the plants contact for inspectors.
* **Maintenance:** Keep equipment and utilities (DG sets, water treatment) reliable through planned maintenance. Plan and manage capex projects on time and budget.
* **People:** Lead and develop supervisors, operators and contract workers. Plan shifts and training, handle grievances fairly, and drive discipline and accountability.
* **Cost, inventory and dispatch:** Manage the plant budget and cost targets. Control stock with FIFO/FEFO to minimise expiry. Plan daily dispatches, manage transporters, and handle paperwork (invoices, e-way bills) and returns.
* **Reporting and improvement:** Share regular MIS reports with management. Lead Lean, 5S, Kaizen and Six Sigma initiatives, and bring in automation and ERP/digital tools.

  

***Required Qualification:-***

  

* Bachelors degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Dairy Technology, Chemical/Mechanical Engineering or related field.
* 8 to 12 years in food, beverage or FMCG manufacturing, with 5+ years as Plant/Factory Manager or equivalent, including hands-on shop-floor experience.
* Strong knowledge of FSSAI, HACCP, GMP and ISO 22000 / FSSC 22000, plus working knowledge of the Factories Act, labour and environmental laws.
* Experience managing a large multi-shift workforce, including contract labour.

  

***Preferred:-***

  

* MBA/Masters in Operations; FSSC 22000 / ISO 22000 / BRCGS Lead Auditor or FoSTaC certification; Lean Six Sigma belt.
* Experience with SAP or another ERP, and knowledge of the local regional language.

  

***Key skills:-***

  

* Leadership that motivates teams and leads by example on the shop floor.
* A food safety mindset, treating hygiene and safety as non-negotiable.
* Data-driven problem solving (5 Why, Fishbone, FMEA) and calm decision-making in breakdowns or recalls.
* Good planning, budgeting and communication with management, regulators, auditors and staff.
* Knowledge of Kannada and Hindi.

  

***How success is measured:-***

  

* Production vs plan and on-time-in-full (OTIF) delivery.
* OEE, yield, wastage and cost per unit vs budget.
* Customer complaints, zero recalls and zero lost-time injuries.
* Inventory accuracy, low expiry write-offs, and team attrition and training.

  

***Working conditions:-***

  

* Based at the plant, with shop-floor presence across shifts as needed.
* Must follow hygiene and GMP rules (protective clothing, health checks) and be available for emergencies.

* **Trade Spend Effectiveness:** Scheme spend within budget as % of sales, and incremental sales delivered per scheme.

* Age: 38yrs to 40 yrs. (Max limit 45yrs)

* Qualification: Minimum graduate. Post Graduate in Sales & Marketing.

jobs.description:
**Description**
Amazon’s mission is to be the most customer-centric company on Earth. To get there, we need to develop leaders who represent, and can innovate, on behalf of a diverse and demanding global customer base. The Global Procurement Organization (GPO) identifies and procures goods and services at the best value for business, maintaining the quality of products and ensuring that alternative sources of supply are available. The Social Responsibility (SR) and Human Rights program drives customer trust and business continuity by ensuring respect for the rights of workers throughout Amazon’s supply chain and operations. We uphold company standards and expectations (such as Amazon's Supply Chain Standards and Human Rights Principles), and seek to constantly improve the tools and processes that we use in doing so.
  
  
As an SR Risk Manager in SR Ops, within the Global Procurement Sustainability (GPS) team, you will work closely with Amazon’s Social Responsibility team and the Global Procurement Organization to implement mechanisms to meet Amazon’s human rights principles and Supply Chain Standards and to ensure our suppliers are compliant with those.
  
  
You will be responsible for Audit risk assessment activities across Global Operations suppliers and remediation plan coordination. You will work closely with internal and external partners to plan and execute high-quality and impactful audits, which address the highest human right risks.
  
  
You will insist on the highest standards for your audits and you will be able to dive deep into every audit area, apply broad technical knowledge, sound business judgment, and partner with key stakeholders.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Work across GPO, collaborating with external partners (Audit companies) and internal business partners, such as Operations, WW SR and Sustainability, Legal and Risk Management to identify and assess regulatory and human rights compliance risks as it relates to our supplier baseline
* Review new and existing suppliers (legacy) ensuring that they meet Human Rights compliance, safety, terms of service standards, investigate suspicious suppliers / driver activity and behaviors that could pose a risk to Amazon, our customers, or others
* Drive cross-functional assessments of risks and controls to align to company strategy and risk appetite. Be able to assess the real situation sometimes with limited information in hand in order to make an independent decision about the suppliers’ integrity and compliance standards
* Be responsible for site-level/ supplier remediation of high-severity issues identified in assessments, or external sources (i.e., whistle-blower, media alerts, worker voice)
* Assist with creation of investigation plans to determine root cause, and leads the remediation efforts with CSR while maintaining communication with leadership and impacted stakeholders
* Coordinate and plan remediation activities for suppliers in case of high-risk findings
* Handle day-to-day issues (constantly thinking about how to invent and simplify to improve)

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* 5+ years of supply chain experience
* 3+ years of program or project management experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Knowledge of procurement and source to pay processes and solutions or equivalent experience
* 2+ years of experience in compliance, audit or risk management
* Business communication skill in English and Hindi

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics or related field
* 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience in Environmental, Social & Governance (ESG) Law

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. **Senior Trade Compliance Specialist**

**Company Overview**

Our client is a global provider of high-technology interconnect, sensor and antenna solutions, serving a diverse range of industries, including Defence and Commercial Aerospace, Automotive, Industrial, Information Technology and Data Communications, Broadband Communications and other technology-driven sectors.

The successful candidate will serve as the principal subject-matter expert for trade compliance matters, ensuring regulatory adherence, optimising customs and trade-related benefits, mitigating compliance risks and facilitating seamless import and export operations.

This is an individual contributor role requiring strong technical expertise, analytical capabilities and functional leadership to effectively coordinate with internal stakeholders, customs authorities, government agencies, logistics partners and other external stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Import & Export Operations**

* Independently manage and oversee import and export operations, ensuring the smooth, timely and compliant movement of goods.

* Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory frameworks, including:
* Foreign Trade Policy (FTP) and Handbook of Procedures.
* Customs Act, 1962 and Customs Tariff Act, 1975.
* DGFT regulations and applicable notifications.
* FEMA provisions relating to import and export transactions.
* GST provisions relating to imports, exports and zero-rated supplies.
* Applicable export control regulations.
* EOU, SEZ and Domestic Tariff Area (DTA) provisions.

* Shipping Bills and Bills of Entry.

* Ensure proper maintenance of EOU records, registers, reconciliations and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate with relevant authorities for amendments, renewals, permissions and closure of applicable EOU authorisations.

**3. Customs, DGFT & Government Liaison**

* Act as the primary point of coordination with relevant government authorities on trade compliance matters, including:
* Indian Customs authorities.
* Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT).
* GST authorities.
* Special Economic Zone (SEZ) authorities, wherever applicable.

At Wells Fargo, a Senior Product Valuation Control Analyst supports accurate, transparent financial reporting and effective valuation oversight. You will lead or contribute to moderately complex profit and loss and valuation control work, resolve valuation and reconciliation issues, and strengthen financial reporting and control processes.

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead or participate in moderately complex initiatives related to daily profit and loss production, attribution, and commentary for trading and banking desks
* Review and analyze valuation inputs, trade data, and reconciliation breaks to ensure accurate financial reporting and control

* Lead projects, mentor less experienced analysts, and coordinate cross-functional initiatives within the product and valuation control function
* Expand understanding of systems and data flows across Front Office, Risk, and Finance to provide recommendations to fix issues at source

**Required Qualifications:**

* 4+ years of product and valuation control experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* Strong demonstration on valuation control, independent price verification experience.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Experience applying financial valuation, financial analysis, and data analysis to assess complex information and support sound conclusions
* Knowledge of profit and loss management, profitability analysis, and financial drivers for trading and capital markets products
* Ability to complete balance sheet substantiation and financial reconciliations, including investigation and resolution of discrepancies
* Experience applying control frameworks, risk management, regulatory compliance, and issue management practices
* Ability to prepare clear reporting and analysis and present findings to stakeholders
* Experience managing processes and projects, including control enhancement, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives
* Problem solving, strategic thinking, and stakeholder management skills to resolve cross-functional matters

jobs.title: IT GRC - Assistant Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a techno-functional professional to join our RegTech & Cyber Risk practice. The role sits at the intersection of technology, regulation, and compliance advisory requiring an individual who is equally at home reviewing IT systems and audit artefacts as they are interpreting RBI Master Directions and advising clients on compliance posture.

The successful candidate will work across regulatory compliance engagements covering the RBI IT Governance, Risk, Controls and Assurance (ITGRCA) framework, IT Outsourcing and TPRM norms, Digital Lending guidelines, Payment and Settlement Systems regulations, and frameworks governing Payment Aggregators / Payment Gateways (PA/PG) and Prepaid Payment Instruments (PPI). This is a growth-track role with direct client interaction and practice development responsibilities.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Shall possess hands-on technical experience executing a diverse range of engagements,

including IT General Controls (ITGC) audits, comprehensive Internal Audits of complex IT

environments, and the evaluation/preparation of SOC reports.

* Shall independently drive and execute regulatory compliance audits spanning diverse

financial entities, including Banks, NBFCs, Fintechs, Insurance Brokers, and Stockbrokers

ensuring adherence to applicable RBI, SEBI, and IRDAI norms.

* Ability to critically evaluate technical evidence, identify inconsistencies, and detect control

circumvention risks across applications, databases, and infrastructure.

* Shall independently verify that the organizations IT strategy, policy frameworks, and Board

level oversight (ITSC/ACB) strictly align with regulatory Master Directions and maintain a

clear, independent reporting line for the CISO.

* Shall audit the security posture of the extended ecosystem, including third-party vendors,

outsourced IT services.

* Capability to seamlessly bridge the gap between technical IT controls and broader regulatory

expectations, translating complex cyber risks into clear business impacts.

* Shall validate the operational effectiveness of security monitoring (SOC), VAPT cycles, and

BCP/DR readiness to ensure the institution can detect threats in real-time and recover from

system failures within mandatory RPO/RTO targets.

* Susinftrong understanding of the control environments surrounding complex payment

systems, including Payment Aggregators/Payment Gateways (PA/PG), cross-border data

flows, and third-party payment integrations.

* Supervise and review the fieldwork of senior associates/consultants, ensuring that audit

working papers, test scripts, and documentation meet rigorous qualitative standards.

* Collaborating with IT process owners to design practical, risk-mitigating controls and actively

tracking remediation plans to closure.

* Act as a key liaison during external regulatory inspections and statutory audits, facilitating

clear communication between technical IT teams, external auditors, and senior

management.

  

**Educational Qualifications:**

* B.E. / B.Tech / B.Sc. (IT/CS/ECE) or B.Com / BBA with strong technology orientation; MBA /

M.Tech is an advantage.

* Certifications considered - CISA, CISSP, CISM, CompTIA Security+, CRISC, CCSP

**Skills & Competencies:**

**Regulatory Knowledge Essential**

* RBI IT Governance, Risk, Controls and Assurance (ITGRCA) Master Direction
* RBI Master Direction on IT Outsourcing / Managing Risks in Outsourcing (NBFC / Banks)
* RBI Digital Lending Guidelines (2022 and subsequent updates)
* Payment and Settlement Systems (PSS) Act, 2007 and RBI DPSS frameworks
* Payment Aggregator / Payment Gateway (PA/PG) guidelines Merchant onboarding, escrow,

baseline security

* Prepaid Payment Instruments (PPI) Master Direction wallet issuance, interoperability, KYC

norms

* UPI ecosystem — NPCI operating guidelines, dispute resolution, fraud risk frameworks

**Technology & Control Domains**

* IT General Controls (ITGC) assessment — access management, change management,

operations, BCP/DR

* Application controls review — input validation, processing controls, output reconciliation
* Cybersecurity frameworks — familiarity with ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls
* Data protection and privacy — DPDP Act 2023 awareness; data classification and handling

controls

* Third-party risk management (TPRM) — vendor assessment, contract review, SLA monitoring
* Cloud risk assessment — awareness of shared responsibility models, cloud-specific regulatory

requirements

  

**Tools & Methodology**

* Proficiency in MS Excel (audit/risk workbooks, control matrices, scoring models)
* MS PowerPoint — client-facing deliverable and deck preparation
* Familiarity with GRC tools (e.g., SAP GRC, ServiceNow GRC, or similar) is an advantage
* Comfort with data analysis and log review as part of IT audit fieldwork

**Behavioural Attributes:**

* High level of confidentiality and discretion.
* Ability to perform under pressure and manage multiple competing priorities.
* Customer-service-oriented with a positive attitude.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team.
