jobs.title: Manager – Corporate Legal & Secretarial Advisory
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**  

Role OverviewWe are looking for a senior professional who is a qualified Company Secretary and Law Graduate, with strong experience in corporate law, legal documentation, regulatory compliances and advisory services. The role will involve managing the firm's corporate secretarial and legal practice, leading a team responsible for routine corporate compliance and execution, while also independently handling and advising on complex corporate structuring, startup advisory, investment transactions, FEMA and cross-border regulatory matters. The candidate should be comfortable working with established businesses as well as startups, founders, investors and investment funds, and should bring a strong combination of technical knowledge, practical execution capabilities and client management skills.

**Key Responsibilities**  

* Lead and oversee routine corporate secretarial compliances for a portfolio of companies, LLPs and other entities.
* Manage incorporation, restructuring, conversion, capital restructuring, share allotments, transfers, buybacks and other corporate actions.
* Spearhead the drafting and vetting of diverse legal contracts and agreements, and advise clients on navigating legal matters, dispute resolution, and drafting/responding to legal notices.
* Assist clients in effectively managing ongoing legal matters, mitigating risks, and ensuring legal and regulatory compliance.
* Handle ROC filings, MCA compliances, maintenance of statutory registers, minutes, resolutions and other secretarial records.
* Oversee annual compliances, Board and General Meetings, and other requirements under the Companies Act, 2013 and LLP Act.
* Lead and guide a team handling day-to-day secretarial assignments, ensuring quality, timelines and client deliverables.

* Advise startups, founders, investors and investment funds on corporate structuring, investment structures, capitalisation and governance matters.
* Draft, review and negotiate Shareholders' Agreements (SHA), Share Subscription Agreements (SSA), Share Purchase Agreements (SPA), Investment Agreements, Founders' Agreements, ESOP plans and other commercial and transaction documents.
* Guide the stakeholders and assist companies in completion of CPs and CS with complete ownership for transactions.
* Advise on equity investments, preferential allotments, rights issues, convertible instruments, CCPS, CCDs, warrants and other investment structures.
* Assist in due diligence, transaction structuring, term sheet reviews, investment documentation and deal execution.
* Advise on founder exits, secondary transactions, share buybacks, business transfers and other corporate transactions.

* Handle and advise on inbound and outbound investments, FDI, ODI, overseas investments and other FEMA-related matters.
* Advise on foreign investment structures, downstream investments, overseas holding structures and cross-border transactions.
* Handle RBI/FEMA reporting, including FC-GPR, FC-TRS, Form DI, LLP filings, APR and other applicable regulatory filings.
* Liaise with authorised dealer banks, RBI, DPIIT and other regulatory authorities.
* Advise on ECB, foreign remittances, transfer of shares, repatriation, Branch and Liaison office, and other cross-border regulatory matters.

* Advise on business and investment structuring, holding company structures, subsidiary arrangements, group reorganisations and restructuring.
* Advise on corporate governance, shareholder rights, promoter arrangements, related-party transactions and regulatory considerations.
* Work closely with the firm's tax, accounting and transaction advisory teams to provide integrated solutions to clients.
* Advise on IPO readiness, pre-IPO corporate restructuring, governance and compliance requirements.

* Lead, mentor and develop a team of company secretarial and legal professionals.
* Allocate assignments, monitor deliverables and ensure timely completion of client engagements.
* Independently interact with founders, CFOs, investors, promoters, legal counsels and senior management.
* Review the quality of legal documentation, regulatory filings, opinions and advisory deliverables.
* Identify additional advisory opportunities within the existing client portfolio and contribute to developing the firm's corporate legal and secretarial practice.

  
  
**Desired Candidate Profile**  

Qualified Company Secretary and Law Graduate (LL.B.). 8-10 years of relevant professional experience in a CA firm, law firm, consulting firm or corporate legal/secretarial function. Strong working knowledge of the Companies Act, 2013, LLP Act, FEMA, FDI Policy, ODI Regulations and SEBI regulations. Hands-on experience in drafting and reviewing SHAs, SSAs, SPAs, investment agreements and other corporate transaction documents. Good exposure to startup ecosystem, venture capital transactions, private equity investments and founder/investor advisory. Experience in handling FEMA, FDI and ODI transactions, including regulatory reporting and liaison with AD banks. Exposure to IPO readiness, SME/Main Board listing requirements and capital markets will be an advantage. Ability to independently manage client engagements, lead teams and handle multiple assignments. Strong drafting, analytical, communication and client relationship management skills.

**What We Are Looking For**  

We are looking for someone who can go beyond routine secretarial compliance and support corporate legal and transaction advisory services. The individual should be equally comfortable reviewing a routine ROC filing, leading a team handling corporate compliances, drafting a shareholders' agreement, advising a startup on its investment structure or handling a cross-border FEMA transaction.

**What You'll Build**

You will identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows, reduce manual effort, enable intelligent decision-making, and deliver differentiated AI-native experiences within SAP Concur Spend. jobs.title: Product Manager II
jobs.description:
**The Role**

Having built strong foundations in India, we now operate across multiple international markets and are expanding into new ones. International Payments (i18n) takes Razorpay’s products into these markets: local payment methods, cross-border flows, and the partnerships with banks, wallets and schemes that make them work — on top of a platform and systems layer that has to be rebuilt for each market’s rails, currency, regulation and settlement cycle. Much of this is 0 to 1 work. You will be deciding what to build, building it with engineering, taking it to merchants, and growing it. There is no running playbook to inherit. You will write it.

This is a builder role as much as a product role. In a new market, Razorpay has no brand recall and few relationships, so you will open doors yourself and because a new market means new rails, you will also own the systems underneath — machinery that every downstream product depends on.

**What you will own**

* Build Customer Empathy: PMs have to regularly meet and understand customer needs first-hand as well as stay on top of the customer pulse via secondary insights - both qualitative and quantitative.
* Devise Strategy: Define both long-term strategy and quarterly roadmap to achieve the product vision and create impact.
* Conceptualize new solutions: Product Conceptualization with a problem first, data-driven, and test & iterate approach. Ensures conceptualization from a platform and a long-term view. Ensures value-based prioritization of product initiatives.
* Build products: Collaborate with Engineering and ecosystem players to build products that customers love. Produce high-quality product specifications and effectively prioritize and manage the scope of each product launch to deliver products and features on time.
* Launch products: Draft and execute a go-to-market plan in conjunction with Product Marketing. Be the internal and external authority and advocate for your given area of focus.
* Ecosystem collaboration: Self-starter to collaborate closely with ecosystem players to co-build products that don’t exist
* Business focus: Build business strategy around ecosystem product that would define the success for the Razorpay and the Ecosystem players

**Mandatory Qualifications:**

* You understand technology, but love customer-first & business-first thinking.
* You are comfortable working hands-on in a fast-paced start-up environment.
* You are curious about metrics, execution processes, macro trends.
* Problem-solving and detail orientation come naturally to you.
* You have an analytical and data-driven approach in day-to-day work. Energetic self-starter with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
* You are entrepreneurial and have the hunger to solve problems end-to-end.
* You have at least 4 years of experience in Product Management.

jobs.title: Associate Manager, Product-Tech, Central
jobs.description:
**About The/Nudge Institute**
**The/Nudge**
is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.
  
  
Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.
  
  
Founded with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.
  
  
**About This Role**
The/Nudge is building its own technology products to run the organisation better and to deliver programmes at scale. These include internal platforms our 400+ team members use day to day, and tools that support our programme and field teams. We build fast and in-house, using AI-assisted development tools and LLMs.
  
  
We are looking for an Associate Product Manager to own products end to end: from understanding what users need, to shaping the solution, shipping it, and driving adoption. You will work closely with leadership, programme teams, strategy and operations teams, and with the engineers who build our products. This role suits someone who wants hands-on product ownership early in their career, in an organisation where technology directly serves social impact.
  
  
**What will you do?**

* Discover the problem: Work with internal teams and end users to understand their workflows and pain points through interviews, observation, feedback and usage data. Turn what you learn into clear problem statements.
* Define the product: Write product requirement documents (PRDs), user stories and acceptance criteria. Make sure every feature has a clear purpose, scope and measure of success.
* Prioritise the roadmap: Maintain the product backlog and roadmap. Weigh user impact, effort, risk and organisational priorities, and explain trade-offs clearly to stakeholders.
* Build with engineering and AI: Work hands-on with developers, interns and AI-assisted development tools to design, build and iterate on features. Translate requirements into precise, well-scoped instructions.
* Test before release: Plan and run user acceptance testing, coordinate beta testers, and track bugs and fixes through to closure. Protect live products from regressions.
* Launch and drive adoption: Plan rollouts, write launch communications, run demos and training sessions, and create user guides so that products are actually used.
* Measure what matters: Define and track product metrics such as adoption, usage and user satisfaction. Use the data to decide what to build, fix or retire next.
* Keep things documented: Maintain product documentation, decision logs and release notes so the products can scale and be handed over smoothly.
* Grow the product practice: Help bring a product-first, AI-first way of working to new initiatives as The/Nudge builds more products in the future.

**Who are we looking for in this role?**

* A degree in engineering, computer science, business, economics or a related field. Strong candidates from other backgrounds who can show product thinking are welcome to apply.
* 5+ years of overall experience in product management, business analysis, consulting, technology implementation or software engineering. Experience shipping a product or feature that real users adopted is a strong plus.
* Clear structured thinking: the ability to break a messy problem into its parts and write it up crisply.
* Comfort with data: spreadsheets are a must; basic SQL or a dashboarding tool is a strong plus.
* Hands-on familiarity with AI tools and large language models (LLMs), and curiosity about how they can be used to build products faster.
* Enough technical understanding to work confidently with engineers: how web apps, databases and APIs fit together. You do not need to be a developer.
* Excellent communication with non-technical users, from senior leadership to field teams. You can explain a feature simply and listen well to feedback.
* An ownership mindset: you follow a feature through to adoption, not just to release.
* A strong alignment with our mission to leverage technology for large-scale social impact.

**Good To Have**

* Experience building with no-code, low-code or AI-assisted development tools.
* Exposure to internal tools, ERP, CRM or HRMS systems.
* Experience in the social sector, or working with government or field programmes.

***Please note:***
This is an onsite, full-time role based in our Bengaluru office. We are dedicated to building a dynamic in-office culture and require all team members to work from the office.
  
  
*We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organisation and encourage qualified individuals irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.*

jobs.title: Staff Software Development Engineer, Bangalore
jobs.description:
**About Broccoli 🥦**
At Broccoli, we're building AI teammates for the people who build and maintain our world.
  
  
We partner with plumbing, HVAC, and electrical contractors, the hardworking businesses that keep homes and communities running, and replace fragmented software and repetitive manual work with AI that actually gets the job done.
  
  
Our AI teammates answer phones, book appointments, follow up with customers, recover missed revenue, and help contractors deliver exceptional customer experiences, all while integrating seamlessly with platforms like ServiceTitan.
  
  
Before we wrote a single line of code, we visited more than 140 contractors to understand how these businesses truly operate. That firsthand experience shaped everything we've built.
  
  
**Today:**

* Hundreds of contractors rely on Broccoli every day.
* We've grown to $25M+ ARR in two years.
* We're trusted by everyone from independent contractors to some of the largest private equity backed operators in the home services industry.
* We're backed by Khosla Ventures and Y Combinator.

We're still just getting started.
  
  
**Staff Software Engineer @ Broccoli**
We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help build the AI intelligence layer that runs front-office operations for home service businesses. You’ll work on systems that don’t just generate responses—but take real actions like booking jobs, dispatching technicians, and driving revenue.
  
  
This is a product engineering role. You won’t just write code—you’ll shape how the product works in the real world, talking to customers, understanding edge cases, and shipping quickly.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Build end-to-end features across backend and frontend that directly impact customer revenue
* Work closely with design, product, and GTM to ship features from idea to production
* Translate real-world workflows (calls, scheduling, dispatch) into scalable systems
* Improve system reliability, performance, and developer velocity as we scale
* Learn fast by working directly with customers and iterating based on real usage

What You’ll Bring
  
  

* 8+ years of experience building and shipping products
* Strong fundamentals across backend and frontend systems
* High ownership—you don’t wait for specs, you figure things out
* Curiosity for how real businesses operate, not just how software works
* Ability to move fast without breaking things that matter

Broccoli is an equal-opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practice laws.

jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.description:
SeekRight is an AI company that uses computer vision and video analytics to help organisations across industries including roads and highways, rail, construction, logistics and warehousing, waste management, and energy and power. We are headquartered in Bangalore, India, with offices in the Middle East and other countries.

  

We are hiring a QA Engineer to ensure the reliability, accuracy and performance of our software platforms, APIs and AI-driven applications through structured manual and automated testing. This is a full-time, work-from-office role at our Bangalore office in Hulimavu.

Nice-to-haves: testing AI/ML or computer vision applications; performance tools such as JMeter; CI/CD; basic Linux and Docker.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Weighing Solutions
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Sales Manager  

**Your role and responsibilities**

In this role, you will support the development and growth of ABB's weighing solutions portfolio by optimizing the offer portfolio and improving return on investment. You will be responsible for understanding market needs, customer requirements, and industry trends, translating these insights into product strategies, specifications, and development initiatives. You will play a key role throughout the product lifecycle, supporting portfolio planning, product launches, market positioning, pricing strategies, profitability, and continuous portfolio enhancement to deliver sustainable business growth and customer value.

The work model for the role is: #LI - Onsite

This role is contributing to the development of weighing portfolio for the Force measurement business line of ABB Measurement and Analytics division for Business area Automation in India region supporting globally.

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Managing the product portfolio of weighing solutions.
* Maintain product documentation including technical specification, product brochures, product manuals, application notes, success stories and other technical and sales material. Prepare and maintain price lists for review and approval
* Maintains and follows annual cycle of activities to govern product management for the assigned offering.
* Keeps the product group, Sales team, and channels informed on topics related to the offering, such as new offering availability, market, competition, quality, configuration, trends, and limitations.
* Ensures appropriate product training materials are available to train internal (Sales/Engineering/Service JFGs) and external customers, delivers training on new offering(s) to internal teams and customers.
* Understanding and following global or assigned area standards, market and customer requirements, and their impact on the current offer portfolio.
* Conducting valuation of market size and trends, as well as competitor analyses including identification of offering gaps and evaluating ABB’s market standing.
* Ensuring whether technical solutions can be used across the Product Group’s offer portfolio to the maximum possible extent.

**Qualifications for the role**

* You have 6-8 years of experience in product management, application engineering, or business development within the weighing, force measurement, process automation, or related industrial sectors.
* You possess knowledge of weighing solutions, applications, and systems, with exposure to industries such as Ferrous and Non-Ferrous metals, mining, cement, power, or other process industries.
* You have experience in managing product portfolios, supporting product lifecycle activities, developing technical documentation, and developing market-oriented product strategies.
* You demonstrate a solid understanding of market trends, customer requirements, competitor offerings, and value proposition development for industrial products and solutions.
* You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related discipline.
* You are motivated by developing innovative customer-centric solutions and collaborating with global stakeholders to support business growth and product performance.
* You are comfortable working in a global matrix organization and engaging with cross-functional teams across product management, sales, engineering, and service.
* You communicate effectively in English, both written and spoken.

**More About Us:**

The Measurement & Analytics Division is among the largest manufacturers and suppliers of smart instrumentation and analyzers, working at the heart of industrial digital transformation. The Measurement & Analytics Division’s portfolio consists of analyzers measuring compositions of gases and liquids; instrumentation measuring process variables such as temperature, pressure, flow, and level; force measurement solutions measuring parameters such as flatness, thickness, and tension; and advanced digital solutions for device management, device health check and predictive maintenance. The Measurement & Analytics Division serves key industries such as oil and gas, chemical, water and wastewater, power, hydrogen, batteries, as well as the marine industry. The Division enables the optimization of industrial processes by providing and analyzing data collected from sensing and smart measurement devices. Parameters such as emission levels and production inputs are measured by providing ‘before’ and ‘after’ values, enabling efficient operations and environmental sustainability through measurement.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

**Job Description Summary**  

This System Value Optimization (SVO) Engineer role is responsible for wind turbine aeroelastic simulations, encompassing New Product Development and Fleet Support as needed. The SVO Engineer will perform state-of-the-art simulations, in accordance to Design Practices and IEC guidelines. This person will be responsible for loads execution and tools and methods development as needed. Preparation of certification documentation will be part of the role of the engineer.

The vision of the SVO team is to create robust yet cost-efficient wind turbine product designs by providing best-in-class load assessment, validation, methods and tools.

  
  
**Job Description**  
  
**Essential Responsibilities**  

* Execute mechanical loads analyses, controller tunings and trade-offs (loads, stability, operation and performance) for new products, cost out, design updates, and fleet support as needed.
* Preparation of loads inputs, creation of the aeroelastic model, execute loads analysis and perform postprocessing is part of the design loop and therefore the responsibilities of the SVO engineer.
* Perform basic operability checks and frequency domain stability checks.
* Update loads envelopes
* Hand off model and controller to MLA team, to execute site specific assessments.
* Perform feasibility studies and develop tech charts.
* Deliver best-in-class loads mitigation and performance optimization technologies to lower Levelized Cost of Energy (LCOE)
* Identify and deliver on ideas for process simplification and tools automation
* Developing specialized knowledge in their discipline. Serves as best practice/quality resource. Has awareness of latest technical developments in own area. Contributes towards strategy and policy development and ensure delivery within area of responsibility.
* Uses judgment to make decisions or solve moderately complex tasks or problems in areas of operational/product management, manufacturing, technology or engineering. Takes new perspective on existing solutions. Uses technical experience and expertise for data analysis to support recommendations. Uses multiple internal and limited external sources outside of own function to arrive at decisions.
* Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience. May lead small projects with moderate risks and resource requirements. Explains difficult or sensitive information; works to build consensus. Developing persuasion skills required to influence others on topics within field.
* Cultivate an atmosphere of team building and learning, driving new methods/ideas for loads and performance improvements
* Effectively communicate to external customers regulators and cross-functionally to sales, product line, and other stakeholders.

  
  
**Qualifications/Requirements**  

* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Wind, Systems, or Aerospace Engineering from accredited university
* Minimum of 5 years experience in Mechanical, Wind, Systems, or Aerospace Engineering

  
  
**Desired Characteristics**  

* Master degree from an accredited university in Mechanical engineering, civil engineering or aerospace engineering
* Experience in aeroelastic simulations.
* Proven ability to work in a cross-functional and global environment
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Working knowledge of aero-elastic simulation platforms: Bladed, HAWC2, Simpack, SDM
* Experience in wind turbine control technologies, operability validation
* Expert knowledge on wind turbine component design criteria

* Demonstrated leadership across business and technical functions, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams while remaining actively engaged in technical solution delivery.
* Demonstrated success taking AI or technology products from **POC through MVP and production deployment**, including user adoption and measurable business outcomes.

  
  
**Desired Characteristics:**   

* **Hands-on AI Proficiency:** Strong practical experience with Python, SQL, APIs, Databricks, and cloud AI technologies, with the ability to personally prototype, test, troubleshoot, and validate AI solutions.
* **Generative and Agentic AI:** Practical knowledge of LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector search, APIs, AI agents, orchestration, evaluation, and production monitoring.
* **Wind Business Expertise:** Strong understanding of Wind Sourcing, supply chain, manufacturing, or related operational value streams and the ability to identify opportunities where AI can improve productivity, cost, quality, cycle time, and decision-making.

jobs.title: Product Manager - UPI
jobs.description:
**About CheQ**

At CheQ, were turning the chaos of credit into a journey that’s clear, rewarding, and even a little fun. With 80,000 Cr+ in lifetime payments, a growing tribe of users (30%+ using more than two products), and $16M raised from marquee investors, we’re fast becoming India’s favorite way to go from credit-stressed to credit-smart.

Founded by ex-Flipkart leader Aditya Soni and backed by 3one4 Capital, Venture Highway, Ram Shriram, Lloyd Mathias and more, CheQ isn’t just another fintech, it’s a full-stack credit experience.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Product Manager to own and scale our UPI Third-Party Application Provider (TPAP) journey. You will be responsible for driving the end-to-end UPI product experience — onboarding, payment flows, reliability, and growth — while working closely with our PSP bank partners and staying aligned with NPCI's evolving rules and guidelines. This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants to build a payment product used by millions of users every day.

  

**What You'll Do**

* Own the end-to-end UPI TPAP product journey — VPA creation, device binding, UPI registration/onboarding, mandate/autopay, collect & pay flows, and transaction lifecycle management.
* Define and drive the product roadmap for scaling UPI as a TPAP, balancing user experience, compliance, and business metrics (success rate, activation, retention).
* Track and implement NPCI circulars, guidelines, and API version updates (UPI 2.0, UPI Lite, UPI Lite X, Credit Line on UPI, AutoPay, RuPay Credit on UPI, etc.) — translating regulatory/technical changes into product and engineering requirements.
* Own product metrics such as transaction success rate (TSR), latency, decline/failure analysis, and NPCI-mandated SLAs; work with engineering and ops to improve them.
* Write detailed PRDs, user stories, and flows; work with design and engineering to ship features.
* Drive UAT, certification testing with NPCI/PSP, and manage go-live checklists for new features or PSP bank additions.
* Analyze transaction and funnel data to identify drop-offs, fraud patterns, and growth opportunities across the UPI stack.
* Collaborate with risk, compliance, and customer support teams to ensure grievance redressal, chargeback, and dispute management flows meet NPCI TAT requirements.
* Liaise with external stakeholders — NPCI, PSP banks, payment aggregators — to unblock issues and represent product interests in ecosystem forums.

  

**What We're Looking For**

* 2–4 years of product management experience, with meaningful exposure to building or scaling a **UPI TPAP product** (fintech, banking, or payments company).
* Strong working knowledge of the **UPI ecosystem** — NPCI, PSP, TPAP roles, transaction flows (P2P, P2M, collect, intent, QR), and the UPI switch architecture.
* Familiarity with **NPCI guidelines and circulars** — onboarding requirements, transaction limits, security protocols, and compliance mandates for TPAPs.
* Proven experience shipping payment products end-to-end — from PRD to launch to post-launch iteration.
* Comfort with data — able to define metrics, analyze funnels (SQL/Excel proficiency preferred), and make data-backed prioritization calls.
* Experience working with PSP banks or NPCI-facing integrations/certifications is a strong plus.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills — you'll coordinate across engineering, design, compliance, risk, and external banking/NPCI partners.
* Strong written communication for PRDs, NPCI documentation responses, and cross-team alignment.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, or related field; MBA is a plus but not mandatory.

  

**Good to Have**

* Exposure to UPI Lite, UPI AutoPay/Mandates, Credit Line on UPI, or UPI International.
* Understanding of payment risk, fraud detection, and chargeback/dispute mechanisms in UPI.
* Prior experience at a fintech app, payment aggregator, PSP bank, or NPCI-linked organization.

  

**Why should you join CheQ**

You own it, we trust you

Shape your work with freedom, deliver with ownership, backed by trust.

Bold, fast & human  
We push boundaries together, and deliver with agility, rigor, and heart. Always looking out for one another.

Growth by osmosis  
Learn directly from a stellar leadership team with rich, diverse backgrounds.

  

**What you’ll not get**

* Monotony Work is dynamic, expect variety every day.
* Slow climbs Growth here is about leaps, not ladders.
* Layers of red tape We believe in speed, not bureaucracy.

jobs.title: Process Engineer 4
jobs.description:
**The group you’ll be a part of**
In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam’s etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry.
  
  
**The impact you’ll make**
As a Process Engineer at Lam, you will operate on cutting-edge technology, harnessing atomic precision, material science, and surface engineering to push technical boundaries. Your role involves developing new and advanced process formulations, defining equipment hardware to meet processing requirements, evaluating test data, and coordinating design requirements to ensure compatibility of processing methods. Your expertise and knowledge play a crucial role our customers success, making an impact on the next generation of semiconductor breakthroughs.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Conduct process engineering research, development, and evaluation in support of Lam’s cutting-edge semiconductor equipment and systems.
* Review and enhance processing techniques and methods applied in the manufacture and fabrication of products.
* Develop and sustain new processes and process improvements to reduce production costs and increase yields.
* Compile and analyze test data to establish next steps in process development and determine appropriate limits and variables for process specifications.
* Collaborate internally to plan, collect data, analyze results, and report on customer demos for existing process applications.
* Partner cross-functionally and with customers to understand roadmaps, process flow, inflection points, requirements, and business challenges.
* Contribute to next generation product development and release activities supporting the semiconductor roadmap.
* Provide leadership, clear direction, and guidance to process technicians to support execution activities.

**Minimum Qualifications**
**Who we’re looking for**

* Master’s degree in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry or Physics or related field with 6+ years of experience; or a PhD with 3+ years’ experience; or equivalent experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with working in a laboratory and on semiconductor equipment with experience in surface preparation and analytical techniques.
* In-depth understanding of Statistical Process Control (SPC) and/or Design of Experiments (DOE).
* Highly proficient in MATLAB, Python, or other similar scientific computing language.
* Working knowledge of statistical analysis and problem-solving methodologies.
* Experience with statistical tools (JMP, Minitab, etc.)
* Background in Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD), Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD), Plasma Enhanced Chemical Vapor Deposition (PECVD), or Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD).
* Background in Plasma Physics, Reactive Ion Etching (RIE), Atomic Layer Etching (ALE), Inductively Coupled Plasma (ICP), Capacitively Coupled Plasma (CCP).
* Knowledge of Material synthesis and material characterization.
* Experience working in a collaborative and matrixed environment with diverse teams, semiconductor customers, and/or partners.
* Experience in semiconductor, process design, deposition, etch dielectrics or conductor, metal films, etc.

**Our commitment**
We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.
  
  
Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.
  
  
*Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.*

**Product Mgr II**

**Do you want to make signing in to Elsevier products simple and secure?**

**Can you build identity and access products together with the product teams who depend on them?**

**About Our Team:-**

Our team owns Identity, Access and API Management for Elsevier. We're focused on making access to our products frictionless and secure, with modern access solutions that make customer onboarding easier and sign-in simpler, without compromising security. We work closely with the product managers of Elsevier's products, and with Technology, Design, Data, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, to solve real customer access problems. **About the Role:-**

As a Product Manager II on our team, you will work toward owning the end-to-end value and outcomes of identity and access features, from discovery through to delivery and adoption. You will act as the voice of the customer, using market insight, customer feedback, and data to identify opportunities and define solutions that make sign-in, onboarding and access management easy for customers, while meeting Elsevier's security and compliance bar.

  

Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will drive product requirements through specs for your feature area (using genAI and Spec-Driven Development (SDD) as part of your process), execute against the roadmap, and keep your features running well day to day. This role is ideal for a product professional who enjoys combining customer insight, a user-centric approach and data-driven decision-making. You'll partner directly with one or two engineering squads, running discovery through to delivery for your slice of the product, within an overall roadmap and prioritisation set by our Senior Product Manager for Identity and Access. **Job Description**

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. **DESCRIPTION**

We are seeking highly motivated and curious **AI** engineers **–** college hires – to join our engineering team and contribute to the development of next-generation AI-powered scientific and business applications.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to learn, design, develop, and test generative **AI and** agentic **AI applications**, intelligent workflows, and solutions powered by large language models (LLMs). You will work alongside experienced engineers, architects, scientists, and product teams to solve real-world problems using modern AI technologies.

You will contribute across the AI application lifecycle, including prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, model evaluation, application development, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement.

This role is ideal for recent graduates who have a strong foundation in software engineering and artificial intelligence and are passionate about applying AI technologies to meaningful scientific and business problems.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Integrate AI applications with REST APIs, databases, microservices, and other enterprise systems.

* Follow modern software engineering practices including version control, CI/CD, documentation, and Agile development.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in **Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology**, or a related technical field.
* Strong programming fundamentals, preferably with **Python**.
* Good understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-orientated programming, and software engineering concepts.
* Foundational understanding of artificial intelligence,machine learning,generative **AI, and Large Language Models**.
* Academic projects, internships, hackathons, research projects, or personal projects involving AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, or software application development.
* Familiarity with prompting and interacting with LLMs such as OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, or equivalent models.
* Basic understanding of **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)** concepts.
* Exposure to AI application frameworks such as **LangChain, LangGraph**, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks is preferred.
* Understanding of AI agents, tool calling, function calling, or autonomous workflows is a plus.
* Familiarity with vector embeddings and vector databases such as ChromaDB, FAISS, Pinecone, or Azure AI Search is a plus.
* Exposure to local LLM technologies such as **Ollama** is a plus.
* Basic understanding of REST APIs, databases, and client-server application development.
* Familiarity with **Git** and modern software development practices.
* Understanding of software testing, debugging, and problem-solving techniques.
* Awareness of responsible AI concepts such as AI safety, privacy, security, guardrails, and output validation.
* Strong analytical thinking and willingness to learn new technologies.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative and Agile development environment.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Internship, academic, research, or project experience developing Generative AI or LLM-based applications.
* Projects demonstrating the use of **LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, AI agents, or multi-agent workflows**.
* Experience building applications that integrate LLMs with APIs, databases, documents, or external tools.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Exposure to Docker, containers, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, or DevOps practices.
* Participation in AI/ML hackathons, open-source projects, technical competitions, research publications, or relevant certifications.

**EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* **0–2 years of relevant experience.**

**WHAT WILL HELP YOU SUCCEED**

* Curiosity and enthusiasm for solving problems using emerging AI technologies.

* Ability to quickly learn new frameworks, models, and development tools.

As AI Commercial & Adoption Manager, you will play a key role in turning AI opportunities into solutions that create measurable and sustainable value for Linde. Depending on the product or initiative, you may act as the Commercial Lead, focusing on business opportunity, value proposition, product definition and scaling, and/ or act as the Adoption Manager, focusing on user readiness, change, adoption and value realization. At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. Every day is an opportunity: an opportunity to learn, to grow, to share success, and to contribute to one of the world’s leading industrial gas and engineering companies. Seize the opportunity: take your next step with us and join our team.  
  
Linde values diversity and recognizes the importance of fostering inclusion in our work environment. We believe that our success depends on the diverse perspectives of our employees, customers, and global markets. As an employer of choice, we strive to support our employees' growth, welcome new ideas, and respect our differences.

Team

Making an impact. **What will you do?**

* In this role you will identify, explore and qualify promising AI opportunities together with businesses, functions and end users.

* Furthermore, you will develop and validate commercial hypotheses, including expected business impact, value potential, target users and success KPIs

* Moreover, you will build stakeholder alignment and secure business sponsorship for selected use cases
* Additionally, you will validate value during pilots and use the results to inform investment and scaling decisions
* Further you will assess global demand and replication potential and develop appropriate scaling approaches
* Furthermore, you will assess the expected adoption effort and identify potential user, organizational and workflow barriers early in the product lifecycle
* In this role you will Develop a fit-for-purpose adoption approach based on the product's user scale, business impact and degree of behavioral change required
* Further you will define adoption objectives, KPIs and measures of success together with Commercial Leads and business stakeholders
* Moreover, you will engage relevant user groups, sponsors, champions and other stakeholders throughout pilots and implementation
* Further you will design and coordinate communication, enablement, training and change activities that support successful product adoption
* Additionally, you will develop repeatable adoption approaches that enable successful products to scale across functions, regions and business units

Winning in your role. **Do you have what it takes?**

For this role you have a Bachelor or Master's Degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science or related field  
Further you have 3+ years of experience in project management, business analysis, or digital transformation roles, preferably in a tech or industrial setting

Further you have strong financial background, analytical, due diligent with business and financial modelling skills, consulting background is a plus

Moreover, to be successful in your role you are a strong communicator

Further you should be strong knowhow in one or two business areas of Linde is preferred  
Furthermore, you should be practical experience with change management, adoption, enablement or organizational transformation, including working directly with users and business stakeholders  
For this role you be strong user orientation and the ability to translate between business needs, user needs and technical teams.  
Additionally, you should be able to connect people and ideas, deduct value, convince and motivate stakeholders in matrix organization and build synergies

**Why you will love working for us!**

You will join a collaborative, globally diverse team, where you will have the opportunity to help shape commercial transformation initiatives, work with digital technologies, and contribute to ABB's growth strategy.

jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**  
  

“We Power the Magic!” That’s our motto at Disney Experiences (DX). Our team creates world-class immersive digital experiences for the Company’s premier vacation brands including Disney’s Parks & Resorts worldwide, Disney Cruise Line, Aulani, a Disney Resort & Spa, and Disney Vacation Club.

We are responsible for the end-to-end digital and physical Guest experience for all technology & digital-led initiatives across the Attractions & Entertainment, Food & Beverage, Resorts & Transportation and Merchandise lines of business as well as other initiatives including MyDisneyExperience and Hey, Disney!

As a Senior Software Engineer within Disney Experiences Technology, you will help create immersive digital products that bring Disney’s stories to life across theme parks, resorts, cruise vacations, and consumer experiences worldwide. In this role, you will operate as a skilled, independent worker who solves complex problems, mentors less experienced colleagues, and contributes effective, high-quality solutions that enhance guest and business experiences.

**Responsibilities:**

In this role, you will design, build, test, and maintain software solutions that support end-to-end guest and business journeys across Disney Experiences, from travel and vacation planning to in-park and retail interactions. You will work with minimal guidance, act as a resource for teammates, and apply your problem-solving skills to deliver effective, scalable systems that help Disney provide creative, customer-focused, and innovative experiences around the world. This role matters because it ensures our technology is reliable, performant, and easy to evolve, requiring a proficient engineer who is detail-oriented, collaborative, and able to explain complex concepts clearly.

* Conceive, design, develop, test, and implement software components, enhancements, fixes, and new applications across web and cloud-based platforms.
* Contribute to and sometimes lead the design and implementation of custom applications, integrations, microservices, and APIs that support high-volume, highly scalable systems.
* Work independently to deliver assigned tasks from planning through implementation, adapting to changing business requirements while maintaining code quality and performance.
* Participate in agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, demos, retrospectives) and collaborate with product, design, QA, and other stakeholders to define scalable, maintainable solutions.
* Perform regular code reviews, enforce coding standards, and support unit, behavioral, and integration testing to ensure high-quality, secure, and performant software.
* Monitor applications using tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics, or similar solutions, troubleshoot production issues, and proactively improve system reliability and run quality.
* Explain difficult or sensitive technical concepts to non-technical partners and collaborate across teams to align on requirements, architecture, and implementation approaches.
* Offer guidance and informal mentorship to junior engineers by sharing best practices, providing constructive feedback, and modeling effective problem-solving approaches.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Strong proficiency in Java for building production-grade, scalable applications and services.
* Experience developing front-end applications using JavaScript frameworks such as Angular and/or React, and back-end services using Node.js.
* Knowledge of microservices architectures, RESTful web services, and API design for high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems.
* Proficiency in object-oriented programming, design principles, and common design patterns for multi-tier web applications.
* Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging technologies such as Pub/Sub or Kafka.
* Strong knowledge of unit testing, behavioral or component testing, and continuous integration practices and tools.
* Experience using monitoring and logging tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics, New Relic, or similar platforms to support production systems.
* Ability to work effectively in agile teams, collaborate with cross-functional partners, and communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality solutions.
* Minimum Required Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Years Of Experience: 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including full software development lifecycle responsibilities.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience developing cloud-based or cloud-native solutions using AWS or similar platforms, including managed and serverless technologies such as Docker, ECS, Lambda, or Kubernetes.
* Database design and implementation experience with both relational and NoSQL databases, such as MariaDB, DynamoDB, or MongoDB.
* Experience with QA and software analytics tools, CI/CD pipelines, and automated release management systems.
* Background in hospitality, travel, vacation ownership, licensing, or commerce-related domains.

  
**Disclaimer**  

This position is with Walt Disney Attractions Technology LLC, which is part of a business we call Disney Experiences.

Strong problem-solving aptitude with innovative thinking for method troubleshooting. d. Effective technical communication skills to support customers, teams, and training sessions

jobs.description:
* **Technical Lead Engineer -Electrical**

    
    

  **Your Role:**

    

  The Technical Lead Engineer - Electrical is responsible for leading the design, development, validation, and delivery of electronic hardware solutions for automotive applications. This role serves as the primary technical focal point for assigned products, systems, or projects, ensuring robust, high-quality, and cost-effective designs that meet customer and business requirements.

  The Technical Lead Engineer provides technical leadership across the product development lifecycle, coordinates cross-functional engineering activities, drives technical decision-making, and supports the professional development of team members.

  In addition to individual design responsibility, the **Technical Lead Engineer -Electrical** is expected to drive technical decisions, lead design reviews, resolve complex cross-functional issues, mentor engineers and ensure that hardware designs meet customer, quality, reliability, cost and timing objectives.

    
    

  This distinction is aligned with your internal career framework, where progression moves from supervised design to independent design and subsequently to technical mentoring, expert knowledge and leadership of complex problem resolution.

    
    

  **Key Responsibilities**

  + Lead the design, development, validation, and delivery of electronic hardware solutions for automotive applications.
  + Define and drive technical solutions, ensuring compliance with customer requirements, engineering standards, quality objectives, and project targets.
  + Serve as the technical lead for assigned products, systems, or projects, providing direction and guidance throughout the development lifecycle.
  + Coordinate and align activities across cross-functional teams, including Systems, Software, Mechanical, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain.
  + Lead technical reviews, risk assessments, issue resolution, and root cause analysis activities.
  + Provide technical leadership in design changes, deviation assessments, and escalation management.
  + Support customer and supplier interactions by representing the hardware engineering organization in technical discussions and reviews.
  + Mentor and support engineers through coaching, knowledge sharing, and technical guidance.
  + Drive continuous improvement initiatives, engineering best practices, design reuse, and innovation.
  + Ensure successful execution of project deliverables with accountability for technical quality, timing, and performance.

  **Technical ownership**

  + Own electrical design of an ECU, major subsystem or complex electronic module.
  + Translate system/customer requirements into robust HW architecture and detailed electrical requirements.
  + Define processor/SoC, memory, PMIC, power, communication and peripheral architecture.
  + Make component and design trade-offs considering technical performance, cost, availability, qualification, lifecycle and supply-chain risk.
  + Drive schematic design from concept through design freeze and production release.

  **Design analysis & technical sign-off**

  + Drive SI, PI, WCCA, power sequencing, timing and electrical-interface analysis.
  + Review simulation results and ensure appropriate design margins.
  + Lead schematic and PCB design reviews.
  + Review critical high-speed, high-current, RF-sensitive and EMC-sensitive PCB implementation.
  + Define technical risk mitigation before DV/PV.

  **Bring-up, debug & problem solving**

  + Lead complex board bring-up and HW/SW integration debugging.
  + Define structured root-cause-analysis approaches for electrical, EMC and environmental failures.
  + Use measurements and engineering analysis to differentiate HW, SW, component, PCB and system-level issues.
  + Drive corrective actions and verify effectiveness.
  + Provide technical leadership during critical program escalations.

  **EMC, validation & design robustness**

  + Drive design-for-EMC principles early in the architecture and PCB design.
  + Review EMC/EMI test plans and results.
  + Lead resolution of radiated/conducted emissions, immunity and ESD issues.
  + Evaluate electrical/environmental validation failures and determine design impact.
  + Ensure appropriate design margin and robustness before design release.

  **Cross-functional technical leadership**

  + Work closely with Systems, ECAD, Mechanical, EMC, Software, Validation, Functional Safety, Manufacturing and Component Engineering teams.
  + Interface technically with semiconductor and component suppliers.
  + Support customer technical discussions and design reviews.
  + Mentor junior engineers and improve engineering methods, checklists and reusable design solutions.
  + Drive lessons learned and reuse across programs.

  **Required Qualifications**

  + Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics/Electronics & Communication Engineering or equivalent.
  + Typically 8–12+ years of automotive or equivalent complex electronic hardware design experience.
  + Strong hands-on electronic circuit design and debugging capability.
  + Strong understanding of SoCs/MCUs, memories, PMICs, power supplies and communication interfaces.
  + Experienced in schematic design, PCB design reviews and component selection.
  + Practical knowledge of SI/PI/WCCA and EMC/EMI design.
  Experience taking hardware through prototype DV PV+ production.
  + Demonstrated capability to independently solve complex electrical/system problems.
  + Ability to lead technical reviews and communicate technical risks to engineering and program leadership.
