jobs.title: Senior Manager - R&D (Hair Care)
jobs.description:
**Role Purpose**
The Senior Manager - R&D will lead end-to-end formulation innovation and execution for Purplle’s private labels and exclusive brands.
  
  
This role is responsible not only for product formulation delivery, but also for development of new molecules, actives, and proprietary technology platforms that create sustainable differentiation for Purplle brands. The role demands a strong blend of deep technical expertise, commercial judgment, and execution speed.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**- 1. Product & Formula Development (Core Ownership)
- Own end-to-end formulation development across skincare, haircare, personal care, and colour cosmetics:

* Benchmarking (India & global),Lab-scale formulation & Optimization for performance, cost, and scale

- Translate brand briefs into high-performing, scalable, and consumer-relevant formulas.
- Drive fast prototyping and rapid iteration to support aggressive launch timelines.
- Ensure formulas are aligned with:

* Indian consumer needs, Clean / conscious beauty trends, Derma-led & performance-driven positioning
* 2. New Molecules, Actives & Technology Development
* Lead development of new molecules, active systems, and delivery technologies, including Novel active blends, Encapsulation & delivery systems, Texture & sensorial platforms, Preservation and stability innovations
* Lead development of new molecules, active systems, and delivery technologies, including Novel active blends, Encapsulation & delivery systems, Texture & sensorial platforms, Preservation and stability innovations
* Partner with Raw material suppliers, Global ingredient innovators, Research labs & technology partners
* Evaluate and translate emerging cosmetic technologies into commercially viable products.
* Build proprietary or semi-exclusive technology platforms that can be leveraged across multiple SKUs and brands.
* Support IP generation, documentation, and claim substantiation for new technologies.
* 3. Scale-Up, Manufacturing & Tech Transfer
* Lead formula scale-up with contract manufacturers - Pilot batches, Trial runs, First commercial batches
* Lead formula scale-up with contract manufacturers - Pilot batches, Trial runs, First commercial batches
* Own tech transfer including SOPs, BMRs, Critical process parameters
* Troubleshoot scale-up challenges related to Rheology changes, Sensory drift,Yield loss and Stability failures
* 4. Regulatory, Safety & Compliance
* Ensure all formulations comply with:

+ Indian Cosmetics Rules (CDSCO)
+ Global regulations (ASEAN / EU / US where applicable)

* Work closely with regulatory teams on:

+ Ingredient approvals
+ Safety & toxicology inputs
+ Claim substantiation support

* Anticipate regulatory risks early to avoid launch delays.
* 5. Costing, Margin & Commercial Viability
* Own formulation-level costing and BOM accuracy.
* Drive cost optimization while maintaining product performance.
* Partner with sourcing and finance teams to Optimize raw material choices and Balance innovation vs. gross margin targets
* Lead reformulation initiatives for cost-down or compliance updates.
* 6. Team Leadership & Capability Building
* Lead, mentor, and develop formulation teams.
* Define Formulation SOPs, documentation standards, Stability & testing protocols
* Build a strong internal knowledge base for actives, technologies, and formulations.
* 7. Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Work closely with Brand & Marketing (claims, sensorials, storytelling), Packaging (compatibility, dispensing, sustainability), Quality, Regulatory & Supply Chain
* Work closely with Brand & Marketing (claims, sensorials, storytelling), Packaging (compatibility, dispensing, sustainability), Quality, Regulatory & Supply Chain
* Act as the technical authority translating consumer insight into executable innovation.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* M.Sc / M.Tech / PhD in Cosmetic Science, Chemistry, Pharmaceutics, or Chemical Engineering
* 10+ years of formulation development experience
* Proven experience in Skincare & haircare (mandatory), Actives & technology-led product development
* Proven experience in Skincare & haircare (mandatory), Actives & technology-led product development
* Hands-on experience working with Indian & global contract manufacturers and Raw material innovators
* Prior experience managing formulation teams

**Skills & Competencies**

* Deep expertise in Emulsions, surfactants, anhydrous systems, Actives, delivery systems, preservatives
* Strong understanding of Stability, compatibility, and scale-up science
* Commercial acumen and execution mindset
* Strong stakeholder management skills

**About Company**
Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.
  
  
Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.
  
  
What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.
  
  
In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.
  
  
With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

jobs.title: Innovation Manager (Hair Care)
jobs.description:
**Company overview:**

PEP is a dynamic personal care company that proudly houses two innovative brands –
**mCaffeine & Hyphen**
. With a passion for creating high-performance, conscious, and consumer-loved products, we are redefining the way personal care is experienced. While mCaffeine is India’s first caffeinated personal care brand, loved for its energizing and playful approach, Hyphen is built on the philosophy of simplifying skincare through science-backed formulations. Together, our brands reflect PEP’s mission to deliver quality, creativity, and care to millions of consumers. We believe in Confidence over all skin & body biases.

**Come, join the pack!**

**Job Summary :**
We're looking for a
**Lead - R&D (Hair Care)**
to own formulation and development for our Hair Care portfolio — shampoos, conditioners, hair masks, hair oils, hair serums and scalp care. This is a senior, hands-on role for a formulator who has built and launched multiple hair care products and understands surfactant chemistry, conditioning science and scalp health in depth. You'll drive new launches, upgrade our top sellers, guide a small team, and be the technical expert for everything hair and scalp.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* End-to-End Formulation: Formulate shampoos, conditioners, masks, hair oils, leave-in serums, and scalp/hair-fall treatments from concept brief through commercial launch, tailored to Indian hair types, water hardness, and climate.
* Technical Expertise: Build mild, high-performing surfactant systems; develop conditioning treatments for frizz control and shine; create non-sticky oils/serums; and formulate compliant anti-dandruff and hair-growth solutions using actives like caffeine and peptides.
* Testing, Stability & Compliance: Oversee stability, compatibility, and preservative challenge studies; manage performance (tress/salon) and external clinical claims testing; and maintain technical dossiers aligned with CDSCO/BIS standards.
* Product Upgrades & Cost Optimization: Reformulate top-selling SKUs to boost performance and sensorials, drive cost savings via formula/process improvements, and build an alternate ingredient library to de-risk supply.
* Scale-Up & Leadership: Lead tech transfer and first-batch supervision with contract manufacturers, mentor 1–3 junior formulators, partner cross-functionally for on-time launches, and scout global hair care trends.

**Skills and Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Cosmetic Science/Technology, Chemistry, Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cosmetic Science/Technology, Chemistry, Pharmacy, or related field
* 7–10 years of hands-on cosmetics/personal care R&D experience, with hair care as the primary focus
* Proven track record of personally formulating and launching shampoos, conditioners, hair oils, masks and/or scalp care products
* Strong command of surfactant chemistry, conditioning science, rheology/thickening systems, preservation and stability troubleshooting
* Experience with hair performance testing and hair fall / anti-dandruff claims substantiation
* Working knowledge of CDSCO/BIS regulations for hair care, including limits on anti-dandruff and other regulated actives
* High ownership and comfort with pace and ambiguity in a start-up / fast-scaling D2C environment

jobs.title: New Product Development Lead - Foods
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
Vitalpro Consumer Pvt Ltd is an emerging leader in India’s hospitality and food and beverage sector, known for its innovative and quality-driven approach. The company builds beloved brands such as Saffron & Mishri, which reimagines traditional Indian mithai, and 224 Craftery, which blends global chocolate-making craft with flavors tailored to Indian tastes. Vitalpro focuses on creating memorable culinary experiences that balance tradition with modernity, backed by data-driven insights, precision marketing, and hyper-personalized engagement. With a strong emphasis on creativity, excellence, and people development, the company aims to transform India’s food culture while offering team members a growth-oriented, purpose-led career journey.

**Experience:**
6–12 Years

**Location:**
Mumbai

**Reporting To:**
Founder / Business Head

Role Overview

We are looking for a passionate and experienced New Product Development Lead to drive food innovation across our brands.

The role will be responsible for conceptualising, developing and commercialising differentiated food products across traditional Indian sweets, contemporary confectionery, chocolates, snacking and other food categories.

The ideal candidate should bring a strong understanding of food science, ingredients, formulations, processing technologies and consumer trends, combined with the creativity to develop exciting products and the execution capability to scale them commercially.

Key Responsibilities1. Product Innovation & Concept Development

* Drive the end-to-end new product development pipeline across food categories.
* Identify emerging consumer trends, consumption occasions and product opportunities.
* Develop innovative concepts across mithai, confectionery, chocolates, snacks and other food categories.
* Experiment with new ingredients, flavours, textures, formats and processing techniques.
* Develop differentiated products combining Indian food heritage with contemporary tastes and formats.
* Create product concepts aligned with brand positioning and consumer expectations.

2. Formulation & Product Development

* Lead product formulation, ingredient selection and recipe development.
* Conduct kitchen and laboratory trials to optimise taste, texture, appearance and overall product experience.
* Work on sugar reduction, ingredient optimisation, nutritional profiles and shelf-life enhancement.
* Explore new ingredients, functional ingredients and food technologies.
* Develop alternatives to existing formulations wherever required.
* Ensure products meet applicable FSSAI and food safety requirements.

3. Process Development & Commercialisation

* Translate prototype formulations into scalable commercial products.
* Develop manufacturing processes, process parameters and standard operating procedures.
* Work closely with manufacturing teams to establish production feasibility.
* Identify suitable equipment, technologies and manufacturing processes.
* Drive pilot batches, production trials and product validation.
* Ensure consistency and repeatability across production batches.

4. Quality, Shelf Life & Packaging

* Develop products with appropriate shelf life and stability.
* Work on preservation technologies, packaging compatibility and storage conditions.
* Conduct sensory evaluations, stability studies and shelf-life trials.
* Establish product specifications, quality benchmarks and acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with packaging teams to identify suitable packaging solutions.

5. Costing & Commercial Viability

* Develop product costing and optimise ingredient costs.
* Ensure formulations meet target gross margins without compromising product quality.
* Identify alternative ingredients and vendors.
* Evaluate scalability, manufacturing efficiency and commercial viability.
* Work towards improving product economics through formulation and process optimisation.

6. Cross-functional Collaboration

* Work closely with marketing and brand teams to translate consumer insights into product propositions.
* Collaborate with procurement on ingredient sourcing and vendor development.
* Partner with manufacturing and quality teams for product commercialisation.
* Coordinate with packaging, sales and business teams to ensure successful launches.
* Build and maintain a structured product development calendar and innovation pipeline.

Desired Skills & Experience

* 6–12 years of experience in food product development, R&D or food innovation.
* Degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Food Engineering or a related discipline.
* Strong understanding of food ingredients, formulations and processing technologies.
* Experience in developing and commercialising food products at scale.
* Knowledge of shelf-life enhancement, preservation systems and food packaging technologies.
* Understanding of food safety standards, FSSAI regulations and quality systems.
* Strong analytical, experimentation and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to balance creativity, product quality, cost and commercial feasibility.
* Experience working in FMCG, food manufacturing, confectionery or packaged foods preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of successful new product launches.
* Speed and efficiency of product development.
* Product quality, consistency and consumer acceptance.
* Shelf-life and product stability performance.
* Achievement of target product costs and gross margins.
* Successful scale-up from laboratory trials to commercial production.
* Innovation pipeline and launch calendar delivery.

The Ideal Candidate

A food innovator who combines the mind of a food scientist with the creativity of a product developer and the execution mindset of an FMCG professional.

Someone who is passionate about food, constantly curious about ingredients and technologies, and capable of converting exciting ideas into differentiated, scalable and commercially successful products.

jobs.title: Team Leader
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
Syngenta Bioscience Private Limited (SBPL) is one of Syngenta's three global Research & Technology centers, our Goa facility stands at the forefront of agricultural innovation. Our world-class team specializes in developing novel active ingredients, pioneering sustainable synthesis routes and advancing cutting-edge chemical technologies. We have diverse scientific talent pool, with deep expertise in organic chemistry, drives solutions that enhance global food security and sustainable agriculture. At SBPL Goa, we combine scientific excellence with meaningful career growth opportunities, contributing directly to Syngenta's mission of feeding a growing world sustainably.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Purpose**
Lead the Analytical team of 5 to 6 scientists in delivering reliable, timely and compliant analytical support to Product Chemistry, Formulation Development, Technology & Sourcing, Manufacturing and Quality. The role requires strong technical expertise, structured problem solving, people leadership, and effective communication with internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Technical and Operational Excellence**

* Lead analytical testing, method development, validation, transfer, verification and troubleshooting activities for active ingredients, intermediates, formulations and relevant raw materials.
* Ensure methods, instruments, laboratory systems and data meet applicable Quality, Health Safety and Environment (HSE), Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and data-integrity requirements.
* Provide expert scientific judgement for complex deviations, out-of-specification results, investigations, root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions.
* Drive laboratory efficiency, robustness and continuous improvement through fit-for-purpose technologies, standardization, automation and lean ways of working.
* Ensure high-quality technical reports, analytical documentation and defensible scientific data to support product, process and regulatory decisions.
* Manage laboratory resources, priorities, capacity, equipment readiness and budget to meet agreed service levels.

**People Leadership**

* Build a capable, engaged and inclusive Analytical team through clear objectives, regular feedback, coaching and performance management.
* Develop technical capability, succession pipelines and individual development plans using structured learning, peer learning and on-the-job experience.
* Promote a culture of scientific curiosity, ownership, collaboration, safety, quality and continuous improvement.
* Recruit, retain and develop talent; ensure appropriate competency assessment and training for laboratory roles.
* Lead by example in applying Syngenta behaviours and creating a respectful, diverse and rightful working environment. The internal people-management framework highlights talent development, coaching and inclusive leadership as core expectations.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Partner closely with Product Chemistry, Process Technology, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Supply, HSE and external laboratories/suppliers.
* Translate business and technical needs into clear analytical strategies, plans, priorities and realistic delivery commitments.
* Communicate complex analytical findings clearly and influence decisions at project, site and regional levels.
* Manage stakeholder expectations proactively, escalating risks, resource constraints and technical issues early with practical options for resolution.
* Represent Analytical in cross-functional project teams, audits, technical reviews and customer/regulatory interactions where required.

**Key Interfaces**
Internal: Product Chemistry, Process Technology, Manufacturing, Quality Assurance/Quality Control, Regulatory Affairs, HSE, Production & Supply Chain, Research, HR and Finance.
  
  
External: Contract research/testing laboratories, equipment vendors, consultants, auditors and regulatory bodies.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* A PhD or Post Doc with specialization in Analytical Chemistry is preferred OR Organic chemistry or allied sciences qualification with high exposure to analytical and or formulation activity from a reputed institution in India or abroad. A 10+ years of experience analytical laboratory experience, including 5+ years leading teams or technical workstreams. OR
* Master’s degree in chemistry preferable analytical or allied Science, area from the reputed Universities with strong academic records and good communication skills Typically, 15+ years of relevant analytical laboratory experience, including 5+ years leading teams or technical workstreams.
* Deep practical experience with chromatographic and spectroscopic techniques, e.g., HPLC/UPLC, GC, LC-MS/GC-MS, IC, UV-Vis, IR and particle/physical-characterisation techniques as relevant to the function.
* Demonstrated experience in analytical method lifecycle management, validation, transfer, stability/support testing, data review and investigation leadership.
* Experience working in a regulated quality environment (GLP etc.,) and leading stakeholder-facing technical projects.

**Essential Competencies**

* Technical expertise: recognised analytical subject-matter expertise; sound scientific judgement; disciplined problem-solving.
* People leadership: develops people, gives clear feedback, manages performance and builds inclusive, accountable teams.
* Stakeholder management: communicates with influence, builds trust and aligns diverse functional priorities.
* Delivery focus: plans effectively, manages risk and resources, and delivers to agreed quality, cost and timeline commitments.
* Continuous improvement: challenges inefficient practices and converts learning into sustainable laboratory improvements.
* Quality, safety and integrity: demonstrates uncompromising commitment to HSE, quality systems and data integrity.

**Additional Information**
**People are at the heart of what we do:**

* Once a year Full body check
* Competitive insurance scheme
* Employee assistance program – to take care of your and your loved ones mental health
* Paid Vacation of 30days, 12 Paid Holidays, Maternity and Paternity Leave, compassionate leaves
* Education assistance – for your career growth
* People first culture translated into ‘Most Preferred place to work 2022-23 by Times group’

Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. Learn more about our D&I initiatives here: https://www.syngenta.com/careers/working-syngenta/diversity-and-inclusion

jobs.title: RGM Lead
jobs.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you'd like, where you'll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you'll be able to reimagine what's possible. Join us and help the world's leading organizations

****Your Role****   
  

The RGM Lead sits within the CI RGM Pricing Pod and leads advanced revenue-growth-management analytics and decision support across pricing, promotions, pack-price architecture, trade investment and channel / mix strategy. The role converts elasticity, gross-to-net, regulatory and commercial evidence into recommendations that improve sustainable net revenue, margin and trade-investment returns, while setting analytical standards and developing RGM capability across the team.

  

****In this role you will play key role in****   
  

* Lead analysis of price elasticity, price gaps, willingness-to-pay and promotion effectiveness across brands, packs, channels and markets; distinguish true incremental volume from subsidized baseline sales.
* Own pricing and trade-spend scenario modelling, including list-price / net-price bridges, gross-to-net waterfalls, promotional depth and frequency, trade terms, and trade-investment ROI.
* Recommend pack-price architecture, price ladders, mix and channel strategies that balance consumer affordability, competitive position, revenue, margin and share objectives.
* Provide RGM input into pricing cycles, annual operating plans, forecasts and commercial reviews, translating model outputs into clear decisions, risks and value opportunities.
* Assess the commercial impact of changes in excise, tax, minimum-pricing, price-cap, promotion and other relevant regulatory requirements; develop scenarios and mitigation options with Finance, Legal / Regulatory and Commercial teams.
* Lead cross-functional RGM workstreams with Sales, Finance, Category, Brand, Insights and market teams, ensuring aligned assumptions, approved methodologies and traceable recommendations.
* Establish analytical standards, model QA, assumptions governance and reusable scenario templates; improve automation and repeatability using SQL and, where appropriate, Python / R.
* Coach and upskill new and existing team members on elasticity, pricing mechanics, trade terms, gross-to-net, promotion analytics and RGM storytelling; review complex outputs before senior stakeholder use.

  

****Your Profile****   
  

* 12+ years of relevant experience in Revenue Growth Management, pricing, commercial analytics, category / customer strategy or related CPG / FMCG roles, with significant hands-on pricing and trade-investment experience.
* Strong quantitative and modelling capability using advanced Microsoft Excel and SQL; practical Python / R exposure is valuable for scalable modelling and sensitivity analysis.
* Deep understanding of price elasticity and willingness-to-pay approaches; experience with conjoint / discrete-choice modelling or comparable pricing research techniques is strongly preferred.
* Strong command of pricing mechanics, price-pack architecture, trade terms, promotion effectiveness, gross-to-net waterfalls and trade-investment ROI.
* Working knowledge of excise, tax and pricing / promotion regulation and the ability to model the commercial impact of regulatory changes.
* Ability to connect consumer, competitor, customer and financial evidence into commercially actionable recommendations for senior leadership.
* Proven experience coaching analysts, governing model quality and raising RGM capability across a team or distributed delivery environment.

  

****What you will love working here****   
  

* Exposure to cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven solutions, and data-led decision making.
* Collaborative and inclusive work culture focused on innovation and continuous learning.
* Global career growth opportunities across diverse industries and markets.
* Work with talented professionals who are passionate about creating business impact and delivering excellence.

jobs.title: Toxicology- Research Associate/Research Officer
jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

**Job Summary**

Responsible for conducting and documenting regulatory toxicological assessments for pharmaceutical APIs and impurities, including nitrosamine risk assessments, in-silico mutagenicity evaluations, Permitted Daily Exposure (PDE) assessments, and Occupational Exposure Limit (OEL) assessments in accordance with applicable regulatory guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Nitrosamine Risk Assessment**

* Conduct nitrosamine risk assessments for pharmaceutical APIs and drug products in accordance with applicable regulatory guidance, including FDA, EMA, and ICH recommendations.
* Evaluate potential nitrosamine formation, contamination risks, and N-nitrosamine drug substance-related impurities (NDSRIs).
* Assess acceptable intake (AI) limits and permissible impurity limits based on applicable regulatory guidance.
* Review and interpret regulatory updates concerning nitrosamine impurities.

**Mutagenicity and Genotoxicity Assessment**

* Review bacterial reverse mutation (Ames) test data and relevant literature.
* Assess the need for additional testing, including Enhanced Ames Test (EAT), where applicable.
* Coordinate with external laboratories for study initiation, sample dispatch, protocol review, data follow-up, and report evaluation.
* Review study findings and prepare scientific justifications to address regulatory queries.

**In-Silico Toxicological Assessment**

* Perform mutagenicity assessments using computational toxicology tools such as Derek and Sarah Nexus, as applicable.
* Conduct QSAR assessments using CaseUltra or equivalent software.
* Interpret structural alerts, supporting databases, experimental Ames data, and structurally relevant reference compounds.
* Prepare scientifically justified expert judgement reports for the assessment and dismissal of alerts, where appropriate.
* Evaluate available experimental data and determine the need for additional testing based on the weight of evidence.

**PDE and OEL Assessment**

* Perform toxicological assessments to establish PDE and OEL values for pharmaceutical APIs and impurities.
* Identify and evaluate relevant toxicological endpoints, NOAEL/LOAEL values, and supporting published literature.
* Apply appropriate uncertainty factors and route-specific considerations in accordance with applicable guidance.
* Prepare scientifically justified toxicological reports and occupational exposure assessments.

**Regulatory Research and Documentation**

* Review relevant guidelines, including ICH M7, IVH Q3B, ICH S9, and applicable nitrosamine guidance
* Conduct literature searches and evaluate relevant nonclinical and clinical safety data.
* Prepare technical reports, risk assessment documents, and responses to regulatory queries.
* Maintain traceable references, supporting evidence, and audit ready documentation

**Cross-functional coordination**

* Coordinate with Regulatory affairs, quality Assurance, R and D and other relevant teams
* Communicate with external laboratories and consultants regarding toxicology studies and technical requirements
* Support internal; review, audits and regulatory submission related to toxicological assessments.

**Required Qualifications**

* Masters degree in Toxicology, Regulatory Toxicology, Pharmacy Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a relevant life-sciences discipline.
* Understanding of pharmaceutical toxicology, genotoxicity, impurity assessment, and regulatory guidelines.
* Experience with Scientific literature review and technical report preparation

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you'd like, where you'll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you'll be able to reimagine what's possible. Join us and help the world's leading organizations

****Your Role****  

The Advanced Analytics Lead is responsible for leading the design, development, deployment and optimization of advanced analytical solutions that enable data-driven commercial decision-making and measurable business impact. The role focuses on delivering scalable solutions across demand forecasting, price elasticity, promotion effectiveness and commercial analytics while mentoring analytics practitioners and establishing best practices.

  

****In this role you will play key role in****  

Demand Forecasting and Planning Analytics

Model Deployment and Performance Monitoring

  

Analytics Capability Development.

  

Price Elasticity and Pricing Analytics

  

Commercial Performance Analytics

  

Revenue Growth Management Analytics

Predictive Analytics

  

Statistical Modelling Machine Learning Application

  

****Your Profile****  

* 12-15+ years of experience in Advanced Analytics, Data Science, Statistical Modelling or Predictive Analytics environments. Proven experience delivering analytical solutions supporting commercial decision-making and mentoring analytics practitioners.

  

* Strong hands-on expertise in Python/R, SQL, statistical modelling, machine learning, predictive analytics, and advanced forecasting methodologies.

  

* Experience working with cloud-based data and analytics platforms (e.g., Databricks) and deploying analytical solutions within enterprise environments.

  

****What will you love working in Capgemini****  

* Exposure to cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven solutions, and data-led decision making.
* Collaborative and inclusive work culture focused on innovation and continuous learning.
* Global career growth opportunities across diverse industries and markets.
* Work with talented professionals who are passionate about creating business impact and delivering excellence.

jobs.title: Executive/ Manager - Product Development & Commercialisation
jobs.description:
**Organisation:** GCV Life Pvt. Ltd. (GCViDEAL)**Job Title:** Executive/ Manager - Product Development & Commercialisation

**Job type:** On site

**Location:** Chakala, Mumbai

**About the Role**

Responsible for managing and coordinating the end-to-end product development, formulation development, manufacturing, quality, regulatory and supply-chain activities for nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, personal care and allied product categories.

The role involves translating client requirements and market opportunities into commercially viable products through coordination with contract manufacturers, ingredient suppliers, packaging vendors, internal business development teams and quality/regulatory functions.

**Key Responsibilities**A. Product Development & NPD

· Manage the product development lifecycle from initial concept and client requirement assessment to formulation finalisation, sampling, validation and commercial manufacturing.

· Evaluate new product opportunities based on market trends, consumer requirements, ingredient innovations and commercial feasibility.

· Coordinate with contract manufacturers and technical teams for new product development across nutraceutical, functional food, pharmaceutical and personal care categories.

· Drive formulation development, optimisation and improvement in terms of ingredient selection, active concentrations, excipient systems, flavour profiles, stability and product performance.

· Evaluate innovative delivery formats, including gummies, powders, sachets, tablets, capsules, liquids, RTDs and other functional formats.

· Coordinate prototype development, sample evaluation, sensory assessment and subsequent formulation modifications.

· Prepare and manage New Product Development (NPD/NPDP) documentation and development timelines.

· Coordinate technical feasibility assessments for new ingredients, formulations, processing technologies and product formats.

B. Contract Manufacturing, Technical Coordination and Scale up

· Identify, evaluate and coordinate with third-party manufacturing partners based on technical capabilities, product requirements, quality standards, certifications and commercial feasibility.

· Conduct manufacturing facility visits and technical assessments to evaluate production capabilities, infrastructure, processes and quality systems.

· Coordinate product development and commercial manufacturing activities with external manufacturing partners.

· Review manufacturing feasibility, process limitations, production capacities, minimum order quantities and lead times.

· Monitor manufacturing progress, identify bottlenecks and coordinate corrective actions to ensure timely execution.

· Establish manufacturing timelines and align internal and external stakeholders on development, procurement, production and dispatch schedules.

· Coordinate with manufacturing partners for process improvements, production optimisation and resolution of technical issues.

C. Quality Assurance & Quality Control Coordination

· Coordinate manufacturer QA/QC teams to establish and maintain product quality standards.

· Review product specifications, Certificates of Analysis (COAs), raw material documentation and finished product quality parameters.

· Establish and coordinate quality checkpoints across product development, sampling, manufacturing and finished goods evaluation.

· Coordinate product testing, analytical evaluation, stability studies and quality investigations.

· Review product samples for sensory attributes, physical characteristics and compliance with agreed specifications.

· Identify quality deviations and coordinate corrective and preventive actions with manufacturing partners.

· Ensure alignment between approved product specifications, manufacturing requirements and final commercial batches.

· Support quality documentation and product release-related activities.

D. Regulatory Affairs & Compliance

· Coordinate regulatory requirements for product development, manufacturing and commercialisation.

· Support FSSAI compliance, including product documentation, ingredient permissibility, product categorisation and labelling requirements.

· Review product labels, ingredient declarations, nutritional information, claims and regulatory artwork.

· Coordinate with regulatory teams and manufacturing partners for required licences, certifications, declarations and technical documentation.

· Support preparation and review of Free Sale Certificates, product descriptions, technical dossiers and other export-related documentation.

· Coordinate regulatory feasibility assessments for domestic and international product opportunities.

· Ensure product development and commercialisation activities remain aligned with applicable regulatory requirements.

E. Product Costing & Commercial Feasibility

· Coordinate product costing exercises for new and existing products.

· Evaluate ingredient costs, excipient systems, manufacturing charges, packaging costs and other associated expenses.

· Work with manufacturers and suppliers to obtain commercial quotations and develop product cost sheets.

· Identify opportunities for formulation optimisation, alternative ingredient sourcing and manufacturing efficiencies to improve product economics.

· Evaluate MOQ, batch sizes, production yields and manufacturing feasibility against commercial requirements.

· Support business development teams with technical and commercial inputs during client discussions and product proposals.

· Assess product feasibility from both technical and commercial perspectives before proceeding with development or commercial production.

F. Product Portfolio & Market Research

· Conduct market research to identify emerging nutraceutical ingredients, product formats, consumer trends and innovation opportunities.

· Evaluate new ingredients and technologies for potential inclusion in the company's product portfolio.

· Analyse competitor products, market positioning, formulation approaches and potential differentiation opportunities.

· Identify opportunities for portfolio expansion through innovative formulations, ingredient combinations and delivery formats.

· Coordinate technical evaluation and commercial feasibility of new product concepts.

· Support product positioning through technical information, formulation inputs and product development insights.

G. Commercial strategy

· Identify, evaluate and develop strategic relationships with third-party manufacturing partners based on technical capabilities, product requirements, quality standards, certifications and commercial feasibility.

· Develop commercial strategies to generate business through manufacturing partners by leveraging GCV's product portfolio, proprietary ingredients, formulation capabilities and innovation pipeline.

· Identify opportunities to introduce GCV-developed formulations and ready-to-launch products into manufacturers' existing client networks and business portfolios.

· Engage with manufacturers to understand their existing capabilities, client base, market reach and potential business opportunities for GCV.

H. Cross-functional Coordination & Project Management

· Act as a central coordination point between business development and external vendors.

· Develop and monitor project timelines covering formulation, sampling, procurement, packaging, testing, manufacturing and dispatch.

· Conduct regular follow-ups with stakeholders to ensure timely completion of project milestones.

· Identify project risks, operational bottlenecks and interdepartmental dependencies and drive resolution.

· Coordinate internal project reviews and development meetings.

· Ensure appropriate documentation, communication and accountability throughout the product development and supply lifecycle.

· Provide management with project updates, manufacturing status, supply risks and development progress.

**Requirements**

● B.Sc./ M.Sc. degree in food technology, biotechnology, microbi

jobs.title: Machine Shop Supervisor cum programmer
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONPosition: Machine Shop Supervisor cum Programmer

**Department:** Machine Shop / Production  
**Designation:** Machine Shop Supervisor cum Programmer  
**Experience:** 5–10 Years  
**Location:** Thirumudivakkam, Chennai  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Industry:** Engineering / Medical Equipment Manufacturing

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Machine Shop Supervisor cum Programmer** to manage day-to-day machine shop operations while independently handling **CNC/VMC programming, machining processes, production planning, quality, and manpower supervision**.

The candidate should have strong practical knowledge of **CNC/VMC machining, CNC programming, tool selection, cutting parameters, drawing interpretation, production planning, and shop-floor management**.

Key Responsibilities1. Machine Shop Supervision

* Supervise daily activities of the Machine Shop and ensure smooth production operations.
* Allocate jobs and manpower based on production priorities and machine availability.
* Monitor machine utilization, production output, cycle time, and productivity.
* Ensure jobs are completed within the planned production schedule.
* Coordinate with Production, Design, R&D, QC, Stores, Maintenance, and other departments.
* Maintain proper discipline, housekeeping, and 5S practices within the machine shop.
* Monitor machine condition and coordinate with Maintenance for breakdowns and preventive maintenance.

2. CNC / VMC Programming

* Prepare, modify, and optimize CNC/VMC programs based on engineering drawings and job requirements.
* Develop CNC programs using appropriate programming methods/software.
* Understand and work with **G-code and M-code**.
* Select suitable cutting tools, inserts, holders, and machining strategies.
* Set appropriate cutting speed, feed rate, depth of cut, spindle speed, and machining parameters.
* Optimize programs to reduce cycle time, tool wear, and machining cost.
* Prove out and validate new programs before production.
* Make necessary program corrections based on machining and inspection results.

3. Drawing & Technical Understanding

* Read and interpret engineering drawings, dimensions, tolerances, GD&T, and machining specifications.
* Understand material specifications such as MS, SS, Aluminium, EN-series materials, etc.
* Identify machining requirements and determine suitable processes.
* Coordinate with the Design/R&D team regarding drawing and machining-related issues.

4. Production Planning & Monitoring

* Prepare daily and weekly machine-shop production plans.
* Prioritize urgent and critical jobs.
* Monitor job progress against production targets.
* Track pending, running, completed, rejected, and rework jobs.
* Ensure proper machine loading and minimize machine idle time.
* Maintain production records and provide regular status reports to management.

5. Quality Control

* Ensure machining is carried out according to approved drawings and specifications.
* Coordinate with QC/Inspection teams for first-piece and final inspection.
* Identify dimensional and machining defects and take corrective action.
* Minimize rejection, rework, and material wastage.
* Ensure proper use of measuring instruments such as Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Height Gauge, Bore Gauge, etc.

6. Tool & Material Management

* Monitor availability and usage of cutting tools, inserts, holders, coolant, and other consumables.
* Maintain proper tool inventory and usage records.
* Recommend suitable tooling to improve productivity and quality.
* Control tool consumption and avoid unnecessary wastage.

7. Manpower Management

* Supervise CNC/VMC operators, machinists, helpers, and other machine-shop personnel.
* Allocate operators according to machine and job requirements.
* Train and guide operators on machine operation, programming, safety, and quality requirements.
* Monitor attendance, productivity, discipline, and work performance.
* Identify skill gaps and recommend training requirements.

8. Safety & Compliance

* Ensure all employees follow machine-shop safety procedures.
* Ensure proper use of PPE and safety equipment.
* Maintain safe working conditions around CNC/VMC and conventional machines.
* Ensure proper handling of tools, materials, chips, coolant, and finished components.
* Immediately report unsafe conditions, accidents, or machine-related hazards to management.

Required Technical Skills

* Strong knowledge of **CNC / VMC machining operations**.
* CNC programming and program editing.
* Knowledge of **G-code and M-code**.
* Knowledge of cutting tools and machining parameters.
* Ability to read engineering drawings and GD&T.
* Knowledge of tooling selection and machining processes.
* Knowledge of CNC/VMC machine setting and offset correction.
* Understanding of production planning and shop-floor management.
* Knowledge of inspection and measuring instruments.
* Knowledge of 5S, productivity improvement, and rejection control.
* Basic knowledge of CAD/CAM software will be an added advantage.

Educational Qualification

* Diploma / ITI / BE / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or related discipline.
* Candidates with strong practical CNC/VMC machining experience may also be considered.

Experience

**5–10 years of relevant experience** in CNC/VMC machining and machine-shop supervision.

Experience in **engineering manufacturing, precision machining, medical equipment manufacturing, or similar industries** will be preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Production target achievement
* Machine utilization
* Reduction in machine idle time
* Reduction in rejection and rework
* CNC program accuracy
* Cycle-time improvement
* Tool consumption and cost control
* On-time completion of production schedules
* Quality compliance
* Manpower productivity
* Machine breakdown coordination
* 5S and shop-floor discipline

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Strong hands-on experience in CNC/VMC programming and machining.
* Good leadership and manpower-handling skills.
* Ability to independently handle machine-shop operations.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making ability.
* Ability to work under production pressure and meet deadlines.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Responsible, disciplined, and safety-conscious.
* Willing to work hands-on with the production team when required.

Reporting To

**Production Manager / Operations Head / Management**

Working Location

**Wemake Solutions Pvt Ltd**  
**Thirumudivakkam, Chennai**

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Position:** **Machine Shop Supervisor cum Programmer**

**Department:** Machine Shop / Production  
**Designation:** Machine Shop Supervisor cum Programmer  
**Experience:** 5–10 Years  
**Location:** Thirumudivakkam, Chennai  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**CONTACT : 9348417916**  
**Industry:** Engineering / Medical Equipment Manufacturing

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Machine Shop Supervisor cum Programmer** to manage day-to-day machine shop operations while independently handling **CNC/VMC programming, machining processes, production planning, quality, and manpower supervision**.

The candidate should have strong practical knowledge of **CNC/VMC machining, CNC programming, tool selection, cutting parameters, drawing interpretation, production planning, and shop-floor management**.

Key Responsibilities1. Machine Shop Supervision

* Supervise daily activities of the Machine Shop and ensure smooth production operations.
* Allocate jobs and manpower based on production priorities and machine availability.
* Monitor machine utilization, production output, cycle time, and productivity.
* Ensure jobs are completed within the planned production schedule.
* Coordinate with Production, Design, R&D, QC, Stores, Maintenance, and other departments.
* Maintain proper discipline, housekeeping, and 5S practices within the machine shop.
* Monitor machine condition and coordinate with Maintenance for breakdowns and preventive maintenance.

2. CNC / VMC Programming

* Prepare, modify, and optimize CNC/VMC programs based on engineering drawings and job requirements.
* Develop CNC programs using appropriate programming methods/software.
* Understand and work with **G-code and M-code**.
* Select suitable cutting tools, inserts, holders, and machining strategies.
* Set appropriate cutting speed, feed rate, depth of cut, spindle speed, and machining parameters.
* Optimize programs to reduce cycle time, tool wear, and machining cost.
* Prove out and validate new programs before production.
* Make necessary program corrections based on machining and inspection results.

3. Drawing & Technical Understanding

* Read and interpret engineering drawings, dimensions, tolerances, GD&T, and machining specifications.
* Understand material specifications such as MS, SS, Aluminium, EN-series materials, etc.
* Identify machining requirements and determine suitable processes.
* Coordinate with the Design/R&D team regarding drawing and machining-related issues.

4. Production Planning & Monitoring

* Prepare daily and weekly machine-shop production plans.
* Prioritize urgent and critical jobs.
* Monitor job progress against production targets.
* Track pending, running, completed, rejected, and rework jobs.
* Ensure proper machine loading and minimize machine idle time.
* Maintain production records and provide regular status reports to management.

5. Quality Control

* Ensure machining is carried out according to approved drawings and specifications.
* Coordinate with QC/Inspection teams for first-piece and final inspection.
* Identify dimensional and machining defects and take corrective action.
* Minimize rejection, rework, and material wastage.
* Ensure proper use of measuring instruments such as Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Height Gauge, Bore Gauge, etc.

6. Tool & Material Management

* Monitor availability and usage of cutting tools, inserts, holders, coolant, and other consumables.
* Maintain proper tool inventory and usage records.
* Recommend suitable tooling to improve productivity and quality.
* Control tool consumption and avoid unnecessary wastage.

7. Manpower Management

* Supervise CNC/VMC operators, machinists, helpers, and other machine-shop personnel.
* Allocate operators according to machine and job requirements.
* Train and guide operators on machine operation, programming, safety, and quality requirements.
* Monitor attendance, productivity, discipline, and work performance.
* Identify skill gaps and recommend training requirements.

8. Safety & Compliance

* Ensure all employees follow machine-shop safety procedures.
* Ensure proper use of PPE and safety equipment.
* Maintain safe working conditions around CNC/VMC and conventional machines.
* Ensure proper handling of tools, materials, chips, coolant, and finished components.
* Immediately report unsafe conditions, accidents, or machine-related hazards to management.

Required Technical Skills

* Strong knowledge of **CNC / VMC machining operations**.
* CNC programming and program editing.
* Knowledge of **G-code and M-code**.
* Knowledge of cutting tools and machining parameters.
* Ability to read engineering drawings and GD&T.
* Knowledge of tooling selection and machining processes.
* Knowledge of CNC/VMC machine setting and offset correction.
* Understanding of production planning and shop-floor management.
* Knowledge of inspection and measuring instruments.
* Knowledge of 5S, productivity improvement, and rejection control.
* Basic knowledge of CAD/CAM software will be an added advantage.

Educational Qualification

* Diploma / ITI / BE / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or related discipline.
* Candidates with strong practical CNC/VMC machining experience may also be considered.

Experience

**5–10 years of relevant experience** in CNC/VMC machining and machine-shop supervision.

Experience in **engineering manufacturing, precision machining, medical equipment manufacturing, or similar industries** will be preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Production target achievement
* Machine utilization
* Reduction in machine idle time
* Reduction in rejection and rework
* CNC program accuracy
* Cycle-time improvement
* Tool consumption and cost control
* On-time completion of production schedules
* Quality compliance
* Manpower productivity
* Machine breakdown coordination
* 5S and shop-floor discipline

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Strong hands-on experience in CNC/VMC programming and machining.
* Good leadership and manpower-handling skills.
* Ability to independently handle machine-shop operations.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making ability.
* Ability to work under production pressure and meet deadlines.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Responsible, disciplined, and safety-conscious.
* Willing to work hands-on with the production team when required.

Reporting To

**Production Manager / Operations Head / Management**

Working Location

**Wemake Solutions Pvt Ltd**  
**Thirumudivakkam, Chennai**

How to Apply

The role

R&D, service, production and sales at CountAI all move fast — and the most important work stalls between them. You run the company's daily execution rhythm: every morning you know what matters most, who owns it and what is blocking it. You clear blocks before they cost us a customer date, and you give top management one honest picture of where things stand and who is delivering. You work directly with the CEO and leadership to get the top-priority work done.

What you will do

* Run the morning meeting every day in 20 minutes or less: understand how each team's tasks flow and set their order of importance, so everyone works on what matters most.
* Keep one company priority list with owners, dates and dependencies. When priorities clash between teams, settle it — or take it to leadership the same day.
* Make sure no task is blocked anywhere in operations — R&D, service, production, purchase or sales. Find the block, name the owner, follow up until it is cleared.
* Track delivery by person — who commits, who delivers on time, and where people need help — and share it fairly with their managers as a monthly view.
* Give management a weekly overview: what moved, what slipped and why, the risks coming up, and the decisions needed.
* Turn leadership decisions into tracked actions, and close every loop.
* Build the tracking system itself — sheets, Jira or ClickUp, and AI tools — so it runs without chasing by email.

Who we are looking for

* 5–10 years in operations, production planning, a PMO or project management at an engineering, manufacturing or technology company.

This is a cGMP and FSSC 22000 certified contract manufacturer specializing in nutrition, protein, energy, granola, and clean-label food bars. Operating from our manufacturing facility at Himalayan Food Park in Kashipur with a daily production capacity of up to 5,00,000 bars, we partner with leading FMCG and nutrition brands to deliver products from concept to shelf.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on **Production Manager** to oversee end-to-end manufacturing operations at our Kashipur plant. You will lead daily shop-floor production across our sheet-and-cut, cold extrusion, baking, enrobing, and packaging lines while ensuring strict adherence to FSSAI, cGMP, and FSSC 22000 food safety standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Production Planning & Execution:** Plan, schedule, and execute daily and monthly production targets across multiple bar-manufacturing lines (30g–150g SKUs) to ensure on-time order fulfillment.
* **Process & Line Management:** Supervise specialized food processing operations including slab/sheet-and-cut, low-pressure cold extrusion, baking, chocolate/compound enrobing, and primary/secondary automated packaging.
* **Quality & Food Safety Compliance:** Enforce cGMP, FSSC 22000, HACCP, and FSSAI guidelines on the shop floor. Oversee critical control points including inline metal detection and check-weighing systems.
* **Yield Optimization & Waste Reduction:** Monitor raw material consumption, batch yields, and rework; implement lean manufacturing practices to minimize wastage and downtime.
* **Team Leadership:** Lead, train, and manage shift supervisors, machine operators, and floor workers; oversee shift scheduling, attendance, and shop-floor discipline.
* **Cross-Functional Coordination:** Collaborate closely with Quality Assurance (QA/QC), R&D (for new product trials and tech transfers), Maintenance, and Supply Chain/Stores teams to resolve bottlenecks smoothly.

* **Education:** B.Tech / B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Food Technology, Food Engineering, Dairy Technology, or a related discipline.

jobs.description:
**Company:** CEV Engineering  
**Department:** Service & Technical Support  
**Designation:** Assistant Manager  
**Experience:** 5–8 Years (Automotive Industry Preferred)  
**Qualification:** B.Tech / Diploma in Automobile or Mechanical Engineering  
**Job Location:** Delhi NCR / Field Operations

**1. Job Purpose**

To manage CNG vehicle field issues, provide technical support to dealers, coordinate with OEM and plant quality teams, and ensure timely resolution of customer and dealer complaints. The role will focus on improving product quality, reducing warranty claims, strengthening dealer technical capabilities, and improving service performance.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Field Issue Management**

* Handle and investigate CNG vehicle technical complaints reported by dealers and customers.
* Conduct vehicle inspections and field visits to identify root causes of technical issues.
* Analyse recurring failures and prepare detailed technical investigation reports.
* Coordinate with OEM, Plant Quality, R&D, and Production teams for corrective actions.
* Monitor complaint trends and ensure timely closure of field issues.
* Escalate critical and repetitive issues to senior management.

**B. Dealer Technical Support**

* Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support to dealer service teams.
* Plan and conduct dealer visits for technical issue resolution.
* Ensure proper CNG system inspection and repair procedures are followed.
* Support dealers in reducing unnecessary part replacement.
* Monitor dealer technical performance and identify training requirements.

**C. Warranty Management**

* Monitor CNG parts warranty claims and replacement activities.
* Analyse warranty failures and identify high-failure components.
* Coordinate with dealers for defective part return and technical investigation.
* Monitor warranty claim numbers and warranty cost.
* Work towards reducing repeat failures and unnecessary warranty claims.

**D. Technical Training & Development**

* Organise technical training for dealer technicians and service advisors.
* Develop training materials, technical manuals, and troubleshooting guides.
* Conduct practical training on CNG components and diagnostic tools.
* Evaluate dealer technicians' technical knowledge and capabilities.

**E. Reporting & Documentation**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly field issue reports.
* Maintain a technical complaint database and track issue closure.
* Prepare 8D reports, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and Corrective Action Reports.
* Monitor KPIs related to field complaints, warranty claims, and dealer performance.
* Present technical performance and improvement plans to management.

**F. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with OEM Quality, Service, Plant Quality, R&D, and Production teams.
* Follow up on corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Support new vehicle launches and CNG system validation activities.
* Coordinate with internal teams for spare parts availability and technical support.

**3. Required Technical Skills**

* Good knowledge of CNG vehicle systems and components.
* Knowledge of CNG regulators, injectors, pressure sensors, cylinders, HP tubes, and fittings.
* Understanding of CNG diagnostics and scanning tools.
* Knowledge of vehicle troubleshooting and failure analysis.
* Understanding of warranty processes and quality tools (5 Why, Fishbone, 8D).
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and technical reporting.

**4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Reduction in repeat field complaints.
* Reduction in warranty claims and warranty costs.
* Timely closure of field issues.
* Dealer technical support response time.
* Number of dealer technical training sessions conducted.
* Improvement in first-time-right repair performance.
* Reduction in unnecessary part replacement.
* Timely submission of RCA and corrective action reports.

**5. Competencies Required**

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Team management and leadership abilities.
* Effective communication and coordination.
* Decision-making and escalation management.
* Customer and dealer handling skills.
* Willingness to travel for field inspections and dealer support.

**6. Expected Deliverables**

* Timely resolution of CNG field issues.
* Improved dealer technical capabilities.
* Reduced warranty cost and repeat complaints.
* Effective coordination with OEM and plant teams.
* Improved CNG service quality and customer satisfaction.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.
  
  
**JOB PURPOSE:**
Provide senior individual-contributor technical leadership for OTC formulation science, product design, development, scale-up, technology transfer, regulatory technical support, and lifecycle management across consumer healthcare products and dosage forms.
  
  
The Principal Scientist, OTC Formulation is a individual-contributor technical authority responsible for shaping formulation strategy and resolving complex technical challenges across OTC consumer healthcare development programs. The role reports to the Senior Principal Scientist, OTC Product Development / Formulation Science, and operates through technical depth, cross-functional influence, senior review, governance, and mentorship rather than direct line management.

* Translate consumer, commercial, regulatory, quality, and manufacturing requirements into robust target product profiles and formulation strategies.
* Provide senior technical leadership for dosage-form design, pre-formulation, excipient selection, active compatibility, product performance, and risk-based formulation decisions.
* Resolve complex formulation challenges including palatability, dose delivery, solubility, dissolution, rheology, microbial robustness, preservative effectiveness, packaging interaction, and stability.
* Embed QbD, design of experiments, critical quality attributes, critical process parameters, control strategy, and technical risk management into development programs.
* Technical Leadership and Delivery
* Ensure formulation decisions support consumer experience, labelled use, dose delivery, product performance, and OTC self-care suitability.
* Partner with Medical, Regulatory, Claims, Consumer Science, Commercial, Quality, Packaging, Supply, and external partners to support evidence readiness and product delivery.
* Provide technical review of formulation rationale, development data, stability conclusions, regulatory technical content, and lifecycle change assessments.
* Contribute to innovation, external technology assessment, competitive benchmarking, design-to-value, productivity, sustainability, and lifecycle improvement opportunities.

**Why you?**

We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:
  
  

* Master’s degree in Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent senior technical experience may be considered.
* Typically 8-10+ years of formulation, product development, or technical leadership experience in OTC, consumer healthcare, pharmaceutical, or other regulated product environments.
* Demonstrated accountability for formulation strategy, technical problem solving, and delivery of multiple products, platforms, dosage forms, or lifecycle programs.
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, work with external partners, and coach or mentor scientists through technical authority rather than formal line-management authority.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:
  
  

* Experience supporting multiple geographic markets, APAC regulatory environments, or OTC monograph/local-standard frameworks.
* Experience with pain, respiratory, allergy, gastrointestinal, dermatology, wellness, or adjacent self-care categories.
* Experience with contract development or manufacturing organizations, external laboratories, packaging partners, or external innovation partners.
* Knowledge of QbD, design of experiments, technical risk assessment, design-to-value, sustainability, and structured problem-solving tools.

**Core Competencies:**

* Strategic formulation leadership and advanced scientific judgment.
* Complex technical problem solving and risk-based decision making.
* Cross-functional influence and stakeholder management.
* Clear technical communication, documentation, and governance mindset.
* Knowledge sharing, and capability building as an individual contributor.
* Consumer-focused innovation, business acumen, and continuous improvement mindset.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Quality and impact of formulation strategy, technical direction, and risk-based decisions.
* Delivery of key technical milestones across development, scale-up, launch, and lifecycle programs.
* Robustness, stability, manufacturability, scalability, and consumer acceptability of developed products.
* Resolution of complex formulation, process, analytical, packaging, stability, and manufacturing issues.

2026-12-25

**Job Purpose**

The Application Lab Senior Executive / Assistant Manager develops tests and demonstrates personal care and home care formulations that showcase the company's principals' ingredients. The role bridges suppliers, sales teams and customers, turning raw material know-how into practical formulations, technical data and compelling presentations.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Skin Care Formulations

* Develop and optimise skin care prototypes – creams, lotions, serums, gels, sun care, cleansers and colour cosmetic bases – using the principals' emulsifiers, emollients, actives, UV filters, rheology modifiers, preservatives and sensory additives.
* Create benchmark and starting-point formulations that showcase ingredient performance, stability and sensory.
* Adapt customer formulas for ingredient substitution, cost optimisation, sustainability or regulatory change.
* Work on natural, vegan and clean beauty concepts in line with market trends.

2. Hair Care Formulations

* Develop shampoos, conditioners, masks, leave-on treatments, styling products, colorants and scalp-care formulations.
* Evaluate surfactant systems, conditioning polymers, silicones and alternatives, and actives for claims such as anti-dandruff, repair, frizz control and colour protection.
* Run sulphate-free, silicone-free and bio-based formulation projects.

3. Home Care Support

* Support home care formulations (laundry, dishwash, surface and fabric care) as business needs require.

4. Testing and Performance Evaluation

* Test physico-chemical parameters: pH, viscosity, appearance, colour, odour, foam, SPF/UV and droplet size.
* Run stability (accelerated, freeze-thaw, light, centrifuge), compatibility and preservative efficacy studies, coordinating with external labs where needed.
* Conduct sensory panels and in-vitro/in-vivo claim support studies, including hair-tress and skin-feel evaluations.
* Maintain and calibrate lab instruments; ensure GLP, safety and housekeeping.

5. Innovation and Trend Monitoring

* Track global personal care trends, launches, regulations and competitor products; convert insights into concept formulations.
* Collaborate with principals on new ingredient launches and co-development projects.
* Propose new product concepts and sustainable, value-added solutions for the regional market.
* Capture market and consumer trends from market visits, customers, retail and competitor products; share insights and opportunity reports with sales, marketing and principals.

6. Trade Shows, Events and Customer Engagement

* Prepare and present formulations, samples and demo material at trade shows and conferences (e.g., in-cosmetics, HPCI, CHT, local exhibitions).
* Support technical seminars, lab tours and live application demonstrations.
* Support the sales team on customer visits, in person and virtual (video calls, online demos, webinars), with technical inputs, formulation discussions and follow-up.
* Join sales on market visits to brand owners, contract manufacturers and trade partners to understand requirements and opportunities.
* Provide technical troubleshooting to customers on formulation, stability, processing and performance issues – identify root causes and recommend corrective solutions.

7. Documentation

* Maintain accurate lab notebooks, formulation records, batch sheets and test reports.
* Prepare technical data sheets, formulation brochures, application notes and product dossiers with full traceability.
* Support sales and principals with technical documents, test data, certificates and customer queries.
* Support regulatory and compliance documentation (SDS, claims support, BIS, ISO 22716/GMP).
* Support sampling: prepare, label, pack and dispatch samples; track requests, feedback and conversions.
* Manage the formulation database, sample inventory and retention-sample library.

8. Presentations and Technical Communication

* Deliver technical presentations to customers, internal teams and principals, covering formulation results and project updates.
* Present case studies and performance data with clear visuals.
* Develop product application training for sales teams.
* Work with marketing on digital campaigns (webinars, e-mailers, social media, online content) and promotional material (brochures, flyers, application videos, case studies), ensuring technical accuracy.

**Candidate Profile**

**Education**

* M.Sc / B.Tech / M.Tech / B.Pharm / M.Pharm in Cosmetic Science, Chemistry, Oils & Surfactants, Chemical or Pharmaceutical Technology.

**Experience**

* Senior Executive: 3–6 years; Assistant Manager: 6–10 years in personal care formulation (skin and hair care), in a lab, application or R&D role – preferably with a raw material supplier or distributor.
* Hands-on experience in emulsions, surfactant systems, sun care and hair care.

**Core Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of cosmetic ingredients, INCI, stability and regulatory basics.
* Excellent presentation, communication and customer-facing skills.
* Proficient in MS Office, especially PowerPoint and Excel; formulation software is a plus.
* Organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Collaborative, curious and innovative; willing to travel for trade shows and customer visits.

Works closely with Personal Care and Home Care sales and marketing, principals' technical teams, customers, and regulatory and quality functions.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager - Fermentation & Upstream Processing
jobs.description:
**Position Overview:**

This position involves managing and optimizing upstream manufacturing operations, including microbial fermentation, media preparation, inoculum development, and microbial algae cultivation. The role focuses on overseeing day-to-day production activities, optimizing fermentation parameters, improving biomass productivity, and ensuring consistent batch performance while meeting production targets and quality standards. The candidate should have exposure to the production of omega oils, particularly DHA and EPA, from microbial algae, along with a strong understanding of fermentation processes, process optimization, and scale-up. The role also requires effective coordination with downstream processing, quality assurance, quality control, maintenance, and engineering teams to ensure safe, efficient, and compliant manufacturing operations.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Manage day-to-day upstream manufacturing operations, including media preparation, sterilization, inoculum development, fermentation, and microbial algae cultivation.
* Supervise and monitor fermentation processes to ensure consistent biomass growth, product yield, and adherence to production schedules.
* Operate and oversee fermenters, bioreactors, seed vessels, media preparation systems, sterilization systems, and associated auxiliary equipment.
* Support upstream production of microbial biomass for the manufacture of omega oils, including DHA and EPA, derived from microbial algae.
* Monitor and optimize critical process parameters such as temperature, pH, dissolved oxygen, agitation, aeration, nutrient feed, and fermentation duration.
* Perform media optimization, inoculum optimization, and process parameter optimization based on strain performance and production requirements.
* Troubleshoot fermentation-related issues, identify root causes of process deviations, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure proper execution of batch manufacturing activities, including batch documentation, process monitoring, yield tracking, and timely batch completion.
* Take responsibility for the successful execution of assigned batches, ensuring process consistency, productivity, and compliance with established specifications.
* Support process development, technology transfer, and scale-up activities from laboratory or pilot scale to commercial manufacturing scale.
* Coordinate with downstream processing teams to ensure the timely transfer of fermentation broth or biomass for subsequent extraction and purification operations.
* Collaborate with quality assurance, quality control, maintenance, and engineering teams to address process deviations, equipment breakdowns, and operational challenges.
* Ensure compliance with applicable GMP requirements, SOPs, safety protocols, hygiene standards, and relevant regulatory requirements.
* Maintain accurate production records, batch manufacturing records, equipment logbooks, and other relevant documentation.
* Monitor raw material and media requirements, coordinate procurement planning with relevant departments, and minimize material wastage.
* Assist in production planning, manpower allocation, shift scheduling, and resource utilization to achieve manufacturing targets within the approved budget.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, cost reduction, increased biomass productivity, improved fermentation yields, and enhanced operational efficiency.
* Lead and guide upstream production personnel, ensuring adherence to operating procedures, safety practices, and quality standards.
* Support the evaluation and implementation of new technologies, automation systems, and process improvements in upstream manufacturing.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned by management.
* Duties and responsibilities are not limited to the work listed above and may include other assignments as necessary

Qualifications, Competencies, and Position Requirements

* Strong technical knowledge of upstream bioprocessing, microbial fermentation, and bioreactor operations.
* Practical understanding of microbial algae cultivation and fermentation-based production of omega oils, particularly DHA and/or EPA, is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of media formulation, inoculum development, sterilization, aseptic techniques, and fermentation process control.
* Ability to monitor, analyze, and optimize critical process parameters to improve biomass productivity and product yield.
* Knowledge of troubleshooting, root cause analysis, process deviation management, and corrective and preventive actions.
* Familiarity with GMP, SOPs, batch manufacturing documentation, and industrial safety practices.
* Strong leadership, communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Good organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple production activities.
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and support continuous improvement initiatives.
* Willingness to work in shifts, including night shifts, as required.
* Willingness to travel as required by the role.

***Education and Experience:***

* M.Tech, M.Sc., or Ph.D. in Biotechnology.
* Minimum of 5 years of relevant industrial experience in upstream manufacturing, microbial fermentation, or bioprocess operations, preferably in the nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, food biotechnology, or microbial oil industry.
* Hands-on experience in industrial-scale fermentation, bioreactor operations, media optimization, and process parameter optimization is preferred.
* Exposure to microbial algae cultivation and the production of omega oils, particularly DHA and EPA, is desirable.
* Knowledge of GMP requirements, SOPs, batch manufacturing documentation, process troubleshooting, and quality standards is preferred.

***Travel:***
