jobs.title: Pharmaceutical Formulation Consultant (Tablets & Capsules, NPD)
jobs.description:
**Job Description:** Pharmaceutical Formulation Consultant (Tablets & Capsules, NPD)

**Engagement type:** Consultant, project-based

**Work location:** Chennai office (on-site)

**Domain:** Pharmaceutical drug formulation and new product development (oral solid dosage)

**Duration:** Project-based, to be defined at onboarding (extendable)

**1. Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Pharmaceutical Formulation Consultant to develop new tablet and capsule products. The consultant will work from our Chennai office for the project duration. The role covers hands-on formulation preparation along with market research that supports product selection and positioning.

**2. Eligibility**

* **Freshers are not eligible to apply.**
* **Minimum 3+ years of hands-on, practical experience in formulation** (lab-level preparation and trials for tablets and/or capsules).
* Candidates with only theoretical or academic exposure, or with experience limited to QC, QA, or regulatory work, will not be considered.

**3. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Formulation Development (Tablets & Capsules)**

* Design and develop oral solid dosage formulations (immediate-release, and modified or sustained-release where applicable) for new products.
* Conduct pre-formulation studies: API characterisation, solubility, compatibility, and excipient selection.
* Personally prepare lab-scale formulation trials and optimise them using QbD / DoE principles.
* Select the manufacturing process (direct compression, wet or dry granulation, capsule filling) and define critical process parameters.
* Evaluate and troubleshoot trial batches: hardness, friability, disintegration, dissolution, assay, and content uniformity.
* Run stability studies as per ICH guidelines and interpret the results.
* Prepare formulation documents: Master Formula, development reports, and technical data packages.
* Support scale-up and tech transfer to the manufacturing site.

**B. Market Research**

* Carry out market and competitor analysis for target molecules and dosage forms (market size, demand trends, key players, pricing).
* Identify new product opportunities, including generics, 505(b)(2), nutraceutical-pharma crossover, and niche or unmet-need segments.
* Review the patent landscape, exclusivity status, and reference listed drug (RLD) details.
* Assess the regulatory pathway and market-entry feasibility (India CDSCO and, where relevant, regulated markets).
* Prepare product feasibility reports and a recommended product pipeline with a go / no-go view.

**C. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate lab records and development documentation.
* Share regular progress updates and present findings to management.
* Deliver a final project report with formulation, data, and recommendations.

**4. Required Qualifications**

* M.Pharm (Pharmaceutics / Industrial Pharmacy) or Ph.D. in Pharmaceutical Sciences. B.Pharm with strong practical experience may be considered.
* **3+ years of practical formulation experience** in oral solid dosage forms (tablets and capsules).
* Demonstrated involvement in product development trials, from pre-formulation through optimisation.

**5. Required Skills**

* Strong working knowledge of excipients, granulation, compression, coating, and capsule-filling technologies.
* Hands-on use of formulation equipment (blenders, granulators, tablet press, capsule filling machine, coating pan).
* Knowledge of ICH, QbD, and cGMP, plus regulatory requirements for product filing.
* Familiarity with analytical methods: dissolution, HPLC, and related quality tests.
* Ability to conduct market research using IQVIA, patent databases, regulatory databases, and similar sources.
* Strong analytical, report-writing, and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and deliver to timelines.

**6. Preferred**

* Experience with modified-release or complex generics.
* Exposure to regulated-market filings (US FDA, EMA, WHO-GMP).
* Prior consulting experience.

**7. Deliverables**

* Pre-formulation and feasibility reports
* Optimised tablet and capsule formulations with trial batch data
* Stability data summary
* Market research and product opportunity report
* Final technical and project report

**8. Terms**

* **Compensation:** Consultant fee (fixed or monthly retainer or Project Based feedback ), to be discussed
* **Reporting to:** Project Head
* **Work mode:** On-site at the Chennai office for the project duration

Language:

* Hindi (Preferred)
* English (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

Job Title: Senior Executive / Assistant Manager Microbiology

  

Job Description

  

We are looking for an experienced Microbiologist to manage microbiological quality control, food safety, and hygiene monitoring activities across our dairy manufacturing operations, including milk, cheese, paneer, processed cheese, and other dairy products.

The candidate will be responsible for microbiological testing, environmental monitoring, laboratory management, hygiene verification, deviation investigation, RCA/CAPA, audit compliance, and maintaining effective microbiological quality standards.

  

Key Responsibilities

  

* Manage microbiological quality control activities for raw milk, incoming materials, process water, brine/process solutions, in-process, and finished dairy products.
* Conduct microbiological testing for TPC, Coliform, E. coli, Yeast & Mould, Enterobacteriaceae, Staphylococcus aureus, Salmonella, Listeria, and other relevant pathogens.
* Develop and implement environmental monitoring programs covering production areas, equipment, product-contact surfaces, personnel hygiene, air, and drains.
* Monitor hygiene and sanitation practices and ensure effective microbiological control across manufacturing operations.
* Investigate microbiological deviations and out-of-specification (OOS) results and implement Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).
* Manage day-to-day microbiology laboratory operations, including testing, documentation, equipment, consumables, and laboratory resources.
* Monitor microbiological trends and prepare daily and weekly MIS reports.
* Ensure timely completion of microbiological testing and review results for product release in coordination with QA/QC.
* Handle laboratory budgeting, Purchase Requisitions (PR), and Purchase Orders (PO).
* Ensure compliance with GMP, FSSAI, and FSSC requirements.
* Coordinate and handle internal and external audits, including FSSAI and FSSC audits.
* Support export quality requirements and drive continuous improvement in food safety and quality culture.

  

Desired Candidate Profile

  

* M.Sc. in Microbiology.
* 6+ years of relevant experience in microbiology and quality assurance.
* Experience in dairy or food manufacturing industries.
* Hands-on experience in microbiological testing of dairy products.
* Good knowledge of environmental monitoring, hygiene verification, and sanitation practices.
* Experience in laboratory management, RCA, CAPA, and microbiological deviation handling.
* Knowledge of GMP, FSSAI, and FSSC audit requirements.
* Good analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and team coordination skills.

  

Key Skills

  

Microbiology | Dairy Microbiology | Food Microbiology | Quality Assurance | Quality Control | Microbiological Testing | Environmental Monitoring | Hygiene Verification | TPC | Coliform | E. coli | Yeast & Mould | Salmonella | Listeria | RCA | CAPA | GMP | FSSAI | FSSC | Laboratory Management | Food Safety | Dairy Quality

jobs.title: Senior Programme Lead – Sustainable Food Systems (Political Economy)
jobs.company: Council on Energy, Environment and Water
jobs.description:
At CEEW, we are deliberate about what we stand for as an employer. So, if the below description strikes a chord, we would love to hear from you!

**At CEEW, we build careers in public policy**

* We offer strong visionary leadership – with emphasis on research and impact at scale
* We actively promote leadership by initiative
* We celebrate talent and ambition
* You will be surrounded by smart people who will challenge you and help you grow
* You will learn faster than your peers in other organisations
* Curiosity and irreverence, as well as responsibility, come together at CEEW
* You will get above-market remuneration
* We provide a safe space for all
* At CEEW, your life is your example for others

**Designation offered**
  
Senior Programme Lead

**Reporting to**
  
Sustainable Food Systems (Political Economy)

**Location**
  
New Delhi, India

### **Purpose**

Systems change in food systems reform is impeded by entrenched political economy dynamics. We are looking for a leader who can not only navigate this political economy, but also orchestrate difficult, real change – rewriting political economy equations and enabling systemic transformation. They will build and lead a team working at the interface of political economy, public policy, and institutions, and will advance the Council’s research, policy engagement, and impact by helping the programme understand and navigate political economy while actively orchestrating systems-level change in India’s food systems.

### **Responsibilities and Duties**

**Strategy**

* Co-evolve the strategy for the programme’s political economy work, building on existing in-house thinking, the political economy landscape across food systems reform, our skillset and niche, the evolving sectoral narrative, and emerging government priorities.
* Work closely with the team to bring alignment within the team on the strategy.
* Build a network of contacts across government, political leadership, and public institutions to create sustained pathways for policy and institutional change.
* Spearhead coalition building with public institutions, political leadership, and civil society partners, in coordination with internal project streams, creating a high-leverage venue for catalytic action on political economy transitions.
* Lead the thinking on how policy, institutions, and narratives shape decision-making in food systems; scope and develop new ideas and programmes to shift this political economy towards sustainability transitions.

### **Research**

* Lead research and intelligence-gathering on the political economy of food systems reform, including the role of institutions, regulatory environments, incentives, and narratives in shaping decision-making.
* Develop intelligence and strategies to shape the political economy of food systems towards sustainability transitions, and identify levers and entry points for orchestrating change.
* Map stakeholders, interests, and power structures across government, political leadership, and public institutions relevant to food systems reform, ensuring alignment and collaborative execution.
* Lead research in the programme area as a principal investigator. Guide and provide relevant inputs to the wider research agenda.
* Assess and improve existing methodologies and frameworks employed by SFS relevant to political economy analysis, and build institutional capacity on such methodologies.
* Keep a tab on policy and political developments in agriculture and food systems.
* Strong writing skills with the ability to write coherently and concisely: emails, opinion pieces, policy briefs, and reports

### **Leadership and Mentoring**

* Take end-to-end ownership of the programme. Ideate new research concepts with team members, develop project proposals and budgets, build relationships with donors that align with the institution’s interests, secure resources for building and expanding the work programme, deliver high-quality, timely outputs, engage with sectoral stakeholders, strive for impact, and develop CEEW’s thought leadership.
* Build and lead your team. Hone the team members to the best of their abilities. Stretch and strive and set leadership by initiative.
* Lead the strategic outreach of the programme. Lead external meetings, conferences, and seminars with government, political leadership, and public institutions, and be the face of CEEW in your programme area, while also creating platforms for your team for public engagement.
* Strategise the communication and outreach of research outputs along with the outreach team.
* Build strong relationships based on trust and credibility with key policymakers, political leadership, and sector stakeholders.

### **Selection Criteria and Key Skills**

* **Education:** PhD or Master’s degree in public policy/political science/international relations/ agriculture/rural development/food systems/public affairs/mass communication/journalism or any other relevant field relevant to food systems transformation.

### **Professional experience**

* At least 10 years of relevant experience in undertaking and leading research, policy engagement, and project management, in one or more of the following areas. Candidates who have prior experience in the following fields will be given a strong preference:
  + Political economy and public policy
  + Working in or with governments, political leadership, or public institutions
  + Agriculture, rural development, or food systems
  + Public affairs, strategic communications, or journalism, with an understanding of how policy, institutions, and narratives shape decision-making
* Ability to navigate diverse stakeholders and strategise systems-level change
* Proven track record in building relationships and coalitions with government, political leadership, and public institutions
* Experience in designing and leading interdisciplinary and inter-programmatic work
* Strong track record of team management and project management, including timely delivery of outputs
* Have demonstrated thought leadership in the areas relevant to the ToR

### **Skills and Competencies**

* Curiosity and an ability to think creatively.
* Willingness to learn new research and project management skills.
* Willingness to travel for field visits and stakeholder interviews (if needed).
* Ability to effectively work in a team while driving research with minimum assistance, when time demands independently.
* Ability to adapt to a new environment and deliver under tight deadlines in a professional environment.
* Striving for rigour in research and quality in work output.
* Ability to dig deeper into details, while also keeping a sense of the broader objectives and big picture.

### **Compensation**

Competitive compensation – commensurate to the experience and matching the best of standards adopted by the industry or other similar organisations for similar roles.

### **Application process**

CEEW is an equal opportunity employer, and the selection process does not discriminate on the basis of age, gender, caste, ethnicity, religion, or sexuality. Female candidates are encouraged to apply.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Interested applicants are advised to apply at the earliest possible. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified by us. We appreciate your interest.

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Lead
jobs.description:
**About us**

Morulaa HealthTech is a Chennai-based, women-led medical device company and part of SaYog Group. We help global medical device manufacturers register, import and sell their products in India, and we act as their importer of record. We are now setting up overseas offices in Dubai and the USA. We need a senior QA/RA professional to own regulatory approvals and quality compliance across our growing portfolio of partner products.

**Role purpose**

The Lead - QA & RA owns the regulatory and quality function end to end. This covers registration strategy and submissions for new partner products in India and selected export markets, keeping our ISO 13485 quality management system audit-ready, and keeping products compliant through their lifecycle. The role works closely with overseas manufacturers, MDLR licensing authorities, the US FDA, notified bodies and our internal sales and operations teams.

**Key responsibilities**

**Regulatory affairs**

* Plan the regulatory strategy and registration roadmap for each new partner product, covering classification, pathway, timelines and documents needed.
* Prepare, review and submit registration, manufacturing and import licence applications under MDLR (Medical Devices Rules, 2017), and track them through to approval.
* Review and compile technical files, Device Master Files, Plant Master Files and STED documents received from overseas manufacturers. Identify gaps and drive remediation.
* Perform gap assessments against EU MDR 2017/745, including GSPR, clinical evaluation, PMS, labelling and IFU (including e-IFU).
* Respond to queries from MDLR licensing authorities, the US FDA, notified bodies and other regulators quickly and accurately.
* Lead US FDA submissions and compliance (510(k)/De Novo, establishment registration and listing, UDI, QMSR), and support other markets as Morulaa expands.
* Manage change notifications, licence renewals and post-approval changes for registered products.
* Track regulatory and standards updates and brief management and the team on what they mean for the business.

**Quality assurance**

* Own and maintain Morulaa's ISO 13485:2016 QMS, including procedures, document control, records and continual improvement.
* Plan and lead internal audits. Host external, customer and partner audits and close findings on time.
* Run complaint handling, non-conformance, CAPA and vigilance/field safety processes, and report adverse events to authorities as required.
* Oversee risk management files in line with ISO 14971.
* Review design and technical documentation (DHF, design verification/validation and labelling) against applicable standards such as IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2, IEC 62366, IEC 62304 and ISO 20417/15223-1.
* Coordinate external testing (biocompatibility, sterilisation, electrical safety, calibration) with accredited labs.
* Conduct Management Review Meetings and report quality KPIs to the Directors.

**Leadership and collaboration**

* Lead, train and mentor QA/RA team members, and build the function as the business grows.
* Act as the regulatory point of contact for overseas manufacturers and partners.
* Work with sales, supply chain and finance so that products are imported, labelled and sold in full compliance.
* Run regular internal training on regulations, QMS and data integrity.

**Qualifications and experience**

**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy or a related discipline.
* Minimum 7-8 years' experience in medical device regulatory affairs and quality assurance, including at least 2 years in a lead or supervisory role.
* **Core experience must be with a medical device manufacturer.** **The candidate's foundation (typically the first 4-5 years) should be in an in-house QA/RA role at a medical device manufacturing company**, with direct exposure to the shop floor, production QMS, design control, CAPA and regulatory submissions for the company's own products. Later experience at a regulatory consultancy or IT/engineering services firm (e.g. HCL, TCS, Infosys) is acceptable. Profiles whose experience is entirely in consulting or services companies will not be considered.
* Strong hands-on experience with MDLR (Medical Devices Rules, 2017), including manufacturing and import licences, registration dossiers and query handling.
* Strong hands-on experience with US FDA submissions and requirements (510(k)/De Novo, 21 CFR Part 820/QMSR, establishment registration and device listing, UDI, medical device reporting). Strong working knowledge of ISO 13485:2016 and ISO 14971.
* Proven track record of preparing technical files and obtaining product approvals or certifications (for example MDLR licences or FDA clearances).
* Experience with Class II/IIb/III devices.

**Preferred**

* Certified ISO 13485 Lead Auditor.
* Experience with FDA inspections, and with other stringent regulators such as EU MDR (notified bodies), Health Canada, TGA, PMDA or SFDA.
* Additional experience working with overseas manufacturers, or in an importer/distributor or regulatory consulting setting, after a manufacturing foundation.
* Product experience in one or more of these areas: patient monitoring accessories, respiratory devices, dialysis, IVF, cardiovascular or single-use sterile devices.
* Six Sigma Green Belt or similar training in problem-solving.
* Familiarity with PLM or SAP systems.

**Key skills and competencies**

* Regulatory strategy and submission planning
* Technical writing and document review with strong attention to detail
* Analytical, structured problem-solving
* Ability to manage several registrations and deadlines at once
* Clear written and verbal communication with regulators and international partners
* Team leadership and cross-functional collaboration
* Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

**Key performance indicators**

* Registrations and licences obtained on schedule
* First-time-right submissions (few queries and rejections)
* Zero major non-conformities in external audits
* CAPAs and complaints closed within target timelines
* Licences and certificates renewed before expiry, with no lapses

**What we offer**

* A senior role building the QA/RA function at a growing, globally focused, women-led group
* Exposure to a wide range of international products and markets, including our Dubai and US expansion
* Competitive compensation in line with experience

**How to apply**

Send your CV to hr@morulaa.com with the subject line "Lead - QA & RA".

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹500,000.00 per year

We are on a strong path of growth, and you’ll get to be part of that journey — helping shape the systems, culture, and capabilities that will scale with us. Note - we are an equal opportunities employer, committed to fostering diversity & growth for all. We welcome applications from traditional and unusual backgrounds and also are happy to discuss any specific accommodations required in the recruitment process to help you shine.

Are you ready to inspire? #MakingWinners #InspireXT #SupplyChainExperts

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Food & Beverage Industry Subject Matter Expert (SME) with 15+ years of industry experience and strong domain expertise in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), product specification management, packaging development and regulatory compliance.

The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of end-to-end F&B product lifecycle processes, including product development, formulation, ingredient management, raw material specifications, packaging specifications, finished goods, quality management and product commercialization.

The candidate will play a critical role in providing functional and domain expertise for PLM transformation initiatives, helping translate business requirements into scalable digital solutions. The role will involve working closely with business stakeholders, product development teams, R&D, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Packaging, Manufacturing and IT teams.

A sound understanding of global food regulatory frameworks, particularly EU and USA regulations, is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

PLM & Product Lifecycle Management

  

* Provide subject matter expertise across the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation and product development to commercialization and product maintenance.
* Understand and define PLM processes covering product development, formulation, ingredient management, product specifications, quality and change management.
* Drive standardization of PLM processes, workflows, approval mechanisms and governance across business functions.
* Define business requirements and translate them into functional specifications for PLM platform implementation.
* Support PLM transformation initiatives, process optimization and digitalization programmes.

Product Specification Management

  

* Demonstrate strong expertise in managing product specifications across raw materials, ingredients, intermediates, finished goods and packaging materials.
* Understand specification attributes, technical data, nutritional information, allergen declarations, composition, physical and chemical properties and quality parameters.
* Define and manage specification lifecycle processes, including creation, review, approval, version control and obsolescence.
* Understand specification relationships, hierarchies, inheritance, dependencies and cross functional data requirements.
* Establish governance for specification accuracy, completeness, traceability and data integrity.

Packaging Management

  

* Provide functional expertise in primary, secondary and tertiary packaging processes and specifications.
* Understand packaging materials, structures, dimensions, weights, artwork, labeling, packaging components and material compliance.
* Support packaging development, packaging change management, supplier collaboration and packaging approval processes.
* Understand packaging sustainability, recyclability, material composition and environmental compliance requirements.
* Work with packaging engineering, procurement, quality and regulatory teams to define packaging specifications and associated workflows.

jobs.title: Scientific Officer Environmental Fate
jobs.description:
**Auxilife Scientific Services Pvt. Ltd.**  
**Job Title:** Scientific Officer Environmental Fate  
**Location:** Pune, Maharashtra  
**Reports To:** General Manager & Regulatory Head  
**Position Summary**  
The Scientific Officer Environmental Fate will be responsible for supporting regulatory environmental fate and exposure assessments of agrochemicals, pesticides, biocides, plant protection products and other regulated chemical products. The role involves reviewing, interpreting and evaluating environmental fate study reports and data relating to degradation, metabolism, adsorption/desorption, mobility, leaching, hydrolysis, photolysis and environmental persistence in soil, water and sediment.

  

The position will involve assessing environmental fate data requirements, conducting literature searches, reviewing scientific study protocols and reports, preparing environmental fate summaries, performing data gap assessments and supporting environmental exposure and risk assessments. The role will also contribute to regulatory dossier preparation and submissions for product registrations in India and international markets, including the EU and APVMA.  
**Key Responsibilities**  
**1. Environmental Fate and Behaviour Assessment**

* Review, interpret and evaluate environmental fate studies in accordance with applicable regulatory guidelines and requirements.
* Assess degradation and persistence of chemicals in soil, including aerobic and anaerobic soil degradation, degradation kinetics and DT50/DT90 values.
* Evaluate hydrolysis, aqueous photolysis, soil photolysis and other relevant transformation processes.
* Review soil and aquatic metabolism studies, including identification, characterisation and assessment of transformation products and metabolites.
* Evaluate adsorption/desorption studies, Koc/Kd values, mobility, leaching potential and environmental distribution of active substances and metabolites.
* Interpret studies relating to dissipation, degradation pathways, persistence, bioavailability and environmental fate.
* Assess environmental fate data for regulatory acceptability, study reliability, relevance and completeness, and identify data gaps.
* Prepare environmental fate summaries, scientific interpretations and weight-of-evidence assessments for regulatory submissions.

**2. Environmental Exposure and Risk Assessment**

* Support environmental exposure assessments for soil, groundwater, surface water, sediment and other relevant environmental compartments.
* Review and interpret predicted environmental concentration (PEC) calculations and exposure estimates for active substances, metabolites and formulated products.
* Support groundwater exposure and leaching assessments, including review of relevant modelling inputs, assumptions and outputs.
* Evaluate environmental exposure scenarios, application rates, application methods, crop/use patterns, environmental conditions and relevant mitigation measures.
* Review environmental fate parameters used in exposure and risk assessments, including degradation rates, adsorption coefficients and relevant metabolite parameters.
* Assist in assessing environmental risks and interpreting exposure estimates in conjunction with ecotoxicological endpoints and regulatory risk assessment criteria.
* Support preparation and review of environmental fate and exposure sections of regulatory risk assessment reports and dossiers.

**3. Environmental Fate Modelling and Data Evaluation**

* Support environmental fate and exposure modelling using relevant regulatory tools and models, as applicable to the project and jurisdiction.
* Review model input parameters, assumptions, scenarios, outputs and supporting environmental fate data for scientific consistency and regulatory relevance.
* Familiarity with EU FOCUS groundwater and surface-water exposure assessment approaches and models such as PEARL, PELMO and other applicable tools will be beneficial.
* Assist in evaluating predicted concentrations in groundwater, surface water and soil and in interpreting model results for regulatory purposes.
* Conduct sensitivity checks and identify critical parameters influencing environmental exposure estimates, where required.
* Maintain organized records of modelling inputs, calculations, assumptions, results and technical justifications.

**4. Regulatory Affairs and Dossier Support**

* Support regulatory registration and approval processes for agrochemicals, pesticides, biocides and other regulated chemical products.
* Prepare, review and compile environmental fate and behaviour sections of regulatory dossiers for submission to authorities in India and international markets.
* Review applicable regulatory guidelines, data requirements, legislation and assessment frameworks relevant to environmental fate and exposure.
* Conduct environmental fate data gap assessments and identify additional studies, information or evaluations required for product registration.
* Assist in preparing scientific justifications, bridging arguments, read-across assessments and responses to regulatory authority questions, where scientifically appropriate.
* Support responses to regulatory comments, technical queries and requests for clarification related to environmental fate, exposure and groundwater assessment.
* Monitor regulatory developments and guidance affecting environmental fate and environmental exposure assessment.

**5. Literature Search and Scientific Review**

* Conduct scientific literature searches for environmental fate, degradation, metabolism, adsorption, mobility, leaching and environmental exposure information.
* Evaluate published studies and publicly available scientific information for relevance, reliability and suitability for regulatory use.
* Prepare literature review reports, scientific summaries, environmental fate assessments and technical justifications.
* Review and document relevant information on metabolites, transformation products, degradation pathways and environmental properties.
* Maintain databases of environmental fate studies, regulatory guidance, scientific publications, study references and relevant physicochemical information.

**6. Study Coordination and Project Management**

* Coordinate with external laboratories and CROs for conducting environmental fate studies, as required.
* Review study protocols, study progress, draft reports and final reports against applicable regulatory requirements and study objectives.
* Coordinate with clients, sponsors, laboratories and internal regulatory teams to obtain technical information, study data and supporting documentation.
* Support preparation of study plans, study requirement lists, project timelines and regulatory data tracking documents.
* Maintain project records, environmental fate databases, study tracking documents and technical correspondence.
* Ensure timely completion, accuracy and quality of assigned environmental fate and regulatory projects.

**7. Technical Review and Team Support**

* Support technical discussions and knowledge sharing within the regulatory and environmental fate team.
* Review scientific documents, environmental fate assessments, data summaries and regulatory deliverables for accuracy, consistency and compliance with applicable guidelines.
* Collaborate with toxicology, ecotoxicology, residue, efficacy and other regulatory specialists to support integrated regulatory evaluations.
* Contribute to internal technical procedures, templates, guidance notes and knowledge-management activities.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Masters degree or PhD in Environmental Engineering, Environmental Chemistry or chemical Engineering.
* Scientific Officer: 0 to 3 years of relevant experience. Freshers with relevant postgraduate qualifications may also be considered.
* Knowledge of environmental fate endpoints, including degradation, metabolism, adsorption/desorption, mobility, leaching, hydrolysis and photolysis.
* Understanding of OECD

**Job Purpose**

To lead telecom regulatory compliance, nodal operations, government liaison, and legal documentation. The role will ensure adherence to applicable DoT/TRAI/TERM Cell requirements, manage authorised Law Enforcement Agency (LEA) requests, strengthen regulatory frameworks, and maintain accurate, timely, and audit-ready compliance records.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Ensure compliance with applicable DoT guidelines, TRAI regulations, telecom licence conditions, TERM Cell requirements, and other relevant regulatory directives.
* Monitor regulatory notifications, circulars, amendments, and policy changes; assess their impact and coordinate timely implementation.
* Coordinate with DoT, TRAI, TERM Cell, and other relevant authorities on regulatory submissions, inspections, audits, and compliance queries.
* Act as a key liaison with authorised Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs), including police departments, cybercrime units, and intelligence agencies.
* Oversee the receipt, validation, tracking, documentation, and timely processing of lawful interception and data disclosure requests in accordance with applicable law and approved procedures.
* Coordinate with internal technical, network, IT, information security, legal, and business teams to address regulatory requirements and resolve operational issues.
* Prepare, review, and maintain regulatory correspondence, legal documentation, official submissions, evidence-related records, and supporting documents.

* Build and maintain professional working relationships with government officials, regulatory authorities, law enforcement stakeholders, and internal leadership.
* Manage sensitive escalations and confidential communications with appropriate discretion, information security, and adherence to approved access controls.

**Qualification & Experience**

* Education: Graduate or postgraduate qualification in Law, Public Administration, Management, or a related discipline preferred.
* Experience: 7+ years of overall professional experience, preferably with substantial experience in telecom regulatory compliance, nodal affairs, government relations, or legal operations.
* Industry Exposure: Experience with a telecom operator or telecommunications service provider is strongly preferred.
* Certifications (if any): Relevant certifications or professional development in telecom regulations, legal compliance, public administration, or regulatory affairs will be an added advantage.

* DoT / TRAI / TERM Cell compliance and understanding of applicable telecom regulatory requirements.
* Nodal and regulatory operations; LEA coordination and authorised request management.
* Regulatory framework development, SOPs, compliance calendars, trackers, and audit documentation.
* Legal documentation, regulatory correspondence, court coordination, and evidence-related documentation.
* Regulatory audits, MIS reporting, risk identification, confidentiality, and escalation management.
* Knowledge of telecom licence conditions, security requirements, and lawful interception/data disclosure procedures.
* Added advantages: Experience with regulatory portals, compliance systems, and dashboard-based reporting.

**Functional Skills:**

* Interpretation of regulatory requirements and translation into operational processes.
* Regulatory submissions, deadline management, and compliance monitoring.
* Government liaison, LEA coordination, and stakeholder management.
* Legal record management, audit readiness, and corrective action tracking.
* Cross-functional coordination with Legal, Network, IT, Information Security, and business teams.

**Behavioral Competencies:**

* High integrity, discretion, and sound judgment when handling confidential matters.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage time-sensitive requests, escalations, and competing priorities.
* Strong analytical, risk assessment, and problem-solving abilities.
* Stakeholder influence, collaboration, and continuous improvement mindset.

Syngenta Crop Protection keeps plants safe from planting to harvesting. From the moment a seed is planted through to harvest, crops need to be protected from weeds, insects and diseases as well as droughts and floods, heat and cold.

**Accountabilities**

* Develop a Corporate Affairs & Reputation Management action plan for India that supports the delivery of the regional corporate affairs strategy, and which is specific to the circumstances, issues and stakeholders in India. The approach should identify key stakeholders (government, research institutes, NGOs, media, investors, academics etc) and their influencers across the region and form the basis for detailed action and engagement plans.

* Deliver pro-active reputation management (identification, informing, educating and influencing), particularly with key government stakeholders relevant issues (e.g. technology acceptance, public private partnerships and collaborations, regulatory policy and implementation in concert with regulatory affairs through a “License to Operate” environment) with disciplined and consistent stakeholder management activities including the use of direct engagement and the full array of communication and influence channels – media, public forums, industry groups, speeches and keynotes etc.

Ensuring wherever possible the alignment between stakeholder objectives and Syngenta’s own objectives.

jobs.title: Sr Manager - Global Information Security
jobs.description:
Maintain an integrated governance, risk, compliance and resilience assurance capability as the second line of defence for technology, cybersecurity and data risks.  
Independently challenge first-line risk assessments, control assertions, recovery strategies and residual-risk decisions.  
Govern business continuity and disaster-recovery readiness for critical business services, platforms, applications, data and technology dependencies, including business impact analysis, recovery objectives, recovery design, exercise coverage, evidence and remediation.  
Maintain enterprise security risk and compliance frameworks, risk registers, control assurance, policy governance, regulatory and certification readiness, key risk and performance metrics, and leadership reporting.  
Provide the CISO, CRO, GMC and Board committees with a transparent view of risk exposure, recovery confidence, exceptions, emerging threats and accountable closure plans.

Key External & Internal stakeholders: CISO and GIS leadership; Enterprise Risk Management; Business Continuity Management; Enterprise IT; Core Networks; Interaction Fabric; Cloud & MSS; application and platform owners; Data Privacy; Legal and Regulatory; Finance; Procurement; Crisis Management; Internal Audit; BU risk champions; GMC and Board / Risk Committee secretariats.

Minimum qualification & experience:

Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering or related discipline; 12-15 years in technology risk, cyber GRC, business continuity, disaster recovery, audit or resilience, including at least 5 years leading enterprise assurance, risk or resilience programs.  
Strong knowledge of ISO 31000, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO 22301, ISO/IEC 27031, NIST CSF 2.0, NIST SP 800-34, COBIT 2019, COSO and three-lines governance.  
Working knowledge of telecom and digital-infrastructure resilience.  
Expertise in BIA, critical-service mapping, recovery time and recovery point objectives, maximum tolerable period of disruption, scenario design, exercise validation, recovery evidence, systemic dependency and concentration-risk analysis.  
Strong quantitative analysis, executive writing, facilitation, challenge and influencing skills.  
Relevant certifications may include CISM, CISSP, CRISC, CBCP/CBCI, ISO 22301  
Lead Implementer/Auditor, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or CGEIT.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Enterprise security GRC and second-line risk assurance

Maintain the security and technology risk framework aligned with ERM, risk appetite and the three-lines model, ensuring critical/high risks are treated within SLA, overdue risk acceptances are monitored and residual-risk trends are effectively managed.

2. Business continuity, disaster recovery and cyber recovery assurance

Govern BIA and critical-business-service mapping for business processes, customer services, applications, infrastructure, data, suppliers and facilities. Validate RTO, RPO and maximum tolerable disruption against business impact. Independently assess recovery architecture, technology DR, immutable backup, clean-room and cyber recovery arrangements. Define annual exercise coverage and evidence standards, observe tests and challenge whether recovery was achieved end to end, not merely whether infrastructure started. Ensure critical services have approved dependency maps and validated recovery plans, monitor RTO/RPO test achievement and recovery tests completed versus plan, identify critical services without credible DR, and track the ageing of recovery gaps and evidence quality.

3. Compliance, policy and control assurance

Maintain obligations and control mapping across ISO/IEC 27001, ISO 22301, NIST, SOC reporting, contractual commitments, data-protection and applicable telecom / critical-infrastructure requirements. Govern policy lifecycle, exceptions and attestations. Coordinate assurance plans, internal and external audits, certifications and evidence readiness. Validate sustainable corrective actions and prevent repeat findings. Ensure compliance coverage and control maturity, timely closure of audit / regulatory issues, policy review and attestation completion, management of overdue exceptions and achievement of certification milestones.

4. Resilience improvement, crisis preparedness and stakeholder engagement

Lead cross-functional resilience reviews, scenario analysis, tabletop exercises and post-incident lessons learned. Ensure corrective and preventive actions address root causes and systemic dependencies. Challenge third-party continuity and exit arrangements. Build risk and resilience capability through owner training, playbooks and communities of practice. Provide risk input to investment prioritization and transformation roadmaps. Monitor exercise participation and scenario coverage, CAPA closure and recurrence rate, critical supplier assurance coverage, crisis-role readiness, recovery investment linked to quantified exposure, and BU owner training and attestation completion.

Envirocare Labs is a premier NABL-accredited laboratory with over 45 years of excellence in analytical testing, inspection, and certification services. Job Title: Quality Analyst – Food, Dairy & Sweets Manufacturing

**Company:** Bikanervala  
**Location:** Gurugram, Haryana  
**Department:** Quality Assurance / Quality Control  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 1–5 Years  
**Industry:** Food Processing, Dairy Products, Sweets & Confectionery

Job Summary

Bikanervala is looking for a dedicated and experienced Quality Analyst with practical knowledge of food quality control, dairy processing and Indian sweets manufacturing.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring product quality, food safety, hygiene, process control and regulatory compliance across food production and processing operations.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in dairy products, khoya/mawa, paneer, ghee, milk-based sweets and traditional Indian sweets, along with knowledge of FSSAI regulations, HACCP, GMP, GHP, SSOP and ISO 22000 standards.

Key Responsibilities1. Raw Material Quality Inspection

* Inspect incoming raw materials such as milk, cream, khoya, paneer, ghee, sugar, flour, besan, dry fruits, edible oils and other food ingredients.
* Check raw material quality, freshness, specifications and supplier COAs.
* Conduct physical, chemical and sensory inspections.
* Monitor milk quality parameters, including fat, SNF, acidity and adulteration.
* Identify and segregate rejected or non-conforming raw materials.
* Maintain incoming material inspection records.

2. In-Process Quality Control – Dairy Products

* Monitor quality during the manufacturing of milk, paneer, curd, yoghurt, ghee, butter, khoa and other dairy products.
* Monitor pasteurisation temperature and holding time.
* Check milk fat, SNF, acidity, pH and moisture.
* Monitor coagulation, fermentation, cooling and processing parameters.
* Ensure product consistency, texture, colour and taste.
* Monitor chilling, cold storage and hygienic handling practices.

3. In-Process Quality Control – Indian Sweets

* Monitor quality during the manufacturing of Rasgulla, Rasmalai, Gulab Jamun, Kaju Katli, Barfi, Peda, Kalakand, Milk Cake, Besan Laddu, Motichoor Laddu and other traditional sweets.
* Monitor sugar syrup concentration using a refractometer (Brix).
* Check cooking temperature and processing time.
* Monitor moisture, texture, colour, taste and consistency.
* Check frying temperature and frying oil quality.
* Ensure uniformity in product size, weight, shape and appearance.
* Monitor cooling, handling and storage conditions.

4. Finished Product Quality Inspection

* Conduct final quality inspections before product release.
* Perform sensory evaluation for appearance, colour, taste, aroma and texture.
* Check product weight, moisture, pH, acidity, fat and Brix wherever applicable.
* Verify packaging quality, sealing and product labelling.
* Monitor batch number, manufacturing date and expiry date.
* Coordinate microbiological testing.
* Ensure finished products meet approved quality specifications.

5. Food Safety, Hygiene & Sanitation

* Ensure compliance with FSSAI regulations and applicable food safety requirements.
* Monitor personal hygiene and food handling practices of production employees.
* Conduct regular production-floor hygiene inspections.
* Ensure proper cleaning and sanitation of equipment, utensils, processing areas and machinery.
* Monitor pest control, waste disposal and water quality.
* Prevent cross-contamination and allergen contamination.
* Verify cleaning and sanitation records.

6. Food Safety Management Systems

* Implement and monitor HACCP-based food safety systems.
* Ensure compliance with GMP, GHP and SSOP.
* Support implementation and maintenance of ISO 22000 standards.
* Identify potential biological, chemical and physical hazards.
* Monitor Critical Control Points (CCPs) and applicable OPRPs.
* Maintain food safety monitoring and verification records.
* Ensure calibration of laboratory and quality inspection instruments.

7. Laboratory Testing & Analysis

* Perform routine physical and chemical testing of raw materials and finished products.
* Conduct milk testing for fat, SNF, acidity and adulteration.
* Perform moisture, pH, acidity and Brix analysis.
* Monitor frying oil quality and deterioration.
* Coordinate microbiological testing, including total plate count, yeast and mould, coliforms and other applicable parameters.
* Maintain laboratory records and test reports.
* Coordinate external laboratory testing when required.

8. Quality Audits & Documentation

* Conduct daily quality inspections and internal hygiene audits.
* Identify non-conformities and process deviations.
* Perform root cause analysis using 5 Why and Fishbone techniques.
* Implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).
* Maintain raw material inspection reports, production quality records, CCP monitoring sheets, laboratory reports, cleaning records and audit documentation.
* Support internal, external, FSSAI and customer audits.
* Maintain product traceability and recall-related records.

9. Coordination with Production & Operations

* Coordinate with production teams to maintain consistent product quality.
* Identify and resolve quality issues during manufacturing.
* Communicate deviations and recommend corrective measures.
* Coordinate with procurement, warehouse and operations teams.
* Monitor customer complaints, product rejections and quality improvement activities.
* Conduct food safety and hygiene awareness training for production employees.

Required Skills & Technical Knowledge

* Strong knowledge of FSSAI regulations and food safety standards.
* Practical knowledge of dairy processing and Indian sweets manufacturing.
* Hands-on experience in HACCP, GMP, GHP, SSOP and ISO 22000.
* Knowledge of milk testing, including fat, SNF, acidity and adulteration.
* Knowledge of khoya/mawa quality testing and moisture analysis.
* Experience in Brix testing using a refractometer.
* Knowledge of frying oil quality monitoring.
* Understanding of microbiological testing and shelf-life evaluation.
* Knowledge of CAPA, root cause analysis and internal quality audits.
* Good analytical, coordination and problem-solving skills.
* Strong documentation and reporting abilities.

Important Practical Skills Required

Candidates with hands-on experience in the following areas will be preferred:

* Milk quality testing and dairy product analysis.
* Khoya/Mawa quality inspection.
* Sugar syrup concentration testing (Brix).
* Moisture analysis of sweets and dairy products.
* Frying oil quality monitoring.
* Microbiological testing and hygiene monitoring.
* Shelf-life evaluation of dairy products and Indian sweets.
* Finished product sensory evaluation.
* Production-floor quality monitoring and batch inspection.
* Educational Qualification
* B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Food Technology.

Experience Required

* 1–5 years of experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Control.
* Experience in dairy, sweets, confectionery or food processing manufacturing will be preferred.
* Freshers with strong practical knowledge and relevant educational qualifications may also be considered.
* B.Tech. / M.Tech. in Food Technology.
* B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Dairy Technology.
* B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Microbiology or Biotechnology with relevant food industry experience.

How to Apply

jobs.title: Food Saftey & Prodcution Suprevisor
jobs.company: Amadora Gourmet Ice Cream Pvt. Ltd.
jobs.description:
Food Safety & Production Supervisor

**Company:** Amadora Gourmet Ice Cream Pvt Ltd **Location:** Velachery Central Kitchen, Chennai **Reports to:** Head of Operations **Type:** Full-time, on-site (factory-based, with periodic store visits) **Apply to:** jobs@amadora.in

About Amadora

Amadora makes premium artisanal ice cream, baked goods, sauces, bars and cakes from scratch — no premixes, no compounds. Everything is produced at our central kitchen in Chennai on Pastomaster and Carpigiani equipment and distributed to franchise and company-owned stores across Chennai, Bengaluru and Hyderabad. As we scale, the discipline of the factory floor is what protects the brand.

The Role

We are looking for a food technologist who has worked as a Food Safety Executive and is ready to own both sides of the floor: making sure production runs the way the process says it should, and making sure food safety norms are followed without exception, every single day.

This is a hands-on shop-floor role, not a desk role. You will be present during production, checking that steps are followed as written, catching deviations while they are still small, and holding the line on hygiene, traceability and equipment condition. Alongside the daily work, you will drive our ISO certification programme and partner with the Training team to take food safety standards out to the stores.

Key Responsibilities

1. Daily production supervision

* Verify that every batch is produced to the approved recipe, sequence, temperature and time parameters — pasteurisation, ageing, batch freezing, blast freezing, hardening and packing.
* Run and sign off start-of-shift, in-process and end-of-shift checks; ensure line clearance between batches and between allergen and non-allergen runs.
* Check equipment and tooling condition before use — moulds, scoops, containers, gaskets, blades — and enforce immediate quarantine and physical removal of any damaged, chipped or worn item from the production area.
* Monitor CCPs and record readings in real time; escalate deviations immediately rather than at end of day.
* Verify raw material and packaging at receipt (COA, temperature, condition, shelf life) and enforce FEFO in cold rooms and dry stores.
* Support the production plan — yields, batch sizing, changeover time, wastage — and flag where process adherence and output targets are in conflict.

2. Food safety and hygiene compliance

* Own day-to-day implementation of HACCP, GMP and GHP across the facility.
* Manage personal hygiene, health checks, gowning and handwashing compliance for all production staff.
* Schedule and verify cleaning and sanitation (CIP and manual), pest control, water testing, swab testing and calibration; maintain the records.
* Run the foreign-material control programme: metal, glass, hard plastic, wood and mould-fragment controls, with defined inspection and breakage procedures.
* Manage the finished-goods and shelf-life testing programme, micro sampling and third-party lab coordination.
* Maintain FSSAI licence conditions and Schedule 4 compliance; be the point person for FSSAI and customer audits.
* Investigate customer complaints and internal non-conformances to root cause, define CAPA, and verify that the corrective action actually holds a month later.
* Maintain full batch traceability and be able to run a mock recall to closure.

3. ISO / FSSC certification

* Lead preparation for ISO 22000:2018 (and FSSC 22000 where applicable) — gap assessment, documentation, PRPs, HACCP plan, internal audits, management review and closure of certification body findings.
* Build and maintain the food safety management system documentation: manual, procedures, formats, records.
* Train and hand-hold the production team through the changes the certification requires, so the system survives after the certificate is issued.

4. Store food safety, with the Training team

* Work with the Head of Training to convert factory food safety standards into simple, teachable store-level procedures — cold chain, thawing, display, scooping hygiene, cleaning schedules, expiry management, allergen handling.
* Co-create training content, checklists and audit formats for franchise and company-owned stores.
* Conduct periodic store food safety audits, score them, and drive closure of findings with the operations and training teams.
* Support franchisee-side FSSAI compliance and readiness for regulatory inspections.

5. Documentation and reporting

* Maintain daily, weekly and monthly food safety and production compliance dashboards.
* Report non-conformances, wastage, complaint trends and audit scores to management with clear cause and action.

Qualifications and Competencies

**Required**

* B.Tech / M.Tech / B.Sc / M.Sc in Food Technology, Food Science, Dairy Technology or a related discipline.
* 3–6 years of experience, including a proven stint as a Food Safety Executive or Officer in a food manufacturing environment.
* Working knowledge of HACCP, GMP, GHP, FSSAI regulations and Schedule 4.
* Experience preparing for or maintaining ISO 22000 / FSSC 22000 certification.
* Comfortable with documentation and record discipline — you can build a format, and you can also make people fill it correctly.
* Physically comfortable working in a cold-chain environment, including chillers and blast freezers, and around early production shifts.

**Preferred**

* Dairy, frozen dessert, bakery or chocolate manufacturing background.
* Certified HACCP Level 3 / ISO 22000 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor.
* Multi-site or retail-outlet audit exposure.
* Working Tamil and English; Kannada or Telugu a bonus given our other markets.

**Competencies we care about**

* Willingness to stop a batch. The right answer is sometimes expensive, and we want someone who says it anyway.
* Firm without being adversarial — you will be enforcing standards on colleagues you work beside every day.
* Bias for root cause over blame; interest in why the process allowed the mistake, not just who made it.
* Attention to detail that holds up on day 200, not just day 20.

What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)

* **Month 1–3:** You have mapped every production line end to end, documented the actual process against the written SOP, and produced a prioritised gap list covering process adherence, hygiene, equipment condition and record-keeping.
* **Month 3–4:** Daily production and food safety checks are running consistently across all shifts, with real-time recording and same-day escalation of deviations — verified by you, not self-reported.
* **Month 6:** The ISO 22000 documentation set is complete, PRPs and the HACCP plan are implemented, and the first full internal audit cycle has been completed with CAPAs closed.
* **Month 6–9:** A store food safety standard, training module and audit checklist are live with the Training team, and the first round of audits is complete across Chennai stores.
* **Month 9–12:** ISO certification audit cleared, with no major non-conformances outstanding.
* **Through the year:** A measurable fall in food-safety-related customer complaints and internal non-conformances, with a traceability and mock-recall capability that closes within the target window.

Why Amadora

You will be the person who owns food safety at a brand that makes everything from scratch — which means real process, real risk and real ownership, not a premix line where the standards were set by someone else. You will build the system, certify it, and take it out to every store. Direct access to the founder and the leadership team, and a company growing fast enough that what you build now becomes how it operates at three times the size.

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

Key Responsibilities

● **Multi-Entity Accounting:** Simultaneously maintain and manage independent books of accounts in Tally for VGP Heritage Private Limited, VG Panneerdas & Co. Private Limited, and VGP Heritage Foundation, ensuring clean inter-company tracking and entity-specific compliance.

● **Audit & Statutory Compliance:** Coordinate directly with statutory auditors for annual account finalization and tax compliances, as well as with internal auditors to ensure timely compliance with ESI, PF, and FSSAI regulations.

● **Banqueting & Venue Rental Billing:** Manage accounting and complex tax structures for banquet events—including bundled food and liquor packages—as well as standalone venue-only rentals, ensuring accurate GST application across different service categories.

● **Sales & Aggregator Reconciliation:** Record and reconcile daily F&B sales across direct dine-in/takeaway channels and third-party platforms EazyDiner), accounting for commissions, discounts, and payout settlements.

● **Purchase & Inventory Accounting:** Accurately book purchase entries for liquor procurement (handling state excise, VAT, and hospitality-specific taxes) alongside daily provisions, perishables, and general supplies.

● **POS, Inventory & Payment Gateway Management:** Oversee Petpooja POS accounting integrations, manage end-to-end inventory and stock-keeping modules within Petpooja, and reconcile daily card/UPI settlements from EDC swiping machines.

Position: Quality Auditor – Dairy Operations

**Department:** Quality Assurance (QA)  
**Industry:** Dairy / Food Processing  
**Job Type:** Full-Time | Touring Job  
**Location:** Jabalpur/Bhopal/Borgaon/ Rewa  
**Reporting To:** Head – Quality Assurance / Senior Management

1. Job Purpose

To conduct regular quality audits across dairy plants, BMCs (Bulk Milk Cooling Centres), milk collection centres, and other operational locations to ensure compliance with quality standards, food safety regulations, hygiene practices, and company policies. The role involves extensive travelling, identifying quality gaps, preparing audit reports, and ensuring timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Quality & Process Auditing**

* Conduct scheduled and surprise quality audits at dairy plants, BMCs, milk collection centres, and other company locations.
* Monitor milk procurement, reception, processing, pasteurization, chilling, storage, and dispatch processes.
* Verify adherence to approved SOPs, quality parameters, and operational standards.
* Inspect raw milk, processed milk, and finished dairy products for quality compliance.
* Check hygiene, sanitation, cleaning procedures, and CIP (Cleaning-in-Place) practices.
* Verify temperature monitoring, cold-chain management, and storage conditions.

**B. Food Safety & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable FSSAI regulations and food safety requirements.
* Monitor GMP, GHP, HACCP, and other applicable food safety standards.
* Inspect employee hygiene, protective equipment, pest control, and sanitation arrangements.
* Verify quality records, laboratory registers, calibration records, and documentation.
* Identify deviations and non-compliance with statutory and internal quality standards.

**C. Laboratory & Quality Control Monitoring**

* Review laboratory testing procedures and quality control records.
* Verify testing of milk parameters such as Fat, SNF, CLR, Acidity, MBRT, and Adulteration.
* Check calibration and maintenance status of laboratory equipment.
* Ensure proper sampling, testing, recording, and reporting practices.

**D. Audit Reporting & Corrective Actions**

* Prepare detailed audit reports with observations, non-conformities, and supporting evidence.
* Classify audit findings based on their severity and operational impact.
* Recommend corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Follow up with concerned departments to ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Escalate critical quality issues to the reporting authority immediately.
* Maintain audit records, compliance trackers, and location-wise performance reports.

**E. Touring & Coordination**

* Travel regularly to different plants, BMCs, milk collection centres, and other operational locations.
* Prepare and follow a structured monthly audit tour plan.
* Coordinate with Plant Heads, Quality Teams, Production Teams, and Procurement Teams.
* Conduct follow-up visits to verify implementation of corrective actions.
* Submit daily tour reports and periodic consolidated audit reports.

3. Required Qualifications

* B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Dairy Technology, Dairy Science, Food Technology, Microbiology, or related discipline.
* Knowledge of dairy processing, food safety, quality control, and laboratory testing.

4. Experience

* 3–5 years of relevant experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Control / Quality Auditing in the dairy or food processing industry.
* Experience in conducting plant audits and quality inspections will be preferred..

5. Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong knowledge of dairy quality parameters and food safety standards.
* Good observation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to identify process deviations and quality risks.
* Strong report-writing and documentation skills.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and audit reporting.
* Ability to work independently across multiple locations.

6. Other Job Requirements

* Must be comfortable with extensive travelling across Madhya Pradesh.
* Willingness to conduct unannounced and surprise audits.
* Must have a valid driving licence; two-wheeler/four-wheeler driving capability preferred.
* Should be flexible to travel and stay at different locations as per business requirements.

**Important:** This is a field-oriented touring position and the candidate must be comfortable with frequent travel to different operational locations.

* Background in B2B SaaS, restaurant tech, food tech or POS/delivery platforms.
* Experience running pilots or beta programs with paying customers.
* Ability to back every number on your resume (baseline, time frame, what you owned).

**Why join**

* Work directly with the founders, with no layers in between.
* **Freshly funded, with the new money going into building the products you'll own.**
* Paying customers already, so you're not building on a promise.
* Fast decisions, weekly launches, and real ownership of what ships.
* Competitive pay

jobs.title: Director AI Transformation
jobs.description:
**Primary Purpose**

The Director AI Transformation is responsible for the enterprise-wide governance, assurance, and delivery oversight of artificial intelligence (AI) across UOW Global Enterprises (UOWGE). The role ensures that AI is implemented in a safe, ethical, compliant, and value-driven manner, while enabling innovation and measurable institutional outcomes.

The position establishes and leads AI governance frameworks, risk and assurance processes, and lifecycle standards, and provides strategic and operational oversight of AI delivery across all campuses and jurisdictions. Acting as the central coordination point, the role is positioned within the Business Transformation Portfolio and partners with UOW IMTS, Risk and Assurance, Governance and Legal, and business units to embed responsible AI and scale AI-enabled capabilities as directed by the UOWGE AI Strategy and aligned to UOW AI policy.

**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities**

**AI Governance and Assurance**

* Establish, implement, and continuously improve the UOWGE AI governance framework, aligned to UOW AI policy, local regulatory requirements, and global best practice.
* Define and enforce AI standards, controls, and guardrails, including ethical use, explainability, model transparency, and acceptable use.
* Oversee AI risk management and assurance processes, including risk identification, classification, mitigation, and reporting across all AI initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with data protection, privacy, academic integrity, and jurisdiction-specific regulatory requirements.

**AI strategy and institutional alignment**

* Translate UOWGE strategic priorities into a coherent AI transformation roadmap, aligned to institutional outcomes such as student success, operational efficiency, and growth.

**AI Delivery Oversight and Execution**

* Establish and monitor AI delivery frameworks, including intake, prioritisation, business case development, and benefits realisation.
* Partner with Digital Transformation, IMTS, and Data and Analytics teams to ensure AI solutions are effectively integrated into the enterprise data warehouse and analytics ecosystem.
* Ensure appropriate delivery methodologies, controls, and quality assurance processes are applied to all AI-related projects.
* Monitor and report on portfolio performance, including timelines, risks, value realization

**AI Lifecyle and Capability Management**

* Define and oversee the AI lifecycle management framework, including model development, validation, deployment, monitoring, and retirement.
* Ensure mechanisms are in place for model performance monitoring, bias detection, and drift management.
* Build and maintain AI capability maturity across the organisation, including tools, platforms, and processes.

**Stakeholder Engagement and Operating Model**

* Act as the central coordination point for AI across UOWGE, ensuring alignment across business units and functions.
* Establish and lead AI governance forums, working groups, and communities of practice.
* Drive strong engagement with internal and external stakeholders to support safe adoption and value realisation.

**Responsible AI and Cultural Adoption**

* Champion responsible AI principles, ensuring all AI initiatives uphold ethical standards and institutional values.

**Education & Experience:**

**Essential:**

* Bachelors degree in data science, computer science, information systems, analytics, or related discipline

* Demonstrated experience establishing governance frameworks, risk controls, and assurance processes

jobs.title: R&D – Food Formulation & Microencapsulation
jobs.description:
**Position Overview:**

This position involves developing innovative food and beverage products with a specific focus on food formulation and microencapsulation technologies. The role includes developing and optimising food formulations, working with microencapsulated ingredients, evaluating encapsulation techniques, and improving ingredient stability, functionality, solubility, dispersibility and controlled release properties in food applications.

The candidate will be responsible for executing laboratory-scale trials, ingredient selection, formulation optimisation, product testing and supporting the scale-up and commercialisation of new products. The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to translate innovative ingredient technologies into commercially viable food products.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop, optimise and validate food and beverage formulations based on product requirements and application needs.
* Work on microencapsulation of functional food ingredients, including flavours, colours, vitamins, minerals, oils, probiotics and other bioactive ingredients.
* Explore and work with microencapsulation techniques such as spray drying, coacervation, emulsification and other relevant encapsulation technologies.
* Identify and evaluate suitable core materials, wall materials, carriers and encapsulating agents for different food applications.
* Conduct laboratory-scale experiments and optimise formulation and process parameters to improve encapsulation efficiency, stability and product performance.
* Evaluate the physicochemical properties of encapsulated ingredients, including particle size, moisture content, solubility, dispersibility, encapsulation efficiency and stability, wherever applicable.
* Incorporate microencapsulated ingredients into different food matrices and evaluate their functionality, compatibility and performance.
* Conduct ingredient calculations, proximate analysis, sensory evaluation and shelf-life studies.
* Evaluate and select suitable wall materials and carrier materials based on ingredient compatibility, encapsulation efficiency, stability and intended food application.
* Develop and optimise formulations based on food safety, regulatory requirements, quality standards and commercial feasibility.
* Coordinate with R&D, quality, production and other cross-functional teams for product trials, process optimisation and scale-up.
* Maintain experimental records, prepare technical reports and document product development activities.
* Stay updated on emerging encapsulation technologies, functional ingredients and innovations in food science.

**Qualifications:**  
Master’s or Ph.D. in Food Science, Food Technology, Food Engineering, Dairy Technology, Culinary Arts, or related field

**Responsibility and Decision-Making Authority:**  
Empowered to make project and cross-functional decisions in partnership with peers.

**Experience:**  
Minimum 1–3 years of relevant experience in food product development, food formulation or applied food science R&D, with at least 1 year of hands-on experience in microencapsulation technology, encapsulated ingredient development or application of microencapsulated ingredients in food formulations.

Hands-on experience in spray drying, coacervation, emulsion-based encapsulation or application of microencapsulated ingredients in food products will be preferred.

**Travel:**  
Ability to travel as required

Ensure workplace safety and effective communication of Safety, Health and Environment to all team members.

Coordinate with other departments for production related activities, *viz.* trials, new product development, and technical projects.

Prepare related information and wherever necessary participate in standard audits (HACCP, ISO, GMP etc.).
