jobs.title: Product & GIS Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Product & GIS Development Engineer  
   
\*\*Department:\*\* Smart Grid Digital Solutions\  
\*\*Location:\*\* Pune, Maharashtra\  
\*\*Experience:\*\* 36 Years\  
\*\*Qualification:\*\* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, E&TC or related discipline; candidates with relevant GIS/software development experience may also apply\  
\*\*Indicative Salary:\*\* 7 LAKH PER ANNUM, depending on experience and technical capability  
   
## Job Purpose  
   
The Product & GIS Development Engineer will be responsible for developing and maintaining Arakan GridWatch, our customer-facing smart grid monitoring and GIS-based distribution network intelligence platform.  
   
The candidate will work on GIS mapping, feeder visualization, FPI location mapping, live device monitoring dashboards, data integration, database management and customer reporting for 11 kV, 22 kV and 33 kV distribution networks.  
   
## Key Responsibilities  
   
### A. GIS Mapping & Distribution Network Visualization  
   
- Develop and maintain GIS-based distribution network maps.  
- Map 11 kV, 22 kV and 33 kV feeders, substations, DTCs, poles and FPI installation locations.  
- Create feeder-wise, voltage-wise and subdivision-wise GIS layers.  
- Display FPI locations on interactive maps.  
- Develop feeder route visualization and network hierarchy.  
- Enable users to view device locations and their current status.  
- Import, clean and manage GIS data received from field surveys and customers.  
- Support GIS-based asset inventory and network documentation.  
   
### B. Arakan GridWatch Platform Development  
   
- Work on the development and improvement of the Arakan GridWatch web platform.  
- Develop dashboards for live FPI monitoring and feeder status.  
- Create device status indicators such as Online, Offline, Fault and Normal, based on available device data.  
- Develop fault indication and restoration event visualization.  
- Build customer dashboards with feeder-wise, voltage-wise and subdivision-wise information.  
- Develop event history, alarm history and communication health reports.  
- Create user-friendly interfaces for utility customers and internal operations teams.  
   
### C. SCADA & API Data Integration  
   
- Coordinate with the SCADA & Integration Engineer for data integration.  
- Receive SCADA data through approved APIs or other agreed interfaces.  
- Develop API integrations using REST APIs and JSON.  
- Process incoming device data and update dashboards.  
- Integrate device master data with live monitoring information.  
- Develop data validation and error-handling mechanisms.  
- Coordinate with the SCADA partner for data structure and integration requirements.  
   
### D. Database Development & Management  
   
- Design and maintain databases for:  
 - Customer and utility details.  
 - 11 kV, 22 kV and 33 kV feeder information.  
 - Substation and distribution asset details.  
 - FPI device master and installation locations.  
 - Device coordinates and asset details.  
 - Fault and restoration events.  
 - Communication status.  
 - User access and activity logs.  
- Work with SQL databases such as PostgreSQL.  
- Use PostGIS or equivalent spatial database technology.  
- Maintain data consistency and backup procedures.  
- Develop reports and database queries for customer requirements.  
   
### E. Software Development & Customization  
   
- Develop and maintain web-based dashboards.  
- Work with frontend technologies such as React, JavaScript, HTML and CSS.  
- Work with backend technologies such as Python, Node.js or equivalent.  
- Integrate GIS libraries such as Leaflet or OpenLayers.  
- Work with QGIS, GeoServer and PostGIS for GIS-related activities.  
- Develop new modules based on customer requirements.  
- Perform software testing, bug fixing and performance improvements.  
- Maintain source code, technical documentation and version records.  
   
### F. Customer Reporting & Analytics  
   
- Develop feeder-wise fault and restoration reports.  
- Generate voltage-wise and subdivision-wise monitoring reports.  
- Develop FPI communication health reports.  
- Create device availability and downtime reports.  
- Develop historical event reports.  
- Create customer-specific dashboards and exportable reports.  
- Support future development of fault trend analysis and maintenance planning modules.  
   
### G. Product Testing & Deployment  
   
- Test the application before customer deployment.  
- Verify GIS coordinates and device locations.  
- Check data accuracy between SCADA and GridWatch.  
- Test user access and dashboard functionality.  
- Support cloud or customer-hosted deployment.  
- Coordinate with external developers and technology partners.  
- Provide technical support during customer demonstrations and deployment.  
   
## Required Technical Skills  
   
\*\*GIS & Mapping\*\*  
   
- QGIS  
- PostGIS  
- GeoServer  
- Leaflet or OpenLayers  
- GIS data formats such as SHP, GeoJSON and KML  
- Spatial database concepts and coordinate systems  
   
\*\*Software Development\*\*  
   
- React / JavaScript  
- HTML / CSS  
- Python or Node.js  
- REST API integration  
- JSON data handling  
   
\*\*Database\*\*  
   
- PostgreSQL or MySQL  
- SQL queries  
- Database design and management  
- Basic data security and backup concepts  
   
\*\*Smart Grid Domain Knowledge\*\*  
   
- Understanding of 11 kV, 22 kV and 33 kV distribution networks.  
- Knowledge of feeders, substations, DTCs and distribution assets.  
- Basic understanding of FPI devices and fault monitoring.  
- Understanding of SCADA data and real-time monitoring concepts.  
   
## Preferred Experience  
   
- GIS-based utility or electrical network projects.  
- Distribution network mapping.  
- SCADA dashboard development.  
- IoT monitoring applications.  
- Real-time data visualization.  
- Asset management or utility mapping software.  
- Web-based monitoring platforms.  
   
## Key Performance Indicators  
   
- Accuracy of GIS mapping and device locations.  
- Timely development of GridWatch modules.  
- Successful integration of SCADA data.  
- Dashboard reliability and usability.  
- Quality of software documentation.  
- Timely resolution of bugs and application issues.  
- Successful completion of customer-specific development requirements.  
   
## First 90-Day Expectations  
   
- Understand the Arakan GridWatch product requirements.  
- Develop a sample GIS map of a distribution feeder.  
- Map sample FPI devices with their locations and status.  
- Develop a working monitoring dashboard.  
- Integrate sample SCADA data through an API.  
- Demonstrate device status, fault events and communication health.  
- Prepare basic database design and technical documentation.  
   
---  
   
# Why Join Arakan Group Arakan Smart Grid?  
   
- Opportunity to work on emerging smart grid and distribution automation technologies.  
- Opportunity to develop a utility-focused digital monitoring platform.  
- Exposure to FPI, SCADA, RTU/FRTU, GIS and IoT technologies.  
- Opportunity to work across 11 kV, 22 kV and 33 kV distribution networks.  
- Opportunity to work with electrical utilities, EPC companies and technology partners.  
- Scope to grow with a developing smart grid business.  
   
\*\*Interested candidates can share their updated CV along with details of relevant project experience, technical skills and current/expected salary.\*\*

\*\*Business Division:\*\* ARAKAN SMART GRID\  
\*\*Location:\*\* Pune, Maharashtra

jobs.title: Product Designer Lighting Solutions
jobs.description:
**LOCAL MUMBAI CANDIDATES >>> IMMEDIATE JOINERS ONLY >>>**

  

**Product Designer Lighting Solutions**

  

**Company:** Unilights.co

**Location:** Vile Parle (East), Mumbai

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Experience:** 1-4 Years (Candidates with exceptional design and client-handling abilities may also be considered)

  

**About Unilights**

  

Unilights is a bespoke lighting solutions and manufacturing company specialising in decorative lighting, customised chandeliers and architectural lighting solutions. With an extensive product portfolio and an established Experience Centre, we work closely with architects, interior designers, hospitality professionals and discerning clients to transform spaces through lighting.

  

We are looking for a design-oriented professional who can bridge the gap between product design and client requirements, transforming qualified business leads into successful client engagements.

  

**The Role**

  

This is a client-facing Product Designer role that goes beyond conventional designing.

You will receive qualified, high-intent leads from our Sales Team and take ownership of the design consultation and product presentation process. Your responsibility will be to understand the client's requirements, recommend suitable products from the Unilights portfolio, present customisation possibilities, and build enough confidence in our design solutions to move the client towards a purchase decision.

  

**You will be the design expert who makes the client fall in love with the product and the possibilities it offers.**

  

Key Responsibilities

  

**1. Client Engagement & Design Consultation**

* Connect with qualified leads handed over by the Sales Team.
* Understand the client's project requirements, design preferences, budget indications, dimensions and aesthetic expectations.
* Engage with architects, interior designers, consultants and end clients professionally.
* Understand the application of lighting within the overall interior design concept.

  

**2. Product Presentation & Customisation**

* Present relevant products from the extensive Unilights portfolio, including chandeliers, decorative lights and bespoke lighting solutions.
* Recommend products based on the client's design language, space requirements and functional needs.
* Suggest suitable modifications in dimensions, finishes, materials, colours and configurations.
* Translate the client's ideas into practical, aesthetically appealing lighting solutions.

  

**3. Client Visits & Product Demonstrations**

  

* Visit architects, interior designers and project sites whenever required.
* Carry physical product samples, material finishes, catalogues and relevant references.
* Demonstrate product quality, customisation possibilities and design applications.
* Coordinate with internal design and technical teams to address specific client requirements.

  

**4. Product Positioning & Conversion**

  

* Present suitable product options and indicative pricing to clients.
* Explain the value proposition, craftsmanship, customisation possibilities and product specifications.
* Handle design-related queries and objections confidently.
* Follow up on design discussions and presentations until the client is convinced to proceed with Unilights.
* Ensure a smooth handover to the originating Sales Executive once the client expresses purchase intent.

  

**5. Internal Coordination**

  

* Work closely with the Sales Team to ensure seamless lead ownership and client communication.
* Coordinate with the product, design and manufacturing teams to validate customisation feasibility.
* Maintain records of client preferences, proposed products, samples presented and design discussions.
* Ensure all relevant product information is communicated accurately to the Sales Executive for the next stage of the sales process.

  

Understanding the Sales Workflow

  

**Lead Generation Design Consultation Product Presentation**

**Client Conversion Commercial Closure**

  

* **Sales Executive:** Generates leads through Instagram, WhatsApp groups, cold calling and existing databases. Qualifies prospects and passes high-intent leads to the Product Designer.
* **Product Designer:** Takes charge of design consultation, product recommendations, customisation discussions, sample presentations, client visits and moving the prospect towards a buying decision.
* **Sales Executive:** Resumes ownership once the client is ready to proceed, handling commercial negotiations, final quotations, order coordination and after-sales communication.

  

*The Product Designer is primarily responsible for design-led client conversion, not commercial negotiations or after-sales management.*

  

**Who Are We Looking For?**

  

* A graduate in Product Design, Industrial Design, Interior Design or a related discipline.
* Strong aesthetic sensibility and an understanding of contemporary design trends.
* Excellent verbal communication, presentation and interpersonal skills.
* Confidence in interacting with architects, interior designers and premium clientele.
* Ability to understand client requirements and translate them into suitable product recommendations.
* A proactive, persuasive and solution-oriented approach.
* Willingness to travel for client meetings, product demonstrations and site visits.
* Ability to balance creativity with commercial awareness.

  

**Preferred Skills**

  

* Understanding of lighting products, materials, finishes and manufacturing processes.
* Experience in client presentations, design consultation or product-based sales.
* Familiarity with CAD software, 3D visualisation tools and design presentations.
* Knowledge of bespoke furniture, luxury interiors, decorative lighting or architectural products would be an advantage.

  

**What We Expect**

  

We are looking for someone who:

* Can confidently walk into a meeting with an architect and hold a meaningful design conversation.
* Has the ability to understand what a client wants, even when the client cannot articulate it clearly.
* Can visualise possibilities and suggest products that complement the client's design vision.
* Is persuasive without being pushy.
* Takes ownership of every qualified lead until the design consultation reaches a conversion-ready stage.
* Understands that good design is not just about creating beautiful products; it is also about helping the right client choose the right product.

  

**Why Join Unilights?**

  

* Work with an extensive portfolio of bespoke chandeliers and decorative lighting.
* Get direct exposure to architects, interior designers and premium projects.
* Experience the complete journey from product selection to customised manufacturing.
* Work closely with an experienced design, sales and manufacturing ecosystem.
* Build a career at the intersection of design, client engagement and business development.

  

**If you have an eye for design, the confidence to engage with people and the ability to turn product possibilities into client decisions, we would love to meet you.**

  

**Apply now and become part of the Unilights team!**

**Job Description for Product Management (Associate Director, Director & Senior Director Roles).**

**Role Summary:**

We are seeking a visionary and highly experienced Principal Product Manager / Senior Business Consultant to provide strategic leadership across our core health-tech product portfolios. This individual will act as a senior leader responsible for shaping the overarching strategy, driving execution, and ensuring alignment across multiple high-impact healthcare domains (such as core administrative processing, clinical data exchange, and member-centric platforms). As a Principal, you will not own a single product feature but will be responsible for orchestrating value creation across the broader ecosystem. You will connect the dots between disparate enterprise initiatives, drive cohesive data and platform strategies, and mentor product managers to deliver solutions that meet the strategic goals of enGen and our health plan partners.

Key Takeaway (Ideal Candidate Profile) The ideal candidate is a seasoned product strategist with deep expertise in the US payer/provider landscape. They excel at "connecting the dots" across complex enterprise platforms, driving overarching product vision, and influencing executive stakeholders to prioritize high-value, scalable healthcare solutions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Enterprise Product Strategy & Vision (40%)
* Portfolio-Level Roadmap: Define and champion a unified strategic vision that connects roadmaps across various health-tech domains, ensuring they collectively contribute to enterprise goals like operational efficiency, improved health outcomes, and seamless provider/member experiences.
* Strategic Decision-Making: Act as the ultimate decision-maker on value sequencing and prioritization for large, cross-domain initiatives. Make informed, data-driven trade-offs that balance short-term client needs with long-term platform scalability.
* Innovation & Market Research: Serve as the organization's thought leader on emerging trends in healthcare technology (including automation, advanced analytics, and interoperability). Champion innovative solutions and build compelling, quantitative business cases for new strategic investments. 2. Cross-Functional Orchestration & Governance (35%)
* Ecosystem Collaboration: Act as the primary orchestrator between siloed product pillars, engineering leaders, data architecture teams, and business stakeholders. Identify opportunities for reusable solutions (e.g., shared data connectors, enterprise APIs, common business rules) to eliminate redundancy and accelerate delivery.
* Stakeholder Influence: Influence stakeholders at all levels, from health plan executives to engineering leads, without direct authority. Articulate complex technical and healthcare business concepts to build consensus and drive alignment across a matrixed organization.
* Compliance & Data Governance: Champion enterprise-wide governance standards for data exchange, security, and ethical automation, ensuring all solutions are compliant with healthcare regulations (HIPAA, CMS mandates) and securely manage PHI/PII. 3. Mentorship & Team Enablement (25%)
* Product Leadership Mentorship: Provide direct guidance, coaching, and mentorship to Product Managers, Owners, and Business Analysts. Elevate the team's ability to think strategically, prioritize for value, and execute agile methodologies effectively.
* Best Practices Evangelism: Define and institutionalize product management best practices, particularly in the areas of data-driven decision-making, value-based prioritization, and outcome-oriented roadmapping.
* Talent Development: Partner with leadership to identify skill gaps and develop talent within the product management organization, fostering a culture of continuous learning and operational excellence.

**Qualifications Required (Must-Have):**

* Extensive Experience: 12+ years of progressive experience in product management, business consulting, or a related strategic role, with a significant portion dedicated to the US healthcare payer or health-tech space.
* Healthcare Domain Expertise: Deep subject matter expertise in broad healthcare domains such as health plan operations, claims processing ecosystems, clinical data integration, or provider network management.
* Strategic Acumen: Proven ability to translate high-level business objectives from health plan partners into a cohesive, multi-product strategy and an actionable roadmap.
* Technical & Data Literacy: Strong working understanding of modern enterprise architecture, cloud-based data platforms, and emerging automation/AI capabilities. Must be able to lead technical discussions and evaluate technology stack trade-offs.
* Data Analysis Mastery: Expert-level ability to leverage data for strategic decision-making, guide analysts, interpret complex operational datasets, and build ROI-focused business cases.
* Exceptional Influence: Demonstrated history of leading large digital transformation initiatives and influencing senior leadership in a complex, multi-tenant environment. Preferred (Nice-to-Have)
* Experience leading legacy system modernization initiatives (e.g., migrating off mainframe/legacy platforms to modern cloud architectures).
* Familiarity with national healthcare data standards (e.g., FHIR, HL7, X12).
* Master’s degree in Business Administration (MBA), Healthcare Administration (MHA), or a related technical field.

**2. About the Role**

The Product Manager - Trade & Forex will own the product and business agenda for entity-based Trade Finance and Foreign Exchange within BBRL. The role will drive portfolio activation, product penetration, customer acquisition, digital adoption, proposition development and regulatory implementation across imports, exports, guarantees, letters of credit, trade assets and entity FX. jobs.title: Product Manager, Power Systems (SaaS)
jobs.description:
**Company description**

  

EIRIS (https://www.eiris.com) is an innovative technology startup dedicated to developing solutions for the energy industry. At EIRIS, we empower the future of network resilience through interoperable and standards-based software solutions.

Our Energy solutions seamlessly integrate renewable energy sources into existing grids, enhancing the stability and scalability of downstream assets. Automating workflows across the entire network infrastructure lifecycle, our solutions enable utility companies and energy producers to meet the evolving demands of modern energy ecosystems.

  

**Job description**

  

We are seeking an experienced Product Manager with hands-on experience in building and managing SaaS products in the energy utilities domain. The ideal candidate will own the end-to-end product lifecycle and play a critical role in shaping product direction by translating utility industry needs into scalable software solutions. This role involves collaborating closely with SMEs, engineering teams and customers to identify inefficiencies, define product capabilities and deliver impactful solutions for the utilities sector.

  

**Key responsibilities**

  

* Define and own the product vision, roadmap and execution strategy for utility-focused SaaS platforms, turning business goals and domain insights into clear requirements, user stories and priorities.
* Work closely with customers and SMEs to drive discovery, feedback and validation cycles, finding gaps in utility workflows (planning, simulation, asset management) to make sure the product fits the market.
* Work with engineering teams using Agile methods to deliver products in line with the roadmap and timelines.
* Ensure integration of modern technologies such as AI/ML, automation and standards-based interoperability into the product.
* Support product positioning, demonstrations and go-to-market activities.
* Track product performance metrics (adoption, usage, retention) and drive continuous improvement.

  

**Qualifications/Skills**

  

* Minimum Bachelors degree in engineering (Electrical preferred) or a related field; MBA is a plus.
* 5–12 years of experience in product management, product engineering or enterprise software development.
* Experience building and managing SaaS or cloud-based platforms, including Agile/Scrum delivery, backlog management and release planning.
* Working knowledge of APIs, data models, integrations and cloud architecture.
* Ability to translate complex domain problems into structured product requirements and scalable solutions.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and prioritization skills.
* Ability to communicate clearly and manage stakeholders across utility engineers, development teams, sales and senior leadership.
* Understanding of utility workflows such as transmission/distribution planning, power system studies or DER integration is a big plus.
* Familiarity with power system analysis tools such as ETAP, PSS®E, PowerFactory, PSCAD or CYME is preferred.

  

**Who should apply?**

  

This role is well-suited for individuals who understand utility engineering challenges and want to build scalable SaaS products that modernize legacy workflows. It is ideal for professionals who want to combine domain knowledge with product ownership, drive AI-first innovation in the utilities sector and make a high-impact contribution in a fast-paced startup environment.

  

To apply, please send your updated resume to recruitment@eiris.com.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Purchase Manager with a strong background in hospitality procurement to oversee end-to-end purchasing operations for our expanding hospitality business in Chennai. The candidate will be responsible for strategic sourcing, vendor development, cost optimisation, inventory control, and ensuring uninterrupted supply of quality materials across operational requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end procurement operations, including food ingredients, beverages, kitchen equipment, crockery, cutlery, packaging materials, housekeeping supplies, and other hospitality essentials.
* Develop and manage a strong network of local and regional vendors, suppliers, distributors, and manufacturers.
* Identify cost-effective sourcing opportunities without compromising on product quality and operational standards.
* Negotiate bulk purchase rates, commercial terms, credit periods, payment terms, and vendor contracts.
* Establish procurement strategies and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for efficient purchasing operations.
* Manage centralised procurement and coordinate material requirements across multiple hospitality units or outlets.
* Work closely with kitchen, F&B, operations, stores, and finance teams to forecast material requirements and plan purchases.
* Monitor food and non-food inventory, stock movement, reorder levels, and consumption patterns.
* Implement cost-control measures to minimise procurement costs, food wastage, stock losses, and material expiry.
* Evaluate vendor performance based on quality, pricing, consistency, and delivery timelines.
* Ensure quality checks and compliance with applicable FSSAI, hygiene, and food safety standards.
* Oversee purchase documentation, including Purchase Orders (PO), GRN, invoices, vendor agreements, and payment coordination.
* Prepare procurement budgets, cost analysis, vendor comparison reports, and MIS.
* Conduct regular market research to identify new suppliers, alternative products, and competitive pricing.
* Ensure uninterrupted material availability to support smooth day-to-day hospitality operations.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Graduate in any discipline; a degree/diploma in Hospitality Management, Supply Chain Management, or Procurement will be an added advantage.
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in procurement or purchase management, preferably in hotels, restaurants, QSRs, central kitchens, or large-scale F&B operations.
* Strong exposure to food, beverage, non-food, and hospitality equipment procurement.
* Proven experience in vendor development, bulk purchasing, commercial negotiations, and cost optimisation.
* Understanding of inventory management, food costing, stock audits, and procurement budgeting.
* Knowledge of FSSAI standards and food quality requirements.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, ERP, and purchase management systems.
* Strong analytical, leadership, negotiation, and team coordination skills.
* Must be capable of independently managing procurement operations and developing a vendor ecosystem in Chennai.

jobs.title: Brand Manager - Europe
jobs.description:
**NULO IS:**

We are the fastest-growing U.S. pet food specialty brand and have recently begun our European expansion with major retail listings across Italy, Spain and the UK. We were named “Top 25 Most Innovative Consumer Brands” by Forbes Magazine, offering industry-leading dog and cat food products with a world-class sales team, in a multi-billion-dollar industry that’s ripe for innovation and change. Imagine inspiring pet parents to think differently about the experience of feeding their dogs and cats, to feed them like the little athletes they are - with foods high in meat protein, low in carbs and infused with viable probiotics. To learn more visit www.nulo.co.uk

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

After entering the market in late 2025, Nulo is entering an exciting phase of European growth - building our presence across existing markets while preparing to expand into a number of major new markets from 2027 onwards.

As Brand Manager Europe, you will play a central role in building Nulo into a distinctive, relevant and commercially successful brand across Europe, with primary responsibility for the UK, Spain and other key markets. Working closely with the Head of Marketing, local Marketing Managers, as well as wider European and global brand/commercial teams, you will translate Nulo’s global brand strategy into key European growth markets, driving the short and long-term success of the brand in Europe.

This is a hands-on brand management role with ownership across annual brand planning, marketing campaigns, consumer insight, brand health, proposition development and commercial performance. You will be the guardian of Nulo’s brand positioning and distinctive assets, developing and delivering the brand strategies and activation plans needed to drive sustainable growth in each market.

Fluent English and Spanish are essential with additional European languages useful. Frequent European travel is expected.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

* **Own the Annual Brand Marketing Plan –** working closely with the European Head of Marketing, create and deliver the annual marketing plan in key priority markets, aligned to commercial priorities and long-term brand strategy
* **Lead Consumer Communications –** adapt and deliver compelling, locally relevant communications across paid, owned and earned channels
* **Build & Optimise the Nulo Demand Generation Engine –** working with the wider marketing team, develop and own a full-funnel demand generation programme that drives brand awareness, consideration and trial to recruit consumers at scale
* **Develop Consumer & Category Insight** - build a deep understanding of consumers, category dynamics, competitors and emerging trends, converting insight into clear actions for the brand and portfolio.
* **Drive Brand Health & Performance** - track brand, category and commercial performance across priority markets, identifying growth opportunities and actions to improve awareness, consideration and trial, driving brand penetration and equity.
* **Shape Local Brand Positioning** - act as a guardian of Nulo’s positioning, distinctive assets and brand codes, ensuring global consistency is combined with local relevance
* **Portfolio Strategy & Innovation** - Lead on product lifecycle including performance analysis, opportunity identification, working with global teams on innovation and renovation
* **Lead Integrated Brand Campaign Development** - work with local & global teams and agency partners to develop and execute local campaigns.
* **360 Customer Planning** – lead development and execution of joint customer marketing plans.
* **Support Pricing & Portfolio Architecture** - partner with Commercial and Finance to inform pricing, pack architecture, promotional strategy and portfolio choices that support brand equity and profitable growth.
* **Brand P&L management** - manage and report on full brand P&L including managing brand investment, setting priorities and evaluating activity effectiveness
* **Agency & Partner Management** - lead relevant agency and specialist partner relationships, setting clear briefs and ensuring high-quality, on-brand delivery against timings and budgets.
* **Cross-functional Brand Leadership** - act as a key connector across Marketing, Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, Regulatory and Global Teams to align priorities and deliver key initiatives

  

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

**Essential Experience & Skills**

* 5+ years of brand management or marketing experience in FMCG, food, pet, or a related consumer-goods sector.
* Strong experience developing annual brand plans and translating consumer and commercial insight into clear growth strategies.
* Strong analytical capability with experience using consumer, category and commercial data to identify opportunities and measure performance.
* Commercial mindset with an understanding of pricing, promotional strategy, portfolio architecture and brand P&L drivers.
* Experience developing integrated campaigns and working across the full funnel
* Demonstrable experience working with key customers including joint business planning and shopper activations.
* Strong agency and cross-functional stakeholder management experience.
* Excellent communication, presentation and influencing skills, with the ability to turn strategy into clear direction for others.
* Budget management experience and a strong focus on investment effectiveness.
* Fluent English and Spanish.

**Desirable Experience & Skills**

* Experience working across multiple European markets.
* Experience managing a portfolio, including innovation / NPD, renovation, proposition development and product launches.
* Experience within pet food, pet care, food, beverage or another premium FMCG category.
* Additional European languages are a plus.

**WHO YOU ARE:**

* **Brand Builder** - you care deeply about what makes brands distinctive and know how to build equity consistently over time.
* **Consumer Obsessed** - you are curious about people, culture and behaviour and use insight to inform brand strategy.
* **Commercially minded** – you are comfortable converting business objectives into marketing objectives and strategies
* **Analytical** - you are comfortable with data and use it to diagnose performance, challenge assumptions and make clear recommendations.
* **Hands-on** - you are equally comfortable shaping strategy, reviewing packaging, building a business case, briefing an agency and preparing a customer story.
* **Entrepreneurial** - you are a self-starter who thrives in a growing organisation where not every process or answer already exists.
* **Collaborative** - you build strong relationships across functions, markets and external partners
* **Fast & Pragmatic** - you maintain high standards without sacrificing pace of execution in the pursuit of perfection.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL GET:**

* Competitive salary and benefits, in line with the local market and experience.
* Full-time, permanent contract.
* Travel costs covered in line with company policy.

**Location**

This is a full-time, mostly remote position, with frequent European travel. We need this person to be willing to travel frequently around Europe.

**Salary Range:** €45K - €55K

**Ready to take on the challenge and have a little fun while doing it? We’d love to hear from you!**

jobs.title: Research Engineer (Process)
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a highly skilled Process & Chemical Engineer to lead the development, assessment, and scale-up of advanced treatment solutions for complex water, wastewater, and industrial effluents. The role combines deep chemical engineering fundamentals with strong process engineering capabilities to design, validate, and deploy innovative treatment solutions across physico-chemical, biological, thermal, membrane, and electrochemical domains.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for conducting detailed treatability studies, developing integrated flowsheets, and implementing pilot- and field-scale systems for diverse industrial sectors including petrochemicals, refineries, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, and heavy manufacturing. The role requires a strong grasp of contaminant behaviour, reaction engineering, separation processes, and system optimization. The candidate will work across laboratory testing, simulation, bench-scale experimentation, and on-site troubleshooting to deliver high-value treatment strategies. Close collaboration with chemical, biological, thermal, desalination, and digital teams is essential to ensure end-to-end technology development and deployment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end treatability studies covering characterization, experimental design, optimization, and performance validation of water, wastewater, and industrial effluents.
* Develop integrated flow sheets using physico-chemical, chemical, biological, electro-chemical, membrane, and thermal processes based on effluent characteristics.
* Conduct lab-scale and pilot-scale experiments, analyze results, and refine process conditions for scale-up.
* Simulate and model processes using tools such as ASPEN Plus, HYSYS, GPS-X, or equivalent to support design and optimization.
* Work closely with technologists, mechanical engineers, and field teams to translate laboratory findings into deployable pilot systems and field-scale implementations.
* Evaluate external technologies (both mature and early-stage innovations) and assess their applicability, differentiation, and integration potential.
* Support ZLD, high-TDS effluent treatment, and industrial sludge management programs, including development of novel chemical/physical treatment strategies.
* Generate mass balance, energy balance, and kinetic models to inform design and scale-up decisions.
* Assist in techno-economic analyses, benchmarking, cost estimation, and feasibility assessments for treatment technologies.
* Prepare detailed engineering documents, SOPs, experimental logs, and technical reports for internal and external stakeholders.
* Collaborate with digital teams to incorporate data analytics, process monitoring, and modelling improvements.
* Contribute to publications, patents, and standardization initiatives emerging from successful R&D programs.
* Provide field troubleshooting support for treatment failures, optimization needs, or performance deviations at customer plants.

**Qualifications**

* Education: PhD or M.Tech in Chemical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Biotechnology, Industrial Chemistry, or related disciplines.
* Experience: ~10 years total, with a minimum of 5 years in water, wastewater, or industrial effluent treatment.
* Strong knowledge of reaction engineering, separation processes, mass transfer, and water chemistry.
* Experience with lab-scale experimentation, pilot testing, and field implementation.
* Familiarity with process simulation tools (ASPEN, HYSYS, GPS-X, BioWin, or equivalent).
* Publications: Minimum 3–5 publications in peer-reviewed journals; patents or book chapters preferred.
* Strong analytical, communication, and technical documentation skills.
* Ability to work with cross-functional R&D teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

**Location**
Water Technology Centre, Kanchipuram, Tamil Nadu

jobs.description:
FMC Corporation is a global leader in agricultural sciences, driven by our purpose: Innovation for Agriculture. Solutions for the Planet. We are passionate about the power of science to solve agriculture’s biggest challenges. With one of the most productive and diversified pipelines in the industry, FMC is delivering cutting-edge and next-generation crop protection technologies – including Dodhylex™ active, Isoflex™ active, rimisoxafen, and fluindapyr – to help farmers increase the productivity and resilience of their land. Our employees are at the heart of this innovation. We’re looking for bold thinkers and collaborative doers. At FMC, your ideas matter. From day one, you’ll contribute to meaningful work that drives progress in agriculture, supported by a culture that values integrity, safety, respect, and results. Join us in advancing the future of agriculture. Together, we’re building a more resilient planet – one innovation at a time.
  
  
**Job Title: Principal Investigator – Process Engineer**
**Position Summary**
The Process Development group at Innovation Center in Hyderabad works as part of an interdisciplinary team to design and develop synthetic routes for commercial manufacturing processes. Principal Investigator – Process Engineer will provide engineering support of all phases of process development, with responsibility from early stage to commercial launch.  This role includes conducting laboratory-based programs to develop commercial manufacturing processes as part of a cross-functional team of process chemists, analytical chemists and engineers, also partnering with third party Contract Research Organizations (CRO) to ensure pilot campaign success and extract engineering learnings to be used in future commercial manufacturing designs.
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad
  
  
**The Role (daily Responsibilities)**

* Lead chemical engineering deliverables for assigned synthetic programs from early and/or late-stage development through process characterization, technology transfer, piloting, validation, and commercial manufacturing.
* Develop and oversee process engineering deliverables, including Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs), Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), process descriptions, and detailed mass and heat balance calculations.
* Participate in rigorous risk assessments, HAZOP studies, failure-mode evaluations, and ensure adherence to safety and environmental standards.
* Provides subject matter expertise across development and scale-up, supporting technical package preparation, process and equipment fit assessment, scale-up strategies, facility readiness evaluations, technology transfer execution, validation activities, and post-transfer process stabilization.
* Provide strong technical leadership at CDMOs and manufacturing sites, including hands-on floor support, rapid troubleshooting, risk-based decision-making, issue escalation, and execution support during engineering, demonstration, pilot, and commercial campaigns.
* Build and maintain high-trust, high-accountability partnerships with external manufacturing partners by establishing clear governance, decision-making frameworks, communication pathways, performance expectations, and risk management processes.
* Lead or guide investigations, root-cause assessments, deviations, non-conformances, CAPAs, change controls, and process performance reviews using data-driven and science-based recommendations.
* Apply chemical engineering fundamentals, modeling, and manufacturing data to improve process capability, yield, purity, cycle time, safety, sustainability, productivity, and cost of goods.
* Proficiency in data analysis tools and process simulation software (e.g., Aspen, MATLAB, Minitab, AutoCAD).
* Apply reaction engineering, thermodynamics, kinetics, heat and mass transfer, mixing, hydrodynamics, separations, filtration, drying, solid-liquid handling, and equipment design to development and manufacturing challenges.
* Create fit-for-purpose laboratory and engineering experiments, representative scale-down models, and process characterization studies that define mechanisms, operating ranges, robustness, and scale-up criteria.
* Integrate process safety, equipment and facility fit, material compatibility, containment, operability, maintainability, and human-factor considerations into process and technology-transfer decisions.
* Author, review, and defend engineering reports, technology-transfer packages, risk assessments, control strategy documents, technical investigations, and regulatory filing sections.
* Establish trusted relationships with CDMO leaders and technical teams while maintaining clear accountability, protecting FMC requirements, and addressing conflict or performance gaps directly and professionally.
* Distill complex technical information into concise recommendations, decision points, risks, and trade-offs for senior leaders, governance forums, regulatory stakeholders, and external partners.

**The Candidate (requirements)**

* Bachelor's or master's degree or Ph.D in Chemical Engineering is required.
* Chemical engineers with a strong foundation in chemical engineering and organic chemistry, combined with hands-on experience in process development, pilot plant operations, and commercial-scale manufacturing.
* 7-15 years in R&D process development in agrochemicals, pharmaceutical, fine or specialty chemicals industry required.
* Familiarity with concepts of developing safe and cost-effective chemical processes.
* Strong organic chemistry knowledge is a plus.
* Strong written and oral communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively and work in teams of scientists.
* The ability to effectively develop and test hypotheses and quickly determine the feasibility of a proposal is critical.
* Willingness to work flexibly across multiple time zones and travel as required, including primarily domestic travel and occasional international travel.
* Flexible work schedules to accommodate work performed in different geographies required.
* Experience working in kilo, pilot and/or manufacturing scale environments is desirable.

**Location:**
Dubai, United Arab Emirates

**About Robertet**

Founded in 1850 and headquartered in Grasse, France,
**Robertet**
is a global leader in natural raw materials and one of the world's most respected creators of fragrances, flavors, and active ingredients. With a presence in over 50 countries, Robertet combines innovation, sustainability, and scientific expertise to create unique sensory experiences for some of the world's leading brands.

At
**Robertet Middle East**
, based in Dubai, we serve customers across the Middle East and Africa region, providing tailored fragrance solutions through close collaboration between our local team and global experts.

Joining Robertet means becoming part of a company that values creativity, technical excellence, entrepreneurship, and passion for the world of scent.

**About the Role**

As
**Fragrance Development Manager**
, you will be based at Robertet's Creative Center in Dubai and report directly to the Managing Director, Robertet Middle East.

You will be at the heart of transforming market insights and client aspirations into innovative fragrance creations, driving creative excellence and delivering winning fragrance solutions that strengthen customer partnerships and support business growth across the region. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a dynamic, international environment where passion for fragrance, creativity, and collaboration come together to shape memorable olfactory experiences.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage end-to-end fragrance development for Fine Fragrances primarily, and for Personal Care and Home Care occasionally.
* Collaborate with perfumers from France and United States and FDMs from France to guide creative briefs and submissions.
* Build strong partnerships with key clients and support key presentations.
* Stay up to date on regional olfactive trends, brands, and consumer preferences.
* Coordinate with internal cross-functional teams (marketing, sales assistants, production).
* Contribute to the Fine Fragrances strategy with Sales & Marketing: concepts, captive ingredients, etc.

jobs.title: Manager, Nutrition, Health and Wellness
jobs.description:
POSITION VACANCY
  
  
Manager Nutrition Health & Wellness
  
  
POSITION SNAPSHOT
  
  
Company: Nestlé
  
  
Location: Dubai - HQ
  
  
**Position Summary**
Joining Nestlé means you are joining the largest food and Beverage Company in the world. At our very core, we are a human environment – passionate people driven by the purpose of enhancing the quality of life and contributing to a healthier future.
  
  
As the Manager Nutrition, Health & Wellness, you will work across the MENA region and across the full Nestlé portfolio, bringing nutrition science, portfolio insights and local market understanding together to strengthen products, claims and consumer communication. You will also be responsible to apply findings of research, dietary guidelines, relevant population trends, nutritional needs & wants into innovations of nutrition products & digital initiatives; drive continuous improvement of Nestlé products by applying product nutrient profiles and quality criteria in context of population diet, guide products nutrition and health benefits, credible brand communications and stories.. In addition you will also be responsible of building nutrition capability across cross-functional teams to help our brands deliver better choices and enable Nestlé’s Purpose.
  
  
A DAY IN THE LIFE …
  
  

* Inspire nutrition, dietary & dietetics dimensions into business category strategy. Interpret/evaluate available knowledge and nutrition science to guide business partners and product developers.
* Define desired nutritional profile for target population. Consideration of product as part of a diet, define product 's nutritional composition, its nutrition value & measures (criteria, thresholds, scores), lead nutritional assessment to achieve nutritional superiority. Validate final product’s nutritional criteria & composition.
* Identify nutrition gaps & opportunities for portfolio evolution & growth. Understands and articulates the nutrition reality to drive the identification of nutritional needs and gaps in portfolio. Collation of nutrition science, nutrition landscaping, knowledge on key insights from consumer data, competitive analysis, and global and local trends, translate relevant nutrition knowledge into competitive and feasible product concepts and solutions.
* Acts as the local nutrition partner to local marketing teams, translating portfolio, competitive, consumer and scientific insights into nutrition recommendations supporting category and brand priorities. Liaising with cross-functional teams and global Nestlé innovation and R&D centers.
* Provide substantiation behind nutrition or health claims development. Deploy nutrition and health claims positively evaluated by scientific authorities and /or by Nestlé Health Claim Panel in line with business and brand strategy, guide claims within I/R process. Develop scientific substantiation for market driven nutrition & health claims: e.g. write a scientific rationale document for health claims to be evaluated by global strategic teams & Nestlé Health Claims Panel.
* Brings science-based nutrition insights to inspire innovation and build credible, compelling communication stories.
* Trains and engages market employees and marketers on nutrition and contributes to the internal capability agenda and the Nutritionists Community.
* External KOL/ authorities engagement. May represent the organization at different nutrition forums and convenings, including food industry/technical working groups. Content provider and/or a spoke-person for nutritional advocacy topics externally for categories of responsibility. Acts as a key nutrition advisor at any level and understand the areas of opportunities of positive impact and risks within the external nutrition environment, the Food Industry and Public Health environment

What will make you successful…
  
  

* University Degree; Masters in Nutrition/Dietetics, Food science and technology with nutrition specialization)
* 2–5 years of experience as a nutritionist in the food industry, public health or an academic environment.
* Experience in translating nutrition science into product, communication or consumer applications.
* Experience in nutritional portfolio analysis, data interpretation or competitive benchmarking is an asset.
* Experience with local nutrition regulations, claims and labelling.
* Experience in training or communicating nutrition topics to non-expert audiences.
* Exposure to cross-functional business environments (Marketing, R&D, Regulatory) is a strong asset.
* Project management skils and ability to work in matrix organizations.
* Fluency in Arabic is required; proficiency in French is an advantage.

jobs.title: Manager Culinary Development
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose**
Join our Catering team, where you will be part of an exciting business area that plays a vital role in delivering the Emirates ‘Fly Better’ experience. This team is responsible for a wide range of food and non-food functions, including catering, equipment, and amenities for inflight dining and special events.
  
  
If you are passionate about culinary excellence, logistics, and delivering world-class service, we invite you to apply and contribute to the success of Emirates Group. As a key part of our Service Delivery operations, our catering team makes crucial decisions that enhance the customer experience and elevate our growing global brand.
  
  
As a
**Manager Culinary Development,**
you will manage the recipe, dish and menu design process to ensure Emirates remains at the forefront of global culinary trends and innovation. You will lead a centralised Culinary Development Centre of Excellence, responsible for creating, maintaining and governing the Emirates recipe bank. Working in collaboration with key stakeholders and leveraging customer insights and data, you will plan and develop network-wide menus that consistently delight our guests.
  
  
Additionally, you will plan and deliver Dubai-based culinary workshops focused on educating Emirates' global inflight and premium lounge catering partners on menu and dish preparation. In addition, you will oversee Emirates-owned food and beverage products, while developing and managing Emirates-nominated food suppliers to ensure the highest standards of quality, consistency and culinary excellence across the network. We are hiring for two distinct roles, each requiring specialist expertise in either North and South American cuisine development and innovation, or the development, standardisation and management of Special Meals (SPMLs), including Child, Medical, Religious and Allergen-Sensitive Meals.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will Be**

* Accountable for the planning and day to day management of the EK Culinary Centre of Excellence ensuring that annual targets of blue-sky cuisine innovations and individual dish creations are exceeded.
* In collaboration with the Service design team, responsible for supporting the decision making for flight/cabin level meal service standards.
* Accountable for the creation and development of detailed recipes that are conducive to performing optimally in the EK, network wide catering partner facilities.
* Responsible for documenting and version controlling all EK recipes and production methods in the EK owned, catering management system.
* In collaboration with the Regional Catering Management and Business Insights teams, accountable for station level menu planning ensuring customers’ expectations are exceeded.
* Accountable for planning and executing regular Dubai based, global inflight supplier culinary workshops to ensure that the education of individual dish and menu creations are understood and consistently translated around the EK network.
* Accountable for the product development life cycle management of EK owned, category specific, food and beverage items.
* Accountable for developing the EK centralised, nominated food and beverage suppliers to ensure that we are able to constantly improve our speed to market and efficiency gains.
* Responsible for identifying and developing food and beverage promotional and celebratory initiatives to effectively promote and market EKs award winning offering.
* Responsible for carrying out regular industry benchmarking across all hospitality sectors to ensure that EK remains at the forefront of food and beverage innovation.

Qualification
  
  
**To be considered for this role, you must meet the below requirements:**
**Qualification**

* An attested degree (12+3) or equivalent work experience.
* Culinary apprenticeship is preferred.

**Experience**

* 10+ years in culinary development, fine dining, hospitality R&D, or large-scale production. Airline catering experience preferred.
* Demonstrated expertise in the development, innovation and standardisation of menus and recipes featuring North and South American cuisines, with in-depth knowledge of regional culinary traditions, authentic cooking techniques, emerging food trends, ingredient selection, nutritional principles, portion control and cost optimisation, ensuring culinary authenticity, consistency and alignment with diverse passenger preferences.

* And/or
* Demonstrated expertise in the development, innovation, standardisation and management of Special Meals (SPMLs), including Child, Medical, Religious and Allergen-Sensitive Meals, supported by sound knowledge of nutrition, dietary principles, menu engineering, allergen management and religious and cultural food requirements, ensuring nutritional suitability, recipe consistency and alignment with diverse passenger needs.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Comprehensive knowledge of and passion for, global cuisines, emerging culinary trends, and evolving guest preferences.
* Deep expertise in recipe development, standardisation, and large-scale recipe upscaling.
* Strong understanding of airline catering operations, including large-scale production, cook-chill processes, and the associated operational challenges and considerations.
* Proven ability to train, coach and educate colleagues and external catering partners on recipe execution and individual dish preparation.
* Confident and engaging presenter, with the ability to communicate with credibility and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organisation.
* Highly organised with strong planning, prioritisation, and project management capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to perform effectively under pressure and manage competing priorities within tight timeframes.

At Emirates, we're committed to providing our employees with opportunities to grow and develop in their careers. So if you're looking for a challenging and rewarding opportunity, apply today and join our team!
  
  
Salary & benefits
  
  
Join us in a management role and enjoy an attractive tax-free salary. On top of our generous travel benefits, including discounted flights and hotel stays around the world, this managerial role also offers an excellent leave and healthcare package. That's in addition to transport benefits, life insurance and much more.
  
  
Discover what it's like to live and work in our fast-paced, cosmopolitan home city of Dubai and build a rewarding career with Emirates!

jobs.title: Group Research & Innovation Manager
jobs.description:
**We’re Hiring: Group Research & Innovation Manager | Raibal Holding | Fujairah, UAE**

Raibal Holding is recruiting a permanent
**Group Research & Innovation Manager**
to run the Group’s research portfolio across a diversified farming platform, beginning with marine and agricultural research and extending across apiculture and livestock operations as the portfolio grows.

This is not a laboratory-based role. You will be the person who keeps the Group’s research organised, evidenced and moving: coordinating decisions on what to test, continue or stop, and making sure results reach the right destination, whether that is internal use on our farms, research services, commercial transfer or public benefit.

You will work alongside scientists, who retain authority over research methods, integrity and laboratory safety, and with Raibal’s business sponsors, who approve spending, contracts and formal acceptance.

**What you’ll do**

* **Control commitments:**
  oversee active research, agreements and deliverables, with a clear owner, due date and acceptance status for each
* **Maintain reliable evidence:**
  track sources, versions, results and gaps so every claim on priority work is backed by a source, test result or stated assumption
* **Plan capacity and cover:**
  coordinate people, facilities and specialist support, ensuring critical activities have named cover and documented dependencies
* **Prepare decisions:**
  run portfolio reviews, set priorities and bring complete proposals to decision or escalation promptly, with clear options, costs and uncertainties
* **Manage partners and adoption:**
  coordinate approved partnerships with universities, research institutes and technology providers, and ensure every pilot has a sponsor, baseline and measure before launch
* Report portfolio progress to senior management and route successful results into operational use

**What we’re looking for**

* Degree in science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent applied research experience
* Proven leadership of at least two applied research or innovation programmes, including at least one with a measured pilot or adoption result
* Background in marine science, aquaculture, agriculture, food or environmental research is strongly preferred
* Experience coordinating research partners and operating teams to deliver measurable results
* Track record of making and escalating well-reasoned recommendations, with responsibility for budgets
* Excellent written English and clear, structured communication

**Why join Raibal Holding**

A rare opportunity to build and run a Group-wide research portfolio within one of the region’s growing agriculture and farming platforms, where your work translates directly into operational improvements across multiple businesses.

Application deadline:
**30 November 2026**

* Strong communication, organisational and problem-solving skills.
* A genuine passion for hospitality, culinary innovation and developing future culinary talent.
* Flexibility to work evenings, weekends and public holidays.

**What We Offer**

* The opportunity to shape the culinary identity of a distinctive luxury beachfront resort.
* An exciting journey towards the opening of Four Seasons Resort Ajman at Al Zorah.
* Competitive tax-free salary and service charge.
* Medical insurance, annual leave, flight benefits and end-of-service gratuity.
* Complimentary accommodation, transportation and employee meals.
* Training, development and career growth opportunities.
* A collaborative culinary environment where creativity, leadership and craftsmanship are valued.

Join us at BAT, where purpose meets possibility, and your career story unfolds.

* Strong understanding of laboratory quality control, method validation, verification protocols, and biostatistical principles applied in clinical laboratories.

* Willingness to travel within the UAE and across regional markets as required.

At AKI-MEDLAB, you will have the opportunity to:

* Collaborate with experienced professionals and international stakeholders.

Job Title: Senior Dairy Fermentation Process Specialist

**Location:**
United Arab Emirates (Remote)

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Work Arrangement:**
100% Remote — Work From Home

**Level:**
Senior

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Dairy Fermentation Process Specialist to support the technical analysis, performance monitoring, and optimization of dairy fermentation processes. This fully remote role focuses on reviewing fermentation data, evaluating process performance, assessing quality documentation, and identifying opportunities to improve product consistency, operational efficiency, and process reliability.

The successful candidate will collaborate virtually with dairy technologists, food scientists, microbiologists, quality assurance teams, production specialists, and research professionals. The role requires strong knowledge of dairy fermentation principles, starter cultures, process parameters, and quality management. Physical milk handling, culture preparation, fermentation trials, sampling, microbiological testing, production-line operation, and equipment maintenance must be performed by trained local personnel.

Key Responsibilities

* Review dairy fermentation process data, including temperature profiles, acidity, pH, fermentation duration, and culture performance.
* Analyze production trends and identify process variations affecting fermentation consistency, product quality, and yield.
* Evaluate technical documentation relating to milk composition, starter cultures, fermentation parameters, and product specifications.
* Review fermentation trial results and assess the impact of process variables on product characteristics.
* Monitor digital production records, laboratory reports, quality-control results, and process performance indicators.
* Identify potential causes of fermentation deviations and recommend evidence-based corrective and preventive actions.
* Support the evaluation of starter culture performance, microbial activity trends, and fermentation process reproducibility.
* Review standard operating procedures, process specifications, validation documents, and quality management records.
* Analyze product consistency indicators, including acidity, texture, flavor-related measurements, and relevant microbiological results.
* Develop technical reports, process performance dashboards, and recommendations for continuous improvement.
* Collaborate remotely with production, engineering, laboratory, quality assurance, and product development teams.
* Support process optimization initiatives aimed at improving resource utilization, reducing production losses, and maintaining consistent product quality.
* Assist with technical investigations, deviation documentation, and corrective action tracking.
* Maintain accurate digital records and ensure the confidentiality and integrity of technical and production information.

Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Food Science, Dairy Technology, Food Technology, Microbiology, Bioprocess Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Significant professional experience in dairy processing, fermentation technology, food manufacturing, or dairy quality management.
* Strong understanding of dairy fermentation principles, starter cultures, microbial activity, and process control.
* Knowledge of milk composition, fermentation kinetics, acidity development, pH monitoring, and product quality parameters.
* Experience reviewing fermentation trials, production data, laboratory reports, and technical process documentation.
* Familiarity with dairy products such as yogurt, cheese, cultured milk, fermented cream, and other fermented dairy products.
* Understanding of food safety management systems, hygiene standards, quality assurance, and process validation principles.
* Proficiency in data analysis, technical reporting, spreadsheets, and relevant production monitoring systems.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively with multidisciplinary teams in a fully remote environment.

What We Offer

* Fully remote working arrangement with no routine office attendance.
* Opportunity to contribute to dairy process improvement and food manufacturing innovation.
* Collaboration with multidisciplinary food science, microbiology, engineering, and quality teams.
* Exposure to fermentation performance analysis, process optimization, and dairy product development.
* Professional development opportunities in dairy technology and food manufacturing quality systems.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit an updated CV highlighting relevant dairy fermentation, food processing, microbiology, process optimization, and quality assurance experience.

**Application Subject:**
Application – Senior Dairy Fermentation Process Specialist (UAE Remote)

* Candidates should confirm applicable employment arrangements, residency requirements, and work authorization before accepting an offer. Physical milk handling, culture preparation, inoculation, fermentation trials, sampling, microbiological testing, production-line operation, equipment cleaning and maintenance, and on-site hygiene inspections must be performed by trained local personnel. Food safety decisions, microbiological interpretations requiring authorization, production changes, batch release, product disposition, formal validation approvals, regulatory submissions, and statutory sign-offs must be completed by appropriately qualified and authorized professionals.

jobs.title: Senior Skincare Ingredient Compatibility Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Skincare Ingredient Compatibility Specialist

**Location:**
United Arab Emirates (Remote)

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Work Arrangement:**
100% Remote — Work From Home

**Level:**
Senior

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Skincare Ingredient Compatibility Specialist to provide remote technical analysis, formulation assessment, and product stability support for skincare and personal care products. The role focuses on evaluating interactions between cosmetic ingredients, assessing formulation compatibility, reviewing stability data, and identifying potential risks affecting product performance, appearance, texture, and shelf life.

The successful candidate will collaborate remotely with cosmetic chemists, formulation scientists, research and development teams, analytical laboratories, suppliers, and quality assurance professionals. This is a fully remote position; physical formulation preparation, laboratory testing, sample handling, stability experiments, and instrument operation must be performed by qualified local personnel.

Key Responsibilities

* Review and assess ingredient compatibility across skincare formulations, including creams, lotions, serums, gels, cleansers, sunscreens, and other topical products.
* Evaluate interactions between active ingredients, emulsifiers, surfactants, preservatives, stabilizers, antioxidants, fragrances, and functional additives.
* Analyze formulation data to identify potential incompatibilities involving pH, solubility, oxidation, precipitation, discoloration, and phase separation.
* Review stability study results covering temperature exposure, light sensitivity, freeze-thaw cycles, packaging interactions, and storage conditions.
* Assess ingredient specifications, supplier technical data sheets, certificates of analysis, and supporting safety documentation.
* Evaluate the compatibility of skincare ingredients with different formulation systems, including oil-in-water, water-in-oil, anhydrous, and gel-based systems.
* Review analytical reports relating to pH, viscosity, particle size, emulsion stability, preservative performance, and other relevant product characteristics.
* Support remote investigations into formulation instability, changes in product texture, ingredient degradation, and unexpected sensory variations.
* Assess the effects of formulation concentration, processing parameters, and ingredient substitution on product stability and performance.
* Review formulation development records, laboratory protocols, compatibility studies, and product quality documentation.
* Prepare technical reports, ingredient compatibility assessments, stability summaries, and evidence-based formulation recommendations.
* Collaborate remotely with product development, procurement, regulatory, quality, and manufacturing teams.
* Monitor developments in cosmetic ingredient science, formulation technology, and applicable cosmetic product requirements.
* Maintain accurate technical records and protect confidential formulations, supplier information, and product development data.

Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Cosmetic Science, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Science, Chemical Engineering, Biochemistry, or a related discipline.
* Significant experience in skincare formulation, cosmetic ingredient compatibility, personal care product development, or formulation quality assurance.
* Strong understanding of cosmetic ingredients, their functional properties, and potential interactions within different formulation systems.
* Knowledge of emulsions, surfactants, preservatives, active ingredients, antioxidants, rheology modifiers, and formulation stabilization.
* Experience reviewing accelerated and real-time stability studies, compatibility assessments, and analytical laboratory reports.
* Familiarity with cosmetic testing methods, including pH measurement, viscosity analysis, emulsion stability assessment, and relevant chemical analysis techniques.
* Understanding of cosmetic product quality systems, ingredient specifications, and applicable regulatory frameworks.
* Ability to interpret technical data and translate findings into practical formulation improvement recommendations.
* Strong analytical, scientific writing, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
* Proficiency in spreadsheets, statistical analysis tools, digital laboratory systems, and remote collaboration platforms.
* High standards of scientific integrity, confidentiality, and evidence-based technical judgment.

What We Offer

* Fully remote, work-from-home employment arrangement.
* Full-time opportunity in a specialized skincare formulation and ingredient compatibility discipline.
* Competitive compensation based on qualifications and relevant experience.
* Opportunities to contribute to skincare innovation, formulation reliability, and product quality improvement.
* Professional collaboration with multidisciplinary cosmetic science, research, and product development teams.
* Ongoing learning and development in cosmetic chemistry, ingredient technology, and formulation science.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit an updated CV highlighting relevant experience in skincare formulation, cosmetic ingredient compatibility, stability evaluation, and technical product development.

Please include examples of formulation projects, ingredient compatibility studies, stability investigations, or product improvement initiatives where applicable.

**Application Subject:**
Application – Senior Skincare Ingredient Compatibility Specialist (UAE Remote)

Candidates should confirm applicable employment arrangements, residency requirements, and work authorization before accepting an offer.

* **Important Role Boundary:**
  This position is limited to remote technical analysis, formulation documentation review, laboratory data assessment, and virtual coordination. Physical ingredient handling, formulation preparation, laboratory experiments, chemical testing, stability trials, sample preparation, and instrument operation must be performed by qualified local laboratory personnel. Formal cosmetic safety assessments, clinical or dermatological judgments, regulated product claims, product compliance certifications, regulatory submissions, product release decisions, and statutory sign-offs must be completed by appropriately qualified and authorized professionals.

Your work will help strengthen customer support, improve the quality and reuse of technical evidence, and accelerate evidence-based adoption of Animal Biosolutions across MEIA.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**About Analog Sports**
Analog Sports is a training app built around Ana, an AI coach you can just talk to. She builds your training plan, reads the data from everything you train with, and explains what it means for your next session. Analog sponsors professional cycling teams, and they train on the same platform.
  
  
**The role**
You make Ana a great coach. Ana’s coaching is built on your judgement: you turn how an expert coach decides into rules, numbers and tests that Ana follows, and you check that she gets it right. You won’t coach athletes one to one. Your athletes are everyone who trains with Ana.
  
  
We’re a flat organisation, and you report directly to the CEO.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Define how Ana coaches: training load, form and fatigue, building toward an event, testing and recovery. You write each one as clear rules with thresholds and worked examples.
* Write up the coaching logic for the features you own: the problem, the rules, what good looks like, and how we’ll test it. Then work with design and engineering until it ships.
* Own the maths: every metric and calculation in the app is correct, explained in plain words, and reviewed regularly.
* Build the tests that tell us whether Ana coaches well: real athlete cases, the answers a good coach would give, and a score on every release.
* Review Ana’s work: plans, workout feedback and daily guidance. You find where she’s wrong and fix it with our product and AI engineers.
* Sign off the coaching side of every new feature, alongside product.
* Be the coaches’ voice in the product: how coaches work with their athletes in the app, from one athlete to a squad of 200.
* Work with the coaching staff of the professional teams we sponsor.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 10+ years as an expert coach in cycling, running or triathlon, with amateurs as well as elite athletes.
* Deep knowledge of training load and performance modelling: CTL, ATL and TSB, ramp rate, critical power and critical speed, power and pace zones, testing protocols, periodisation.
* Real experience working with AI. You’ve used AI assistants and models seriously in your work, not just tried them. You know what they do well, where they go wrong (confident answers that are wrong, following what’s written rather than what’s meant), and how to steer them. No coding needed.
* Clear writing. You can turn a judgement call into a rule someone else, or an AI, can follow, edge cases included.
* Comfort with data. You’d rather check a calculation against the raw file than trust the chart.

**Nice to have**

* Coaching swimming.
* Coaching strength and weightlifting for endurance athletes.
* An MSc or PhD in exercise physiology or sports science.
* Experience with a professional, continental or national team.
* Experience working on a training app or platform.

**By the end of your first three months**

* Ana’s coaching rules for load, form and testing are written down and in her hands.
* A coaching test set runs on every release.
* Dynamic training plans are working for running, swimming and weight training, alongside cycling.
* Every metric in the app has been checked and explained.
* You’ve written up the coaching logic for at least one new feature and seen it into the build.

The Quality & Hygiene Coordinator is responsible for supporting the implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of quality assurance, food safety, hygiene, and compliance standards across all Food & Beverage operations in Dubai. The position plays a key role in promoting a culture of food safety excellence, operational consistency, and continuous improvement while ensuring the highest standards of hygiene and customer satisfaction are maintained.

* Conduct routine quality and hygiene inspections across all operational areas.
* Monitor compliance with company SOPs, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Identify non-conformities and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
* Assist in reviewing, updating, and implementing quality management procedures.
* Support quality improvement initiatives and operational excellence programs.

* Monitor food handling, preparation, storage, transportation, and service practices.

Documentation & Reporting

* Track non-conformities and monitor corrective action completion.

Incident & Risk Management

* Support environmental health and workplace safety initiatives.

Quality Responsibilities

* Contribute actively to continuous improvement and compliance initiatives.
* Ensure adherence to Dubai Municipality and relevant regulatory requirements.

Essential

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
* Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

Preferred

* Experience supporting internal and external audits.

Competencies & Skills

* Ability to conduct inspections and audits professionally.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Effective report writing and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

Explain master data structures, dependencies, and system requirements; help resolve issues, recommend practical solutions, and support testing and implementation.

* Working knowledge of data governance principles, data quality controls, documentation requirements, and approval workflows.
