jobs.title: F&B Licensing Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**About Wynn Al Marjan Island:**
Wynn Al Marjan Island will be the first integrated resort in the UAE. Set to open in 2027, the resort will be located 50 miles from Dubai International Airport in the emirate of Ras Al Khaimah. The resort will offer 1,530 rooms and suites, 22 restaurants, lounges, and bars, a theater, and a beach club. It will feature multiple swimming and wading pools, water features, a five-star spa, a salon, a shopping promenade, and a celebrations and events center.
  
  
**About The Position**
Wynn Al Marjan Island is currently seeking F&B Licensing Manager to join the resort’s Food & Beverage team.
  
  
**The Primary Duties And Responsibilities Of This Role Are**

* Build and maintain the end ‑ to ‑ end licensing roadmap for Food & Beverage operations (restaurants, bars/lounges, in ‑ venue service points, storage areas, kitchens, outdoor spaces), mapping initial approvals, renewals, amendments, and closures.
* Own a central license register (master tracker) covering legal entity documents, trade/operational licenses, alcohol/beverage permissions where applicable, health & hygiene certificates, music/entertainment permits, signage, outdoor seating, terrace use, delivery, and vehicle/transport approvals.
* Serve as the primary point of contact with relevant Emirate ‑ level and federal authorities (e.g., Economic Development, Municipality/Public Health, Tourism Authority, Civil Defense, Police/Events, and other regulators as applicable) to obtain, amend, and renew approvals.
* Interpret new regulations, assess impact, and update SOPs; cascade requirements across venues and support implementation.
* Lead all event ‑ related licensing and notifications (e.g., celebrations, tastings, brand activations, outdoor events, one ‑ off extensions of hours/areas), coordinating site plans, crowd management, entertainment permits, and security/Civil Defense clearances.
* Partner with Restaurant Events and venue leaders to build permit ‑ ready event packs (layouts, capacities, NOCs, risk assessments) and to secure approvals on time
* Oversee authorized PROs, translation/legalization services, and specialized consultants; negotiate scopes, SLAs, and fees.
* Maintain a calendar of statutory payments (govt. fees, renewals, inspections) and forecast the licensing budget; reconcile costs against plan.
* Maintain accurate license files (digital and physical), logs of submissions and approvals, and a library of approved layouts/certificates.
* Publish weekly dashboards (licenses due in 90/60/30 days, event permits in progress, inspection outcomes, fines/penalties avoided).
* Run the daily licensing control room: check expiries, validate opening checklists for permit ‑ dependent activities, and green ‑ light venue operations.
* Review event requests; confirm permitting path, lead times, and documentation; submit and track approvals through to issuance.
* Verify display of licenses (where mandated), on ‑ site documentation (HACCP, allergen matrices, employee certifications), and emergency contacts.
* Work with the respective outlet management team and designate Venue Licensing Champions in each outlet.
* Conduct induction and refresher training on licensing rules (alcohol service where applicable, events, outdoor use, deliveries, signage), documentation, and inspection etiquette.
* Monitor UAE market and regulatory trends; recommend operational adjustments and process improvements.
* Collaborate positively with all departments and contractors; lead cross ‑ functional licensing meetings and share relevant updates.

**About You:**
The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:
  
  

* 4–6 years in licensing/compliance for hospitality/Food & Beverage, large venues, or integrated resorts in the UAE; proven track record managing multi ‑ venue portfolios and events permits.
* Working knowledge of UAE/Emirate ‑ level licensing frameworks, municipal public health, tourism/entertainment permits, Civil Defense requirements, and HACCP/food safety.
* Advantageous: experience with alcohol licensing and responsible service standards where applicable; Arabic reading or business proficiency.
* Familiarity with e ‑ government portals and document legalization/attestation processes.
* Diploma or degree in Hospitality Management, Business, Law, or Public Administration; compliance or food ‑ safety certifications a plus (e.g., HACCP).
* Fluent English: Arabic or an additional language is an advantage.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, document management systems, and tracker dashboards (e.g., Excel/SharePoint/Power BI).

**About Wynn Al Marjan Island’s Benefits**
We offer an attractive salary, paid in Dirhams (AED), the local currency of the UAE. In addition, we offer an excellent leave policy, a healthcare package and as well as life insurance, incentive programs, and other employee benefits. The result is a package that makes this role highly attractive to outstanding applicants seeking a career with Wynn Resorts, among the most renowned and celebrated brands in the global hospitality industry.

Agriculture Subsidy Redesign, Targeting, and Impact

**Role purpose**

Design and implement subsidies and incentive mechanisms that improve productivity, sustainability, and farmer livelihoods while ensuring
**fiscal sustainability, compliance, and measurable impact**
. This role is a technical lead within the TMO portfolio and owns the end-to-end subsidy reform workstream.

**Responsibilities:**

**Diagnosis and design**

* Map existing subsidy landscape: eligibility, spend, leakage risks,incentive distortions, overlaps.
* Segment beneficiaries (farm types, size,crop/livestock systems, geography, vulnerability).
* Design alternative subsidy models:
* Targeted input subsidies (seed/feed/fertilizer) with controls
* Outcome/conditionality-linked incentives (water efficiency, compliance, productivity)
* Capital grants/ co-investment schemesfor modernization (irrigation, greenhouses, renewables)
* Develop fiscalscenarios and trade-offs for government decision-makers.

**Targeting, eligibility, and controls**

* Define eligibility rules, verification methods,and audit trails(registry integration, land/farm ID, production evidence).
* Design leakageprevention controls (claimsvalidation, supplier vetting,anomaly detection triggers).
* Develop compliance mechanisms and enforcement pathways aligned with regulations.
* Develop cost-benefit scenarios to define and review on an ongoing basis applicability of the subsidies.

**Implementation of architecture**

* Translate designinto executable implementation plan: policy drafts,operating procedures, system requirements, vendor/process changes.
* Work with digital/data teamson:
* Farmer registryintegration
* e-voucher / digital disbursement logic
* Case management workflows for exceptions and appeals
* Support procurement packages (system integrators, payment rails, verification services).

**Monitoring and impactevaluation framework**

* Define an impact evaluation approach:
* Logic models(inputs → outputs→ outcomes)
* Baselines and measurement methods(surveys, remote sensingproxies, administrative data)
* Quasi-experimental designoptions were feasible(phased rollout, comparison groups)
* Establish a benefits trackingdiscipline within the TMO (impactreporting cadence, auditability).

**Stakeholder management**

* Coordinate with finance/treasury, audit,regulators, farmer associations, suppliers, and service providers.
* Develop communication materials to supportadoption and managepolitical economic risks.

**Required experience and qualifications.**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in economics, public policy, agricultural economics, or related.Advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ years in agricultural subsidy/incentives, social supporttargeting, agri-policy implementation, or development programs at leading organization.
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing targeting and payment/disbursement mechanisms (public sector preferred).
* Strong quantitative capability: fiscal modeling,program evaluation methods.
* Familiarity with global best practices (FAO, World Bank, IFAD style program disciplines) preferred.

jobs.description:
**Location: Northeast**

If you are interested in the below position, please send your resume to careers@tgtxinc.com and REFERENCE THE POSITION TITLE within the subject line.

Organizational Overview

TG Therapeutics is a fully integrated, commercial stage, biotechnology company focused on the acquisition, development and commercialization of novel treatments for B-cell diseases. In addition to a research pipeline including several investigational medicines, TG Therapeutics has received approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for BRIUMVI® (ublituximab-xiiy) for the treatment of adult patients with relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis, including clinically isolated syndrome, relapsing-remitting disease, and active secondary progressive disease, as well as approval by several foreign nations for BRIUMVI to treat adult patients with RMS who have active disease defined by clinical or imaging features. For more information, visit www.TGTherapeutics.com.

Role

The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) is a field-based regional Medical Affairs professional responsible for developing and enhancing relationships with medical professionals, researchers, clinical trial support staff, advocacy, and other members of the Myasthenia Gravis (MG) scientific and clinical community. Additionally, the MSL will demonstrate scientific, clinical, and therapeutic area expertise during scientific engagements with key opinion leaders (KOLs) and other healthcare professionals (HCPs) and requires credibility to engage top national and regional thought leaders.

Reporting into the MSL Team Field Director, the MSL is a critical role in TG Therapeutics’ customer-facing field model, collaborating compliantly with cross-functional teams including Clinical Development, Sales, Marketing, and Market Access to provide clinical support and education.

This role will cover the following territory: ME, VT, NH, CT, MA, NY, PA, NJ, MD, DE, RI

Key Responsibilities

* Be a credible medical/scientific expert
* Fair-balanced scientific engagement across the assigned geography; establishes and maintains relationships with KOLs, HCPs, clinics and institutions, payers, and other stakeholders within the MG area
* Responsive and engages regularly with thought leaders and external stakeholders
* Collaborate and support Clinical Development and Clinical Operations research initiatives including site identification and trial recruitment
* Partner with clinical trial sites to optimize patient recruitment strategies, leveraging both data-driven insights and relationship-building
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, and Medical Affairs—to troubleshoot recruitment challenges and streamline processes
* Monitor site performance metrics and provide actionable recommendations to improve enrollment rates.

* Lead and/or participate in special projects or initiatives aligned to US Medical strategy and objectives

Professional Experience/Qualifications

Education

jobs.title: SENIOR INTERNAL AUDITOR
jobs.description:
Job Purpose   

Perform assigned audit engagements, from start to finish, inclusive of preplanning and wrap up activities. Applies risk and control concepts to scenarios encountered and identifies any potential issues.   
Assist in the periodic Risk Assessments and development of the Risk-Based Work Plans and the periodic reporting to the Audit Committee and Senior Management on internal audit activities, performance, significant risk exposures, controls/governance issues and other related matters.

  
  
  
Job Specific Accountabilities (Part 1)   

**Professional Ethics**  
•    Participate in initiating/promoting the establishment and continuous improvement of the Corporate Governance Framework including Enterprise Risk Management, Corporate Code of Conduct, Ethics and Values.  
**Internal Audit Plan**  
•     Assist in the development of Annual Audit Plan (AAP) based on the results of risk assessment exercise.  
•     Provide input for the periodic reporting on audit activities and performance relative to its plans, significant risk exposures, control/governance issues and other related matters.  
**Audit Execution**  
•    Assist the auditors in the examination and analysis of records through executing audit program steps for the assigned audits.  
•    Develop process understanding of assigned business processes and determines business objectives, main functions, the nature of activities, potential risks and controls to be reviewed.Develop a detailed audit program / Risk & Control Matrix (RCM) for the assigned audit including the objectives, potential risk, key controls, audit procedures and the use of audit techniques and tools to evaluate governance, risks and controls processes, and submits audit program to for review and approval.  
•    Determine auditing procedures to be applied, including the use of Information Systems Audit Techniques, statistical sampling method or others.Ensure that adequate working papers and all relevant information are continuously documented and updated in the automated Audit Management System in accordance with pre-defined templates and audit procedures.  
•    Perform the audit in accordance with the approved audit program and ensures that audit objectives have been met to support the audit conclusions/results.  
•    Identify, obtain, analyse and appraise related systems and evidentiary data/information.  
•    Prepare working papers which record and summarize data on the assigned audit and the results of the audit examination.  
•    Appraise the adequacy of the corrective actions taken by management on audit recommendations through follow up audits and periodically reviews and updates the status of management action plans.   
•    Ensures that approved audit objectives have been met with adequate coverage of all relevant areas. Also ensures that sufficient appropriate audit evidence is obtained to support the conclusion and recommendations, and that the work has been performed in accordance with professional audit standards.  
•    Participate in conducting special reviews and undertakes administrative duties as directed by Head of Internal Audit.  
•    Perform (also supervises audits performed by Internal Auditors) in accordance with the approved RACM and professional standards on internal auditing.  
•    Ensures tasks assigned to junior staff are adequately performed and deliverables are in accordance with ADNOC Internal Audit procedures and quality standards.  
•    Identify high risk areas and key control points of the system to be reviewed.  
•    Evaluate the system’s effectiveness based on his / her business and audit experience and modifies, if necessary, the scope of the review, with the approval of Team Leader / Department Manager.  
•    Participate in special committees to provide independent and objective professional advice and consultancy services.

  
  
  
Job Specific Accountabilities (Part 2)   

**Audit Reports**  
•    Prepare audit report with conclusion, expressing professional opinions on the adequacy and effectiveness of risk management, control systems and the efficiency with which activities are carried out. Recommends improvement options to rectify reported deficiencies, for Team Leader / Department Manager’s review.  
•    Recommend practical improvements options corresponding to the observations with an objective to contribute to the improvement of governance, risks and control processes to assist in the achievement of the company business objectives.  
•    Follow- up on replies to issued draft and final audit reports and review the adequacy of the corrective actions taken on audit recommendations / improvement options.  
**Coordination**  
•    Assist Audit Management in arranging Audit Committee meetings, preparing the agenda, and minutes of meetings (MOMs) and reporting on Corporate Governance Framework, General Controls and other related issues as prescribed in the Audit Committee Charter.   
•    Conducts workshops or presentations to create awareness about IA function and demonstrate value addition across the ADNOC.  
•    Communicates identified issues with Internal Audit management to ensure potential high risk area of concerns are addressed in a timely and effective manner.  
**Innovation and Continuous Improvement**

jobs.title: Aviation Regulatory Compliance Senior Specialist
jobs.description:
**Role Purpose**

  

Ensures regulatory compliance across aviation safety and environmental systems by monitoring adherence to local and international aviation regulations, supporting internal audits, validating corrective actions, and contributing to the continuous improvement of safety and environmental performance within the sector.

  

**Key Responsibilities/Duties**

  

1.**Monitor regulatory compliance** with local and international aviation safety and environmental standards, ensuring alignment with ICAO, GCAA, and DCAA requirements.

  

2.**Support internal audit programs** by coordinating audit schedules, reviewing evidence, tracking findings, and verifying closure of corrective actions within required timelines.

  

3.**Review and assess safety management system (SMS) documentation**, including safety reports, risk assessments, and change management submissions to ensure compliance with regulatory frameworks.

  

4.**Analyse operational and environmental data** to identify compliance gaps, trends, and risks, and prepare periodic reports for sector leadership.

  

5.**Coordinate with internal units and external stakeholders** to ensure consistent implementation of regulatory requirements and promote a culture of safety and continuous improvement.

  

6.**Maintain an integrated compliance database** to support decision‑making, reporting, and regulatory oversight activities.

  

7.**Support the preparation of the annual integrated safety and environmental quality report**, including compliance performance, audit results, and risk levels.

  

8.**Assist in developing and updating policies, procedures, and work instructions** related to regulatory compliance and quality assurance.

  

9.**Monitor implementation of change**‑**management plans** and assess their impact on safety systems to ensure alignment with regulatory expectations.

  

10.**Provide technical input** on regulatory updates, compliance risks, and improvement opportunities to enhance the sector’s safety and environmental performance.

  

11.**Other Duties:** Performs other job-related duties as assigned by the Office Manager or Executive Director.

  

**Academic Qualifications:**

  

·Bachelor’s degree inAviation Management, Aerospace Engineering, Safety Management, Environmental Science, or a related field is an advantage.

  

·Master’s degree or higher qualification in Aviation Management, or a related discipline is an additional advantage.

  

**Certifications:**

  

·ICAO Safety Management (SMS) certification preferred.

  

·ISO 9001 / 14001 / 45001 auditor certification is an advantage.

  

·Aviation regulatory compliance or auditing certifications are desirable.

  

**Professional Experience:**

  

·Minimum 8+ years of relevant professional experience with a Bachelor’s degree, or 6+ years of relevant professional experience with a Master’s degree, in aviation safety, regulatory compliance, quality assurance, or a closely related field.

  

·Practical exposure to Safety Management Systems (SMS), audit protocols, and aviation regulatory compliance frameworks within a controlled or regulated environment is preferred.

  

·Experience operating within government or statutory regulatory bodies, demonstrating familiarity with public sector governance, accountability, and compliance standards, is an advantage.

jobs.title: Accountant
jobs.description:
**Role Purpose**

  

To perform accounting tasks of Finance Operations: Bank transactions, Bank Reconciliation Statements, Maintaining Petty cash, ePayment support, Etisalat payments and extend support to functions of Accounts Payable, Receivable, General Ledger, Fixed Assets and Budgeting.

  

**Key Responsibilities/Duties**

  

**1.****Record and Maintain DCAA Accounts**

  

Recording, Updating, attaching, and matching of various documents such as Purchase/Sale Invoices, Delivery notes of Goods and Services, Purchase Orders, Customers Report – Direct Issue Voucher etc; and record the transaction in the GRP Accounts Payable/Receivable system. Extract and provide information to Finance Analyst for reporting and cash management to ensure accuracy of all the transactions recorded.

  

**2.****Processing Payments**

  

Review of DCAA Accounts Payable/Receivables. Payables - supplier’s statements, priority payments and proceed with preparation of payment vouchers for payments dues and facilitate the workflow of verification and approval. Receivables - Follow-up for collection due before deadlines, tracking of cash and cheque deposits, bank transfers and matching receipts against the relevant invoices and collection of payments.

  

**3.****Bank Reconciliation Statements**

  

Review bank transactions in DCAA bank statement of accounts and DCAA GRP Books and preparation of monthly Bank Reconciliation Statements and ensure matching of records. Prepare collections/payments reports and issues raised to Financial Analyst or Specialist.

  

**4.****Monthly Reporting**

  

Prepare and review monthly reports of revenue Collection & invoice payments, prepare acknowledgement reports, extracting and scrutinizing reports related to closing activities of GRP accounting modules, Transfer of data from Accounts Receivable/Payable to General Ledger and closing periods.

  

**5.****Filing & Documentation**

  

Filing of the copies of payment/receipt vouchers, bank documents, collection reports, bank transfer advice and other collection related documents in proper files and to ensure accessible to management and auditors any time.

  

**6.****Other Duties**

  

Perform any job-related activities of Accounts Payable, General Ledger, Fixed Assets, Budgeting etc; as requested by the Head of Section.

  

****Academic Qualifications:****

  

·Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance or related field preferred.

  

****Certifications:****

  

·GRP FINANCE MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS (Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, Fixed Assets and General Ledger).

  

****Professional Experience:****

  

·Minimum 5 years of progressive experience in financial management, accounting, budgeting, and financial reporting with a Diploma degree; or fresh graduate with a Bachelor’s degree, or fresh graduate with a Master’s degree.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst - FP&A and Corporate Finance | Al-Futtaim Automotive | Dubai
jobs.description:
Established in the 1930s as a trading business, Al-Futtaim Group today is one of the most diversified and progressive, privately held regional businesses headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Structured into five operating divisions; automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia and Africa, Al-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world's most admired and innovative brands. Al-Futtaim Group’s entrepreneurship and relentless customer focus enables the organization to continue to grow and expand; responding to the changing needs of our customers within the societies in which we operate.

  

By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration and integrity; Al-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day

  

**Overview of the Role**

  

We are currently hiring a **Senior Financial Analyst – FP&A & Corporate Finance** to join a dynamic and fast-paced business environment. This is an exciting opportunity for a commercially minded finance professional who thrives on transforming complex data into actionable insights that drive business performance. The role will play a key part in business planning, financial forecasting, performance analysis, investment evaluation, and strategic decision-making across multiple business streams.

  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Lead the annual budgeting process, quarterly forecasts, and long-term strategic planning.
* Develop and maintain driver-based financial models to support business decision-making.
* Prepare monthly management reports, financial commentary, and variance analysis.
* Analyze revenue, margins, pricing, costs, and profitability trends to identify improvement opportunities.
* Monitor operating expenses and support cost optimization initiatives.
* Deliver insightful performance reporting and business reviews for senior leadership.
* Evaluate capital expenditure projects and business investments using NPV, IRR, payback, and sensitivity analysis.
* Support cash flow forecasting, working capital management, and capital efficiency initiatives.
* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to challenge assumptions, improve performance, and drive business growth.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of financial planning and reporting processes.

**Required Skills to Be Successful**

  

* Strong expertise in FP&A, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting.
* Advanced financial modeling, scenario planning, and sensitivity analysis skills.
* Proven capability in variance, profitability, margin, and cost analysis.
* Experience with investment appraisal and business case development.
* Strong analytical thinking with the ability to translate data into commercial insights.
* Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, and communication skills.
* Advanced Excel skills and experience with ERP, planning, and BI platforms.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

**About the Team**

  

You will be joining a high-performing finance team that partners closely with business leaders to drive financial performance and strategic growth. The team plays a critical role in planning, forecasting, performance management, investment analysis, and delivering insights that support key business decisions. The environment encourages collaboration, continuous improvement, commercial thinking, and professional development.

  

**What Equips You for the Role**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
* Professional qualification such as CA, CPA, CFA, ACCA, CMA, or MBA in Finance, or active progression towards one.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience within FP&A, Corporate Finance, Business Finance, or related finance functions.
* Proven experience in business planning, forecasting, performance analysis, cost management, and cash flow forecasting.
* Experience in asset-intensive, distribution, retail, automotive, or similar sectors is advantageous.
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to influence business stakeholders and challenge constructively.
* High attention to detail, integrity, accountability, and a continuous improvement mindset.

We’re here to provide excellent service but a little help from you can ensure a five-star candidate experience from start to finish.

  

Before you click “apply”: Please read the job description carefully to ensure you can confidently demonstrate why this opportunity is right for you and take the time to put together a well-crafted and personalised CV to further boost your visibility. Our global Talent Acquisition team members are all assigned to specific businesses to ensure that we make the best matches between talent and opportunities. We not only consider the requisite compatibility of skills and behaviours, but also how candidates align with our Values of Respect, Integrity, Collaboration, and Excellence.

  

As part of our candidate experience promise, we also want to make ourselves available to you throughout the application process. We make every effort to review and respond to every application.

  

For further information, and to apply, please visit our website via the “Apply” button below.

jobs.title: Accounting-Accountant ( Outsource)
jobs.description:
****أهداف الوظيفة****

  

إثبات المصروفات والإيرادات و تسجيل الاصول الثابتة في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية و إعداد التسويات البنكية وإصدار التقارير ذات العلاقة.

  

****اهم المسؤوليات****

  

1.استلام فواتير الموردين وتصنيفها عن طريق إدخالها في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية بغرض إثباتها في الحسابات.

  

2.إعداد سندات الصرف واصدار الشيكات او التحويلات البنكية و متابعة الحصول على التوقيعات اللازمة وفقا للصلاحيات المعتمدة لصرف المبالغ الصحيحة.

  

3.إثبات كافة قيود العمليات المحاسبية حسب التوجيه المحاسبي السليم وإجراء التعديلات اللازمة .

  

4.إعداد التسويات البنكية الدورية وإعداد التسويات اللازمة وفقاً للإجراءات المعتمدة عن طريق إجراء المقارنات بين فواتير المدفوعات والإيرادات و الدفعات البنكية.

  

5.صرف كشوفات الرواتب الشهرية لموظفي الهيئة عن طريق التحويلات البنكية وفقاً للإجراءات المحاسبية المعتمدة ومتابعة الحصول على الإعتمادات اللازمة للصرف.

  

6.إثبات المنافع المالية ( المنفعة الدورية – منفعة تجهيز مسكن – منفعة السكن المؤقت ) في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية بغرض إثباتها في الحسابات.

  

7.صرف المنافع المالية ( المنفعة الدورية – منفعة تجهيز مسكن – منفعة السكن المؤقت ) من خلال بطاقات المستفيدين للمنفعة .

  

8.إثبات الإيرادات الخاصة بالتراخيص وإعداد الايصالات في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية وفقاً للبنود الخاصة بها .

  

9.استلام تقارير التشغيلية لقاعات الأفراح (مثال : قاعات الطوار والبرشاء) من مركز دبي التجاري و مراجعتها وإثبات الإيرادات في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية

  

10.التأكد من تحويل ايرادات قاعات الافراح من خلال موقع البنك و إعداد الإيصالات في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية.

  

11.التحقق من استلام الشيكات و التحويلات البنكية للمبالغ الواردة من اموال الزكاة و التبرعات و اثباتها في انظمة الموارد الحكومية.

  

12.استلام أوامر صرف أموال الزكاه والمساهمات المجتمعية والتبرعات ولجنة صندوق التضامن و لجنه الحالات الانسانية و ادخالها في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية واثباتها في حسابات الهيئة بهدف توزيعها على الحسابات ذات العلاقة ليتم صرفها للمستحقين وفقاً للاجراءات المعتمدة.

  

13.متابعة ملاحظات الإغلاق الشهري لحسابات الهيئة عن طريق إصدار التقارير المالية من خلال أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية.

  

14.تسجيل الأصول الثابتة في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية لأثباتها في دفاتر حسابات الهيئة.

  

15.المشاركة في فريق الجرد السنوي لإجراء عمليات الجرد السنوية ومطابقتها مع أرصدة الحسابات الموجودة في الأستاذ العام.

  

16.التنسيق مع موظفي المشتريات فيما يتعلق بدفعات الموردين وإعداد مطابقات حسابات الموردين وإعتمادها.

  

17.إعداد التقارير الدورية عن الإيرادات والمصروفات عن طريق أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية وفقاً لمتطلبات الأقسام .

  

18.مراجعة ومطابقة الفواتير مع طلبات الشراء المعتمدة ورفع التوصيات بالمتطلبات مثل ( عقود الشركات ، رسائل تجديد العقود ، العروض المالية للشركات وما إلى ذلك )

  

19.استلام الإيرادات النقدية وإيداعها في حساب البنكي الخاص بإيرادات حكومة دبي.

  

20.الإلتزام بسياسات وإجراءات أمن المعلومات المعتمدة بالهيئة والعمل على الامتثال بالضوابط لضمان سرية المعلومات

  

21.أية مهام أو اختصاصات في نطاق مسؤوليات الوظيفة.

  

****المتطلبات التعليمية****

  

·بكالوريس في المحاسبة أو ما يعادلها.

  

·اجادة اللغتين الانكليزية والعربية(محادثة وكتابة)

  

****متطلبات الخبرة****

  

من 0 – 2 سنوات خبرة في الحسابات.

jobs.title: UAE Branch Accountant | Al-Futtaim Automotive | FAMCO
jobs.description:
**About Al-Futtaim**

  

Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

  

**Overview Of The Role:**

  

* The Branch Accountant supports day-to-day dealership finance operations, ensuring accurate accounting and compliance with financial policies.
* The role involves close collaboration with finance and branch teams to ensure transactions are reviewed, documented, and reconciled. Major responsibilities include supporting vehicle deal documentation, pricing, discount checks, and overseeing cash and banking activities.
* This position requires a focus on the accuracy and timeliness of financial transactions and adherence to month-end timelines.
* The role demands proactive management of daily finance operations within a high-volume automotive environment.

**What You Will Do:**

  

* Review and support the posting of daily branch transactions, including invoices, receipts, customer collections, and vendor payments.
* Support vehicle deals by checking financial aspects, pricing, and discount requests, ensuring accuracy and proper approvals.
* Monitor cash collections, bank deposits, and petty cash, ensuring balances are accurate and reconciled.
* Prepare and follow up on reconciliations for customer accounts, vendor balances, and petty cash.
* Assist with month-end close activities, including accrual inputs, provisions, and journal support.
* Track branch operating expenses, purchase orders, and supplier invoices to identify issues like overspending or miscoding.
* Ensure compliance with financial policies, delegation of authority (DOA), internal controls, and audit requirements.

**Required Skills To Be Successful:**

  

* Proficiency in reconciliation and numerical accuracy.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation discipline.
* Good Excel skills and the ability to manage trackers.
* Ability to manage daily priorities and meet month-end deadlines.

**What Qualifies You For The Role:**

  

* Degree or diploma in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or related field.
* Basic understanding of accounting principles, reconciliations, and financial controls.
* 2-4 years of experience in accounting, branch finance, or high-volume transactional finance.
* Experience with ERP systems, particularly SAP, and dealership finance operations.

**About Al-Futtaim** **Automotive**

  

Al-Futtaim Automotive is one of the region's leading mobility businesses, operating across eight countries in the Middle East, Asia and North Africa.

  

With a portfolio of more than 25 world-leading brands, we deliver one of the region's most comprehensive mobility ecosystems.

  

Our capabilities span passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles and industrial equipment, backed by integrated logistics, leasing, aftersales and financial services that deliver a seamless customer experience across every stage of the mobility journey.

  

Our vision is to become a world-class mobility player, creating better experiences for our customers through innovation, digital transformation and a relentless focus on customer experience. We work alongside some of the world's most trusted automotive brands to shape the future of mobility, delivering solutions that meet the evolving needs of individuals, businesses and communities.

  

Behind everything we do is a team of more than 9,000 colleagues united by ambition, collaboration and a shared commitment to progress. Together, we're shaping the future of mobility, embracing new technologies and creating better experiences for our customers. At Al-Futtaim Automotive, you'll be empowered to turn ambition into action and help move our customers, our business and your career forward.

  

For further information, and to apply, please visit our website via the “Apply” button below.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
To provide support and advice to the management team on financial performance matters and assist in creating and implementing forecasting / budgeting tools and strategies that provide key stakeholders with relevant, accurate and timely management information which supports executive level decision making.

  
  
Responsibilities:  

* Provide timely, relevant, and accurate reports and analysis of performance against historical, budgeted, and forecasted results to facilitate decision-making toward the achievement of the budget and strategic plan
* Provision of business analysis and KPI management
* Adopting a business partnering approach and providing essential financial advice and support to key stakeholders
* Ensure business growth objectives are achieved through planning, coordination and production of budgets and forecasts in a timely manner
* Maintain and develop financial models to aid planning processes, ensuring quality, accuracy, and focused analytical review
* Manage the successful delivery of process improvement initiatives by identifying non-value add activities and implementing solutions which create operational efficiencies across the business
* Responsible for the preparation and execution of month end reporting tasks, ensuring the necessary information is provided in an accurate and timely manner i.e. MIS reporting

* Preparation of periodic reports for OEM requirements and compliance
* Ensure processes and procedures are fully documented in a clear and concise manner and always maintained

* Preparation of ad hoc reports and analysis as required by management

* Strong work ethic, passionate and committed with an enthusiasm to drive change.

jobs.title: Corporate Banking Full Time Analyst, Dubai, UAE 2027
jobs.description:
Job Overview  
  

**You're the brains behind our work**

  
  

You're ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the boardroom and Citi wants to help you get there. Whether it's honing your skills or building your network, we know that success can't come without growth. Our programs equip you with the knowledge and training you need to play a valuable role on your team and establish a long-term career here. At Citi, we value internal mobility, and career growth is not a question of if, but when.

  
  

Citi is looking for full-time Analysts to join the Corporate Banking team in Dubai. Corporate Bankers are relationship-focused finance professionals responsible for understanding the wide range of complex financial issues facing our clients around the world. As a Corporate Banker, you will drive the client dialogue on capital structure, liability management, liquidity and funding strategies, risk management and investment solutions.

  
  

Unique to Citi, Corporate Bankers are also responsible for deciding where to invest the firm's capital and executing on those investments. Corporate Bankers work in partnership with various Citi groups across the firm including Risk Management, Investment Banking and the Capital Markets Origination. If none of these terms make sense right now, that's ok! As a Corporate Banking Analyst, you will join a training program in Dubai, where you will receive an in-depth education on a variety of these topics to learn the fundamentals of the Analyst role and introduce you to Citi's culture. So whatever your degree is in we will give you the training you need to excel.

  
  

**We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed**

  
  

We’re committed to teaching you the ropes. The Analyst Program starts in mid-July 2025 and begins with a six to eight week in-depth training program. You will then be placed with a Corporate Banking team to work with for the duration of the Program. By the third year of the program; Analysts will have the opportunity to take advantage of internal mobility opportunities.

  
  

**Your time here will look something like this…**

  

* Conduct accounting and financial statement analysis, cash flow modelling and capital markets analysis.
* Complete fundamental risk and credit analysis.
* Liaise with product partners.
* Assist in the presentation and development of new ideas to clients.
* Structure deals.

  

**We want to hear from you if...**

  

* You are in your final year of university or graduated.
* Strong academics.
* Interest in business.
* You are fluent in English (another European language desirable).

  

**Who we think will be a great fit...**

  
  

A dedication to learning and a true passion for the business are vital. As industries all over the globe continue to restructure and grow, we are hiring professionals who have a global perspective on the future of banking and want to make an impact on the corporate level. We value diversity and so do you.

  
  

**We'll also be looking for the following:**

  

* Commitment to personal growth and career development, a strong desire to learn and success in team environments.
* Knowledge of the global or domestic business landscape is a plus, but not required
* Strong communication, planning and organizational skills.
* Desire to develop a deep understanding of the financial industry.
* Unquestioned commitment to integrity and ethical decision-making.

  

We will recruit on a rolling basis and therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Successful candidates will be offered a competitive salary.

jobs.description:

* Conduct economic/financial research

* Build complex financial models for valuation purposes
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

jobs.title: Senior Quality Specialist – Microbiology Laboratories
jobs.description:
Senior Quality Specialist – Microbiological Analysis Laboratories

We are seeking an experienced Senior Quality Specialist to join the Microbiological Analysis Laboratories Department and lead quality assurance and accreditation activities in line with international standards.

Location: Dubai

Sector: Government

Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities

Develop, implement, and maintain the laboratory Quality Management System in line with ISO/IEC 17025.

Lead accreditation and re-accreditation activities with EIAC and other accreditation bodies.

Plan and conduct internal audits, and manage nonconformities, root cause analysis, and CAPA.

Oversee method validation and verification, measurement uncertainty, and internal quality control for microbiological tests.

Coordinate proficiency testing and inter-laboratory comparison programs and evaluate results.

Control quality documents, SOPs, and records, and ensure traceability of equipment calibration and reference materials.

Monitor biosafety, environmental monitoring, and media/culture quality control requirements.

Train and support laboratory staff on quality requirements and best practices.

Prepare quality performance reports and KPIs for management review.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Microbiology, Biology, Biotechnology, or a related field (Master's preferred).

Minimum [8–10] years of laboratory experience, including at least [5] years in quality assurance within a microbiology laboratory.

Strong, hands-on knowledge of ISO/IEC 17025 and accreditation processes (EIAC experience is an advantage).

Certified Internal Auditor / Lead Assessor for ISO/IEC 17025 (preferred).

Experience with food, water, environmental, or clinical microbiological testing.

Familiarity with LIMS and statistical tools for QC data analysis.

Excellent communication and report-writing skills in Arabic and English.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Inspector
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
**Position**

QA Inspector

**Location**

Alain Food& Beverages – Al Ain

**Overview**

The Quality Assurance Inspector will carry out proper sample collection & inspection in compliance with the standardized procedures (SOP) and international best practice to ensure right sample is arranged and tested, in addition to production line regular inspection.

**What Will Your Day Look Like?**

* Collect, test, and inspect samples and raw materials according to quality standards.
* Record and report test results accurately and on time.
* Maintain laboratory equipment, chemicals, inventory, and documentation.
* Ensure compliance with GLP, 5S, safety, SOPs, and sanitation requirements.
* Manage product hold/release/reject, audits, proficiency testing, and batch traceability.

**How Will You Make an Impact?**

* Deliver accurate and timely QA results to support product quality and safety.
* Maintain a safe, efficient, and compliant laboratory.
* Strengthen quality control, traceability, and continuous improvement processes.

**What Would Make You Successful?**

**Minimum Qualifications**

* High School

**Minimum Experience**

* 1-2 years functional experience plus technical certifications as required. Operational training will be an added advantage.

**Functional Knowledge**

* Technical certifications and Operational training will be an added advantage
* Good knowledge of Laboratory Management
* Good knowledge of Food Quality Assurance
* Strong Analytical and problem-solving skills
* Good knowledge of laboratory equipment and techniques

**Grow with Agthia – For the Better**

Agthia Group is one of the region’s leading Food & Beverage companies, with a growing international footprint. We are a publicly listed company on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange (ADX) and part of ADQ, one of the region’s largest holding companies.

Rooted in Abu Dhabi since 1978, we've grown into a global presence, operating in countries including the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Oman, Egypt, Turkey, and Jordan. We’ve built a diverse portfolio of over 35 market-leading brands across Water & Food, Snacking, Protein & Frozen, and Agri-Business – touching the lives of millions of consumers in more than 65 global markets. With sustainability at the core of our innovations, we’ve pioneered several world-first products, setting new benchmarks in industry and meeting the evolving needs of communities worldwide.

Over 12,000 people from more than 67 nationalities are at the heart of shaping our purpose-driven future, supported by an agile environment which encourages collaboration, creativity, and the freedom to make a real difference. With a competitive benefits package, genuine opportunities to advance, and a focus on continuous learning and development, we’re committed to supporting your growth as we work together to deliver excellence “For the Better.”

Join us and be part of a team that's not just shaping the future of food and beverage but also making a meaningful impact on the world. Together, let's grow 'For the Better.'
